articleTitle: Comparison of Hyperledger Fabric and Ethereum Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Blockchain technology has received wide attention from researchers and scientists. Blockchain technology is also upgrading all the time. When the original Bitcoin was created, it laid the groundwork for the emergence of Ethereum. Now new federation chains like Hyperledger Fabric are growing fast. Ethereum and fabric are the two representatives. Permissioned and private blockchain platforms are increasingly used in today’s industry. Different blockchain implementations use different consensus protocols. This article briefly compares Hyperledger Fabric and Ethereum from several aspects such as consensus and smart contacts.

articleTitle: Research on Obstacle Avoidance Algorithm of Multi-UAV Consistent Formation Based on Improved Dynamic Window Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The artificial potential field method is widely used in UAV formation and obstacle avoidance due to its concise algorithm and easy implementation, but it is easy to fall into a local optimal solution in a large-scale environment, and the algorithm does not consider the kinematics of the controlled object; this paper proposes An improved dynamic window approach, considering the UAV kinematics model, realizes the effective obstacle avoidance of UAV formations under the consistency algorithm. Firstly, the target distance correction azimuth angle evaluation function is introduced, and the A star algorithm is integrated to replace the fixed weight of the azimuth angle evaluation function, which improves the search ability of the UAV to navigate to the target point in the unknown environment. Secondly, a new rotation cost is added to the evaluation function, and a penalty is imposed on the large rotation angle to ensure the smoothness of the trajectory. Then, the improved obstacle avoidance strategy is applied to the leading-following consistent formation algorithm, which can effectively achieve formation keeping, obstacle avoidance and collision avoidance between aircraft in unknown environments. Finally, the simulation verification based on Matlab shows that the proposed improved dynamic window strategy can significantly improve the UAV path planning and obstacle avoidance ability in the location environment, and it can be applied to the consistent formation algorithm while maintaining the formation.

articleTitle: Development of Image Processing Based on Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of computer technology and information technology, the development of deep learning has been greatly promoted, and as the mainstream trend of the development of deep learning, there is a great technological breakthrough in the field of image processing. This paper mainly focuses on the development of image processing technology supported by deep learning algorithm, using particle swarm algorithms, image matching algorithms and deletion strategies to optimize image processing technology, and it is found that each of these methods plays a role in pattern recognition, obtaining deeper meaning of images and deleting unimportant information. Deep learning algorithm enable the processing of a large amount of stored information and ensure the integrity of the image in the process of optimizing image processing.

articleTitle: Write-Fi: An Accurate Handwriting Recognition System Using Multimodal Net
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Handwriting recognition via Wi-Fi signal is still faced with the difficulty in dealing with individual inconsistency and action diversity and in accurately identifying similar letter pairs. To address these issues, we in this paper propose a WiFi based system, called Write-Fi, which recognizes handwriting actions from Channel State Information (CSI). We design a signal generalization scheme to synthesize variant data to simulate possible changes in the writing actions of different people to alleviate the influence of diversified handwriting speed and scale. Besides, we develop a novel model named Attention Multimodal Fusion Network (AMFN). The multimodal Characteristic of AMFN can preserve the minor characteristic differences between similar uppercase and lowercase letters. In different tasks, we utilize the fused self-attention mechanism to focus adaptively on different crucial parts of handwriting representation. The experiments demonstrate that Write-Fi can obtain 94.63% accuracy on uppercase and lowercase letters.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Intelligent Recommendation System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the popularity of smart phones, e-commerce has developed rapidly. Intelligent recommendation is a very important task in the field of e-commerce. Researchers have proposed the use of association rules, collaborative filtering, Markov chain, recurrent neural network and other technologies for shopping basket recommendation. This paper mainly studies e-commerce intelligent recommendation system(IRS) based on deep learning. In this paper, the overall design of e-commerce recommendation system is firstly carried out, and the functional modules and system architecture of e-commerce IRS are proposed. Then, this paper discusses the recommendation algorithm in the e-commerce IRS, and optimizes the e-commerce IRS based on convolutional neural network. Finally, this paper compares and analyzes the performance of three popular recommendation algorithms on Alibaba data set. Experimental results show that the proposed convolutional neural network recommendation algorithm based on deep learning is superior to the other two algorithms and has strong practical significance and promotion value.

articleTitle: Design of Parking Space Management System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the improvement of people’s quality of life and the rapid development of the automobile consumer market, the problem of urban parking difficulties has become increasingly prominent. In addition to the insufficiency of the number of supporting parking spaces, the backwardness of the traditional parking lot operation model has led to insufficient openness and transparency of various information, which limits the ability of drivers to obtain parking space information, and limited parking spaces cannot be adequately obtained. Utilization is also one of the reasons for the increasing difficulty of urban parking. This article aims to study the design of parking space management system based on Internet of Things technology, choose ZigBee technology to realize wireless communication between parking spaces in the parking lot, analyze the advantages of ZigBee technology and the needs of parking space management system, and build a simulation based on the system design the test environment has made relevant tests on the various items of the system. The test results show that the use of ZigBee technology makes the system have the characteristics of strong adaptability, low cost, and low power consumption, which not only eliminates the complicated wiring costs in the parking lot, but also brings great convenience to the deployment of parking lot nodes.

articleTitle: Dynamic detection of malicious intrusion in wireless network based on improved random forest algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the malicious nonlinear scrambling intrusion detection ability of wireless network and ensure the security of the network, a malicious nonlinear scrambling intrusion detection method based on improved random forest algorithm is proposed. The wireless network malicious nonlinear scrambling intrusion signal model is constructed, the physical layer characteristic detection method of terminal equipment is used to decompose the characteristics of the wireless network malicious nonlinear scrambling intrusion signal, the spectrum characteristic quantity of the wireless network malicious nonlinear scrambling intrusion is extracted by the analysis method of test statistics and detection threshold, and the signal characteristic reorganization and fuzzy clustering analysis are realized by using the improved random forest algorithm for the extracted spectrum characteristics of the wireless network malicious nonlinear scrambling intrusion. According to the clustering distribution of spectral features of malicious nonlinear scrambling intrusion signals in wireless networks, the optimal detection of malicious nonlinear scrambling intrusion features in wireless networks is realized under random forest learning by adopting the methods of reinforcement learning decision and static feature fusion. The simulation results show that the feature clustering of malicious non-linear scrambling intrusion detection in wireless networks is good, and the probability of accurate identification of intrusion information is high.

articleTitle: STM32 microcontroller-based closed-loop speed control drive system design for FOC motors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper designs a motor closed-loop speed control system based on STM32 microcontroller and FOC algorithm. The system consists of microprocessor and motor drive module, Hall sensor module, human-machine interaction module and voltage and current acquisition module, etc. The STM32F407IGT6 chip with Cortex-M3 as the core is used as the processor, and LCD display and buttons are used to realize human-machine interaction. In the hardware, the circuit is designed with STM32 as the core. The rotating state of the motor is converted into pulse signal by Hall sensor and transmitted to STM32 for processing to get the position information of the motor rotor, and the three-phase current of the motor is obtained by sampling the ADC of STM32. The Clarke transform model, Park transform model, and inverse Park transform model are planned in the software, and the BAS algorithm is introduced to optimize the FOC vector control.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection Scheme Based on IPSO-SVM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the level of network intrusion detection, this paper optimized IPSO-SVM algorithm based on support vector machine, and applied the algorithm to network intrusion detection, and constructed a new network intrusion detection architecture. This architecture simplifies the intrusion detection system by sample classification and selects the optimal parameters as the basis of intrusion detection judgment by iterative processing. Experimental results show that the intrusion detection scheme proposed in this paper can fully and accurately identify the intrusion attack behavior, and can be used as a network intrusion detection tool.

articleTitle: The USV Path Planning of Dueling DQN Algorithm Based on Tree Sampling Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The path planning and obstacle avoidance of USV (unmanned surface vessel) has become a research hotspot in recent years. Among them, the DQN algorithm has achieved good results in the obstacle avoidance and path planning problems of unmanned surface vessel. However, the algorithm suffers from the problems that the sampling method does not make full use of the stored information and the randomness of action selection during the training process is too large and the convergence is too slow. In this paper, we propose a Dueling DQN algorithm to optimize obstacle avoidance and path planning, which based on tree sampling mechanism. The Dueling DQN algorithm will decomposes the value function Q into a state-value function (V) and a dominance function (A). Meanwhile, the absolute value of TD-error is directly used as a priority indicator for priority sampling in the sampling process. Subsequently, the network model is built and experiments are conducted on each of the four maps. As a result, the convergence steps and loss values of the proposed algorithm on the four paths are better than those of the DQN algorithm. It shows that the dueling DQN algorithm can effectively use the stored information for optimal path planning.

articleTitle: Abnormal Heart Sound Detection by Using Temporal Convolutional Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Abnormal heart sound detection is great of significance because of the frequent occurrence of heart diseases. However, the automatic diagnosis for abnormal heart sound has a high requirement for domain knowledge and the signal noise poses an increased difficulty of diagnosis. In this paper, we propose a temporal convolutional network (TCN) to automatically detect abnormal heart sounds. Specifically, a noise removing technology is applied to original signals. Then, a TCN architecture is carefully designed to adapt the properties of heartbeat sound. The proposed method is tested on the Physionet dataset, and the results show our method contains potential ability in abnormal heart sound detection.

articleTitle: Analysis on Relevant Factors Affecting Life Expectancy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Although human life expectancy has exceeded 70 years, life expectancy in some countries is still short. Studying the factors affecting life expectancy is significant to improve life expectancy. Therefore, in this work, we firstly analyzed the factors related to life expectancy and then designed the multiple linear regression (MLR) models to predict life expectancy. In this work, 18 factors were considered in regression model, such as GDP, disease, school index, etc. According to Spearman correlation coefficient, we analyzed the reasons affecting the life expectancy, and design 3 MLR models to predict life expectancy. The result show that disease, schooling index and income are considerable factors affecting life expectancy. The root mean squared error (RMSE) of MLR is 3.818 obtained after analysis. In addition, we verified that factors affecting life expectancy are different for developed and developing countries. So, it is necessary to regress for two types of countries. For developing countries, medical and school factors are more important for developing countries. The RMSE of MLR is 3.99 for developing countries, and 2.57 for developed countries.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi 4B-based Design of Home Intelligent Access Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Continuous development of computer technology leads to ever-growing demand for door lock intelligence. In response to this change, a Raspberry Pi 4B-based home intelligent access control system is designed for humanized functions such as voice broadcast. The system has three unlocking modes: remote unlocking, password unlocking and face unlocking. The hardware has a Raspberry Pi 4B-based camera module to record face portraits, process images, save portraits, recognize faces, etc. It has OLED12864 LCD screen for display, and voice broadcast module for broadcast prompts. The mobile terminal can not only unlock remotely, but also receive alarm information in addition to remote monitoring. With convenient unlocking mode and sound alarm system, it is more convenient and safer than the general access control system, thus more appropriate for life. With diversified unlocking modes, it is deeply favored by users.

articleTitle: A fault diagnosis method based on data feature reconstruction and deep transfer learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The ability to quickly and accurately diagnose the fault type of equipment is the key to ensure its safe and efficient operation. In this paper, a fault diagnosis method based on data feature reconstruction and deep transfer learning is proposed, and the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by using bearings as the experimental object. Firstly, the original bearing vibration signal is converted into a two-dimensional scalogram using wavelet transform; secondly, GoogLeNet is pre-trained using Image Net Data, the network structure is fine-tuned using transfer learning, and the two-dimensional scalogram is used as the input of the deep neural network; finally, the model was validated and analyzed several times with the MFPT bearing fault data set, and the average diagnostic accuracy of the proposed method reached 99.4%, which verified its feasibility and superiority and provided a theoretical basis for guiding bearing maintenance decisions.

articleTitle: Yolo Target Detection Algorithm in Road Scene Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Using artificial intelligence, computer vision and other technologies, cars can monitor driving conditions to ensure safety or assist driving. As a driver’s primary task, finding a parking space is equivalent to “eyes”, which need to identify cars and pedestrians in front of the road. The purpose of this paper is to study the Yolo object detection algorithm for road scenes based on computer vision. This paper expounds the research basis and importance of road object detection, as well as the status quo of traditional road object detection, and deeply studies the progress of road object detection optimization. For the analysis of related technologies, firstly, the grayscale of the image is introduced, then the binarization of the image is introduced, and finally the YOLOv4 is analyzed in detail. The software and hardware environment used in the experiment is introduced, the image collection and label labeling process in the data set used in the experiment is described, and the evaluation indicators commonly used to evaluate target detection algorithms are introduced. Through the comparison of FasterR-CNN, SSD and YOLOv4, The average accuracy rate (mAP) of YOLOv4 reaches 87.2%, which meets the requirements of autonomous vehicles.

articleTitle: Social Network Link Prediction Algorithm Based on Node Similarity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Nowadays, with the rapid development of computer technology, network technology has changed people’s lives. The popularity of various social networking sites and smart terminals has enabled people to leave a large amount of real data on the virtual network, thus providing a database for network analysis and research. With the continuous development of social networks, while enjoying the convenience of a rich digital life, people also feel the problems brought about by information expansion, that is, people cannot quickly and effectively extract the most relevant information from the largest information. Predicting the undiscovered links that may or may not exist on the network is useful for analyzing the lack of network data and analyzing the complex mechanisms of network evolution. This research is very important for the analysis of social networks. This paper studies the social network link prediction algorithm based on node similarity. First, the literature research method is used to summarize the social network process and social network link prediction. Experiments are carried out on the social network link prediction algorithm based on node similarity. Comparing the prediction accuracy of the two algorithms, the experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of the LP and Katz indexes exceeds 90%, and the AUC value of most predictions is as high as 95%, indicating that the prediction results of these two types of indexes are close to the truth. The prediction result of the LHNII index is very poor, and the prediction value is less than 0.5, which means that the prediction result is not as accurate as the random prediction result. CN, AA, RA indicators have higher AUC values than other indicators. Among them, the RA index has the best prediction effect, and the prediction effect is the best on the four data sets of Usair, Jazz, Power Grid and Yeast; followed by the AA indicator and the CN indicator, which have the best prediction effect on the C. elegans and Email data sets respectively good.

articleTitle: Population Data Analysis Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of social production and the accumulation of material conditions, the population changes more and more, and the supporting resources are also constantly changing. In order to help people allocate resources rationally, it is necessary to first predict population data such as population number, population birth rate, and population growth rate. To this end, this paper proposes a model for analyzing population data, first obtaining the population; then analyzing the data; then modeling the population number, population birth rate, and population growth rate, and obtained the correct values of 0.9965612798125165, 0.8081945627540684, and 0.6572562263495255, respectively. Rate and dig out more useful information. To a certain extent, the model has a certain use value and can be promoted and used, thereby reducing the tedious work of some people.

articleTitle: Efficient Prediction of Heart Disease Using Cross Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Cardiovascular malady is top of the foremost specifics causes of deaths within the all over the world nowadays. Prediction of heart disease infection may be a basic face within the range of scientific information investigation. Mechanism knowledge has been appeared to be helpful in making choices and expectations from the expansive amount of unprocessed form prepared by the health department industry. In this study, machine learning (ML) methodologies and strategies being utilized in later advancements in different ranges of the Web of Things (WoT). Different ponders deliver as it were a see into anticipating heart disease with ML methods. In this paper, a novel methodologies that points for finding particularity methods is proposed, which implementing ML methods coming about in making strides the precision within the forecasting of cardiovascular malady. The forecast demonstrate is presented with diverse collection of highlights and several known classification strategies. Furthermore, it is investigated to create an improved execution level with an accuracy level of 89% through the forecast show for cardiovascular ailment.

articleTitle: Air Target Intention Recognition Based on Incomplete Multi-Granulation Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, an incomplete Multi-Granulation Rough Set (incomplete MGRS) is presented to recognize the intention of the air target. First, the model of the air target intention recognition based on the incomplete MGRS has be constructed, the dynamic change rate of the air target state has been added into the condition attribution of the decision to enhance the air target intention recognition capability under incomplete information and dynamic environment. And then some measures and a attribute reduction algorithm based on the importance of the decision attribute are presented. Finally, the simulation results showing that the decision algorithm based on the incomplete MGRS can recognize the intention of air target effectively under complex and uncertain combat environment.

articleTitle: A Survey on the Applications of Image Classification Based on Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Convolutional neural network has an obvious advantage to deal with image classification, compared to other deep learning algorithms. In this paper, we review current methods for classifying images and introduce classical image classification models based on CNN. CNN is a traditional and useful network and widely used in various fields of artificial intelligence. We conclude the feature extraction methods of image classification, including linear feature extraction and non-linear feature extraction. Additionally, the applications of CNN and the related models from 2012 to 2021 have been discussed in chronological order in this paper.

articleTitle: Design of Campus Network Security System Based on Network Information Security
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Network information security has been elevated to a national strategy and has become a powerful driving force for innovation and development. While the campus network is developing rapidly, due to the openness and sharing nature of the Internet technology, it still leaves shortcomings in the protection against illegal intrusion and attacks. With the subsequent increase in hacking techniques and the emergence of a wide range of network attack tools, the use of firewalls alone is no longer sufficient to deal with network attacks and to ensure effective protection of sensitive data. Research on the security system of campus network, propose a security system structure with longitudinal anti-attack capability and diversified defence means, adopt measures of application security, physical security, system security, network security and management security, etc. to enhance the ability of campus network to resist attacks and serve the teaching and research work of universities in all aspects.

articleTitle: E-commerce Information Management Model Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The development of artificial intelligence in the information age has undergone qualitative changes, while e-commerce, as the most mature and advanced field of current information technology, has a great impact on people’s life. This paper puts forward the research content based on the current situation of China’s computer Internet industry. Firstly, the definition and characteristics of e-commerce information management are introduced. Secondly, the relationship between artificial intelligence and computer science and technology and relevant theoretical knowledge are studied. Then based on this theory, the paper analyzes the e-commerce information management model and tests the performance of the model. The final test results show that the operation response time and delay time of the information management model are within 2-3 seconds, the memory consumption is about 3400K, and the CPU space is about 2%, and the user concurrency is about 5000. This shows that the information management model can work well.

articleTitle: Design of Interactive Landscape Virtual Tour System Based on 3D Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Under the background of the rapid development of the triple play and the Internet-of-Everything (IoE) model in the new era, it is of practical significance to promote the rapid development of digital landscape design. The effect simulation of traditional landscape design is based on images and videos, which has its limitations. Therefore, this research proposes a new method that breaks through the realisation of traditional landscape design schemes for the three stages of "design-implementation-experience", which is known as "virtual tour design". The novelty of this design is computing a simulated environment through virtual reality (VR) technology, which combines the design of the architectural garden landscape with the ecological environment. This achieves the purpose of improving the interactivity and interest in the tour design, as well as reducing the communication costs between the designer and participants. VR technology has many advantages such as the freedom of experience, diverse perspectives, supply of information, and strong interactivity. Therefore, the realism of landscape simulation based on VR technology can reach more than 95% and has strong applicability in the landscape field, and is a simple and convenient way to achieve the desired effect.

articleTitle: Human-computer interaction-based robotic design and development and control system testing —Prototyping and implementation testing study of a robotic hand
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: One of the most challenging issues in the development of existing robotic hand design and development based on existing policies and in everyday people’s needs for interactive technologies that can assist patients who have lost hand manipulation due to neurological or stroke induced. This paper focuses on robotic hand designs aimed at assisting post-stroke patients with enhanced human-computer interaction, including four innovative research direction areas. a) Aesthetically, the four-piece human-computer interaction-based robotic hand design (i.e., internal mechanics, five elastic bands, electrodes, and soft skin-friendly material) looks more like sports equipment than a wearable machine. b) Inspired by human palm design engineering, the The human-computer assisted manipulator is an innovative form of mixing soft and hard components and materials, constructed from layers closest to the body made of soft, stretchable fabrics (i.e., neoprene and fly stitch fabric). 3D printed flexible TPU components, which use BOA dials to increase or decrease finger tension. c) For added strength, the product is worn on the palm of the hand, and then tightening the wrist strap prevents unwanted movement This is an innovative patent and is integrated into the glove. This is innovative and patented and the BOA dial integrated in the glove is attached to five elastic bands, one for each finger, which are secured in place by a channel placed on the TPU piece. This makes it lighter in weight. d) Intelligent. By being equipped with sensors, it can be intelligently sensed internally to properly release tension with promoting blood circulation in the wearer’s hand, they push the BOA dial in and rotate it to increase tension, and to release tension, the user simply pulls the BOA dial upward. This will help the muscles relax and restore normal fluid movement. The data can be viewed in the accompanying app. After researching and investigating the existing human-machine interaction based robotic hand mostly made of steel, the sensor cannot sense the material of the object well after wearing, temperature, and the set finger bending angle cannot fit the object well. Through experimental data to test the best working area and experimental daily use force, we study and adjust the best for the human-machine interaction-based robotic three-dimensional work treatment area. This is one of the most innovative solutions with the future of the industry, this research focuses on the process of human-computer interaction for the patient’s hand is also required for a large number of interaction resources also with human resources. The development of a more skin-friendly, safer, and less expensive human-computer interaction-based manipulator (HES) that can operate by itself is sufficient to support all daily living activities (ADLs) of the hand. Finally, the physical field study experiments also showed that the device is flexible and can be customized by anyone for the right size and use.

articleTitle: A Survey of Sentiment Analysis Based on Multi-Modal Information
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis is a new direction in the field of emotion analysis and has become a research hotspot in recent years. This paper first briefly outlines the concept of multimodal sentiment analysis and its research background. Secondly, it sorts out the development context of existing text and image fusion, text and audio and video fusion sentiment analysis, then describes the multimodal data fusion method, and finally discusses the future development direction of multi-modal sentiment analysis. It is the intention of this study to provide corresponding reference value for workers in related fields.

articleTitle: Text Detection Based on Bidirectional Feature Fusion and SA Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Most of the scene text detection methods can not balance accuracy and speed, so these text detection methods are difficult to apply to the scenarios with real-time requirements. We propose a text detection network that attempts to improve text detection’s accuracy while guaranteeing the speed of text detection. Firstly, we use ResNet with SA attention mechanism as a backbone network for extracting image features. Then, different feature layers are fused by a bidirectional feature fusion mechanism, and a bilinear interpolation method is adopted for upsampling to reduce the feature loss in the feature fusion process. Finally, the post-processing part uses a differentiable binarization module to ensure the generalization and real-time performance of the model. The model has good performance on public dataset, achieving 41 of FPS and 83.2% of F-measure on the ICDAR2015, which verify the model has both good real-time performance and high accuracy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Logistics Supply Chain Management Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Supply chain management refers to the logistics management between enterprises, which involves coordinating the design and operation of the entire chain, including suppliers, manufacturers, wholesalers and retailers. Implementing the system concept of integrated supply chain management is a research hotspot. The purpose of this paper is to study the application of intelligent supply chain management based on Internet of Things technology. Mainly take the drug supply chain as the research object, and apply the Internet of Things technology to drug transportation. The first is to analyze the traditional supply chain system to determine the supply chain’s demand for IoT technology and wireless technology; the second is to rationally optimize the various processes in the supply chain management system, and make its function realization practical. The experimental results show that compared with the original distribution logistics system, the optimized scheme saves 12.8% of the cost. Finally, the framework and structure of the medical supply chain system based on the Internet of Things technology are established, and the implementation and application are analyzed.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking Control of Unmanned Vehicle Based on Data-driven Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Since the traditional Model Predictive Control(MPC), which is widely used for trajectory tracking of autonomous vehicle, cannot analyze and determine specific parameters of the controller by mathematical methods. In this paper, a trajectory tracking control method based on model prediction is proposed to solve the problem of unmanned vehicle trajectory tracking, and the controller is optimized in a performance objective driven way. Specifically, the cost function of the model predictive controller is parameterized. And the global optimal performance in a specific scenario as the goal to build the global performance cost function. Then, the global performance cost is expressed as a Gaussian process, and new parameters of the next optimization are inferred by Bayesian optimization. The controller parameters of global performance optimization are found with a small learning cost through multiple iterations to improve tracking performance. To verify the effectiveness of this data-driven optimization algorithm, lane-changing experiments with Carsim and Matlab/Simulink are carried out. According to the test data, it is proved that the performance of trajectory tracking under this data-driven MPC algorithm is optimized.

articleTitle: A MrPPG Method for Face Anti-Spoofing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, many face anti-spoofing algorithms have high detection accuracy when detecting 2D face anti-spoofing or 3D mask face anti-spoofing alone in the field of face anti-spoofing, but their detection performance is greatly reduced in multidimensional and cross-datasets tests. The rPPG method used for face anti-spoofing uses the unique vital information of real face to judge real faces and face anti-spoofing, so rPPG method has strong stability compared with other methods, but its detection rate of 2D face anti-spoofing needs to be improved. Therefore, in this paper, we improve a rPPG method (MrPPG) for face anti-spoofing which through color space fusion, using the correlation of pulse signals between real face regions and background regions, and introducing the cyclic neural network (LSTM) method to improve accuracy in 2D face anti-spoofing. Meanwhile, the MrPPG also has high accuracy and good stability in face anti-spoofing of multidimensional and cross-data datasets. The improved method was validated on Replay-Attack, CASIA-FASD, Siw and HKBU_MARs_V2 datasets, the experimental results show that the performance and stability of the improved algorithm proposed in this paper is superior to many advanced algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on user satisfaction of mobile short video based on rough set
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development and upgrade of information technology, the mobile short video has gradually become the source of generating information, entertainment, and online shopping on our smartphones. In the article, we build evaluation indicators based on the consumer satisfaction theory to construct a system of user satisfaction evaluation. Meanwhile, conducting a sample survey on the popular mobile short video users on the Internet to collect data using a random online questionnaire. Then, use the rough set to reduce the system and determine the weight, eliminating the subjectivity of the weight setting of the traditional method. Finally, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is established to calculate the total score of user satisfaction of mobile short videos. It improves the authenticity, reliability and accuracy of the results of this study. Based on the research on mobile short video user satisfaction, we propose practical suggestions for developing mobile Internet to promote the short video based on user needs. Then, increase user stickiness and user scale so that mobile short videos will have better development in the future. The advantage of this model is to further optimize the rough set applied to the complex evaluation system. By simplifying the indexes and determining the weights of each index according to the importance of the influential factors, the evaluation results are generally consistent with the original system, which is not only objective and accurate, but also more feasible and meaningful in many complex index systems.

articleTitle: Robust Automatic Camera Calibration in Badminton Court Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Badminton has attracted a large number of enthusiasts with its unlimited venues and inexpensive nature, and badminton-related studies have emerged, all of which mainly focus on the analysis of badminton videos. Badminton video analysis requires the foundation of court recognition, and this paper discusses the recognition of badminton courts in images. We propose an automatic camera calibration algorithm that is robust in badminton court recognition, which can recognize badminton courts under a variety of shooting angles and solve the problem of court line mapping in the case that the real court lines fall behind the camera optical center. The main process of our algorithm includes three parts: candidate pixel extraction, court line detection and model fitting, adding line number constraints and 3-dimensional mapping filtering to the traditional camera calibration model to improve the robustness of the algorithm. Our algorithm is tested on a self-built dataset containing 300 images of badminton courts from different angles and has a good performance. Our algorithm can be applied to court recognition of other ball sports and can also be extended to court recognition in videos by modifying the standard model, with a wide range of application scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on distributed power transaction mode and strategy based on energy storage cloud platform architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the context of liberalizing the electricity sales side, this paper establishes an open and shared energy storage cloud platform model, and proposes a multi-agent shared energy storage transaction model, aiming at the lack of effective ways and models for distributed energy to participate in the electricity market and direct transactions with users. On this basis, a continuous two-way auction transaction mode and quotation strategy for local distributed energy are proposed. Finally, a park in northern my country is taken as an example to verify and the transaction settlement process is given. The analysis of the calculation example shows that the transaction method and quotation strategy adopted in this paper have better flexibility and reliability, and can be used for the realization of decentralized distributed distribution. The operation of the power trading market provides a reference and has the function of optimizing the allocation of power resources.

articleTitle: Real-time traffic flow detection system based on video image processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of urbanization, traffic problems are becoming more and more serious. Relevant literature shows that traffic information is a direct reflection of road conditions, and timely mastering of traffic information has important research significance for rational allocation of traffic resources and alleviation of congestion. In order to obtain the main traffic information of the road in real time, this paper designed a detection system of vehicle flow and vehicle queue length based on FPGA. Through analyzing the system requirements, and conducting experiments on the development system and simulation tools used, relevant data were obtained. In addition, this paper studies image preprocessing, vehicle presence detection algorithm, vehicle flow statistics algorithm and vehicle queuing length to get relevant conclusions. It provides practical research significance for road traffic resource optimization and traffic light signal lamp.

articleTitle: Intelligent English Writing Automatic Scoring System Based on Data Fusion Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and information technology, computers are increasingly used in high school English teaching. People use network technology to develop an automatic scoring system for English writing, and use it to automate English writing correction and feedback. Automatic English writing correction and feedback are convenient, fast, detailed and relevant. This will also be the direction of feedback education and research in English high schools in the future. This paper studies the intelligent English writing automatic scoring system based on data fusion algorithms. After a general understanding of the intelligent English writing automatic scoring system and the related theories of data fusion algorithms, the intelligent English writing automatic scoring system based on data fusion algorithms is carried out, then design and test the designed system. The test results show that the overall score of the system in this paper is 1-2 points higher than the manual score.

articleTitle: Exploration and analysis of intelligent IoT based on the difficult environment of warehouse indoor positioning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the problems of low informatization, difficulty in positioning and high algorithm complexity in the indoor operation of logistics warehouses. Using a combination of interdisciplinary research methods and simulation methods, a solution based on RFID technology is proposed for this problem. And simulates and verify the program through experiments.

articleTitle: Quantitative evaluation of morphological characteristics of road coarse aggregates based on image processing technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To quantitatively characterize and evaluate the morphological features of coarse aggregate particles, 2D images of coarse aggregate particles were processed by using Image Pro-Plus software in this paper. Through image enhancement, correction, segmentation, and retrieval, six morphological indicators such as axial coefficient, rectangularity, roundness, roughness, angular parameters, and fractal dimension were obtained. Further statistical analysis of the distribution pattern of each morphological characteristic parameter was carried out in a large sample to provide a basis for the quality control of coarse aggregates processing. What’s more, further statistical analysis of the distribution pattern of each morphological characteristic parameter was carried out in a large sample to provide a basis for the quality control of coarse aggregates processing. The axial coefficient of coarse aggregates of different particle sizes, decreases with increasing particle size. The roundness decreases with increasing particle size, and the fractal dimension decreases with increasing particle size; the axial coefficient and rectangularity can be used to characterize the shape of coarse aggregates without the influence of angles. Roughness and fractal dimension can be used to characterize coarse aggregate angles independent of shape; angular parameters, roughness or angular parameters, and fractal dimension can be chosen when characterizing angles only. This study can provide a fast and efficient quantitative basis for the optimization of the coarse aggregate processing and process control of incoming quality.

articleTitle: Micro-Doppler Extraction of Cone-Shaped Target Based on STFT-RANSAC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As an important feature for micro-motion targets, micro-Doppler is widely used in parameters estimation and target classification. Aiming at the extraction of micro-Doppler, a method based on STFT (Short Time Fourier Transform, STFT) and RANSAC (Random Sample Consensus, RANSAC) is proposed. Firstly, the precession model of coneshaped target is established, and the parameterized expression of micro-Doppler is derived. Secondly, STFT is conducted on the echo to analyze the characteristic in time-frequency domain, and time-frequency maxima is used to acquire the time-frequency points set. Then, according to the parameterized expression, the prescribed fitting function is designed, and RANSAC is adopted to distinguish the valid micro-Doppler frequency points and the invalid points, and thus the micro-Doppler is estimated. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Application of PLC Control Technology in Intelligent Automatic Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of electronic computer technology, the application of industrial robots in the automation control of electrical equipment is more and more extensive, and PLC as the core of the field of automation control, in today's intelligent manufacturing field occupies a more and more important position. This paper mainly studies the application of PLC control technology in intelligent automatic control. This paper first introduces programmable logic controller PLC, according to the development needs of this paper on the SELECTION of PLC and communication design, information interaction design and PLC programming design. In this paper, the stability of intelligent automatic control system based on PLC is tested, and the test results show that the success rate of the system designed in this paper is above 90%, which can meet the production needs. It has certain reference and guiding significance for the design and management of modern intelligent automatic production system in China.

articleTitle: Research on Low Cost Multisensor Vehicle Integrated Navigation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of intelligent driving assistance technology, precise positioning in urban complex environment is one of the application difficulties of navigation and positioning at present. The classical GPS / INS integrated navigation scheme continues navigation by IMU in the case of GPS distortion such as satellite navigation signal occlusion, but the error accumulation of low-cost inertial navigation devices will occur over time. Therefore, an integrated navigation system with two modes is proposed: GPS / INS combination with satellite navigation information and INS / Speedometer combination without satellite navigation information, so as to avoid the large error of pure inertial navigation mode. The measured data show that the maximum horizontal error of the algorithm is less than 6m in the case of GPS short-time lock loss (<40s), which meets the requirements of short-time positioning accuracy. In urban vehicle driving environment, the adaptive Kalman filter algorithm and vehicle dynamics constraints are applied to the navigation filter algorithm, with an aim to improve the accuracy of integrated navigation. The experimental results show that the longitude and latitude error after filtering is less than 1.8m, which meets the accuracy and cost requirements of some vehicle positioning applications to a certain extent.

articleTitle: College Teacher Training Resource Management System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the future of the era of knowledge economy, colleges and universities in our country, as the basis of training all kinds of excellent talents in the period of social reform, are facing various challenges under the new situation. The training of university teachers is becoming more and more the key to implement the human resource management function of the whole university, and also has an important connection with the university professor system. The purpose of this article is to analyze the university teacher training resource management system, based on data mining technology, through the analysis of the status quo of higher vocational school teachers management features and functions, and data analysis, the teachers of information resource management subsystem, promote the building method of college teachers' management system, the key is to complete the construction of college teachers of the prediction and management research. According to the data mining algorithm, the confidence of young teachers is about 0.714, so as to formulate the corresponding teacher training construction plan.

articleTitle: 3D Garden Landscape Generation System Based on Machine Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the acceleration of the process of urbanization in my country, the urban population has continued to increase, and there is a higher demand for the quality of garden landscapes. The purpose of three-dimensional landscape generation is to achieve harmony between man and nature, so as to beautify the urban living environment and optimize the working and living conditions of residents. The purpose of the research on the 3D garden landscape generation system in this paper is to intelligently design the landscape through machine learning technology. This article mainly uses experimental methods and qualitative analysis methods to conduct detailed research on the three-dimensional garden landscape generation system, and uses the experimental test results to draw conclusions. The data shows that the accuracy of the system designed in this paper is above 0.8, which can meet the basic requirements. The 3D garden landscape generation system based on machine learning technology has certain efficiency and ability.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer 3D Technology in the Creation of Films Adapted from Literary Works
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The article studies the adaptation of literary works to animated films. Discuss the importance of the adaptation of literary works to the creation of animated films. A new method of using the Poly (polygonal geometric modeling) function of 3DSMAX 3D graphics software in the production of film and television physical special effects models is described. We analyzed the needs of platform development in detail, planned various functional modules, worked out the development process of virtual movie computer three-dimensional animation special effects model, and then through comparison, we chose 3Dmax, Unity3D and other related software to develop the entire system. Finally, the article analyzes and compares the impact of depth map preprocessing under different filtering algorithms on the view quality of literary works adapted from movies, and three fast algorithms in inter-frame motion estimation.

articleTitle: Computer Information Technology and Network Security Analysis of Intelligent Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Intelligent image recognition is one of the key research fields in the field of computer information, image recognition mainly includes feature extraction and classification recognition, among which feature extraction is the deficiency of the development of image recognition technology, recognition performance is good. The application of image recognition to computer and network security can achieve better target feature extraction and higher classification accuracy, and further improve the accuracy of computer and network security identification. This paper presents a method to improve feature extraction scheme and image recognition pattern by using computational information technology. In future research work, we can also propose new feasible unsupervised steering schemes. The Mobile Net+SSD algorithm model tripled the literacy rate in the experiment. The whole testing process conforms to the expected results to improve the identification efficiency, and continuously improve and optimize the system to improve the stability of the system.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Fintech Information Sharing System and Credit Evaluation Method Based on Internet Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Under the background of technology information sharing problems increasing more and more, and financial technology promoting the traditional financial industry, the society needs to speed up the construction of financial technology information sharing credit evaluation system, strengthen the supervision of internet platform and financial technology enterprises, and effectively avoid more risks. Starting from the concept of internet platform and information technology, this paper discusses the current situation of financial science and technology information sharing based on internet platform, puts forward corresponding solutions to the existing problems, and the construction method of financial science and technology information sharing platform and the optimization and adjustment of credit evaluation method.

articleTitle: Application of Wind Power Generation Technology in Ships
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As a means of transportation, ships play an important role in passenger transportation, freight transportation and other transportation. At the same time, the use of ships can also help us better find marine resources, and play an important role in our use of marine resources and research on marine ecology. In the process of navigation, what ships need most in the vast sea is sufficient electricity. In order to ensure the long-term power supply of ships, mankind has thought of many ways. At present, the most commonly used is wind power generation technology. Through the introduction and research of wind power generation technology, this paper describes the working principle and system parameters of wind power generation in detail, in order to help people better understand the application of wind power generation technology in ships.

articleTitle: Integration Project Based on Computer Information Technology Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Deepening project management research will better promote the development and improvement of project risk management theory and the computer system integration of the entire project management theory, and accelerate the development of scientific and refined computer system project management integration in my country. The purpose of this article is to analyze the task of integrating management systems based on computer information technology. Based on the research project of M company's computer information management system integration, the risk factors in the project implementation process were carefully evaluated and analyzed. Based on the theory of project risk management, combined with project risk characteristics and characteristics and key points, the Borda classification method and risk table method are used for quantitative risk analysis. The results show that among the seven risk factors, the required risk factors receive the most attention It is the risk factor that changes the scope of the project, and it is also the most difficult risk factor to solve in project risk management.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Trajectory Planning Algorithm Based on Improved Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: New intelligent industrial robots require the ability to move reliably in restricted spaces with obstacles or work pieces, whether in welding, assembly or grinding operations. In this paper, a kinematic model of the robot is developed using the standard D-H method and the principle of linkage velocity transfer control is described, followed by a smooth trajectory path algorithm for the robot based on kinematic constraints. The improved genetic algorithm reorders the path points, which can effectively re-generate a feasible path for the path points with mixed directional constraints.

articleTitle: Research on Augmented Reality Technology in the Training of Pre-flight Safety Inspect Process
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Traditional pre-flight safety training mainly relies on paper manuals or manual teaching, which is inefficient and of low quality, cannot meet the current trend of urgent introducing aircraft inspection personnel. In the inspect process, there is no real-time information support and guidance, and the difficult problems on the site cannot be solved in time, resulting in low inspect efficiency, but also easy to induce technical errors caused by human factors, such as the inspect personnel carelessly missed a certain step during the inspection process, that will result in many adverse consequences. Based on the current situation of civil aviation inspection industry, the pre-flight inspect process work is complexity, training technicians to efficiently perform new skills is challenging. fortunately, training of this type can be supported by Augmented Reality, a powerful industrial training technology that directly links instructions on how to perform the service tasks to the aircraft components that require processing. Meanwhile, because of the increasing complexity of inspection tasks, it is not sufficient to train the technicians in task execution. It is not sufficient to train the technicians in task execution. an effective solution with the help of visualization technology is proposed. It is mainly to digitize paper manual materials into text information, pictures, videos, 3D models and other multimedia means, combined with human computer interaction development, efficient inspection training services and real-time reliable inspection guidance services. Based on Unity 3D engine and with the help of Microsoft Hololens2, the augmented reality aircraft per-flight inspection training system pursues high-precision process guidance.

articleTitle: Research on Retention Evaluation Method of Floating Gate Memory Used in Aerospace
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: For its data retention character after power off, floating gate memory has widely used in space mission, which requires long service life, and less endurance cycles. Meanwhile, floating gate memory is usually used for main program or data storage. Therefore the data retention directly affects the operation reliability of the spacecraft on orbit. An evaluation method of floating gate memory retention capability is proposed in this paper, basing on the research of data retention mechanism and analysis of relevant standards. This method could be used for evaluating or qualifying the retention of floating gate memory used in space.

articleTitle: Regression Analysis Model Based on Data Processing and MATLAB Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Regression analysis is a method to analyze the relationship between a dependent variable and an independent variable. Which is one of the most powerful tools for statistical data analysis. Through mining 14 groups of experimental data, this paper tries to use this method to build the model and calculate the model parameters. Then the significance test is carried out on the analysis results by MATLAB numerical simulation, so as to obtain the regression equation of ethanol conversion rate and C4 olefins selectivity with temperature under each experiment, and obtain good fitting results. Firstly, line graph of ethanol conversion and C4 olefins selectivity with temperature are drawn by MATLAB for each catalyst combination. Then, all catalyst combinations are divided into two situations: when the linear relationship is obvious, a linear regression model is established. When the linear relationship is not obvious, it’s necessary to fit the curve, and found that a quadratic curve model can be established after fitting.

articleTitle: The Design of Wearable Smart Products Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of my country’s economic level, people’s living standards have improved significantly, and wearable devices have gradually entered people’s sight. More and more people have begun to use wearable products such as smart watches and smart bracelets. In recent years, with the continuous development of big data technology, big data technology has also begun to be applied in the design of wearable smart products. This article analyzes and studies the design of wearable smart products. This article uses literature research, questionnaire surveys and other methods to study the design of wearable products based on big data research, and investigates what types and functions of wearable products are more popular with consumers. The survey results show that consumers know very little about the category of wearable design. About 50% of the people choose bracelets. This shows that the promotion of wearable products in bracelets is relatively good at the beginning. One reason is that its price is reasonably designed and can be accepted by most people. About 30% of people pay more attention to wearable products with healthy functions. This is also a modern trend. With the improvement of people’s quality of life, more people are choosing products that focus on health issues.

articleTitle: Antenna Selection Technology Research in Massive MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The future fifth generation (5G) mobile communication network system will serve home applications other than personal terminal devices such as mobile phones and wearable devices, for instance, smart home, augmented reality, virtual reality, mobile cloud office, and even various industrial service applications, such as telemedicine, automatic traffic driving, smart agriculture, industrial automation and so on. As 5G communication frequency band is gradually determined in various countries, antenna design for 5G communication frequency band is becoming very hot. However, massive multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO), as one of the critical candidate technologies of 5G, has deployed a huge number of antennas, which can effectively enhance channel capacity and anti-interference ability. This paper concentrates on two kinds of antenna selection techniques: optimal antenna selection technique and antenna selection technique with reduced complexity, and compare and analyze their channel capacity.

articleTitle: Ship target detection based on adverse meteorological conditions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: ship target detection is significant for the marine economy and safe driving of marine autonomous systems. However, recent ship target detection is hardly suitable to adverse meteorological conditions. Different weather conditions will disturb the clarity of taken pictures and hurt the performance of the ship detection. Consequently, accurately classifying and locating the ship target is a big challenge. To address the problems, we propose a ship detection system that contains an adaptive weather classification algorithm, adaptive enhancement algorithm, and RetinaNet. Specifically, we construct a classification network for distinguishing fog, low illumination, and clear pictures. Then, the adaptive enhancement algorithm is proposed to eliminate meteorological interference and restore clear pictures. Finally, the RetinaNet network is used to detect the ship targets with fine processed pictures. Extensive experiments show that our ship system consistently exceeds the strong baseline and improves the performance for ship detection based on adverse meteorological conditions.

articleTitle: Weighted Semi-supervised MRI Segmentation with Paired Consistency and Entropy Minimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: U-net is very popular in medical image segmentation. However, the labels of training sets are always lacking for supervised learning. Thus, semi-supervised learning which utilizes unlabeled data shows advantages when dealing with such label-scarce situations. In this paper, we utilize U-net to tackle the challenge of segmenting MR images in semi-supervised setting. Specifically, we introduce paired consistency (PC) as data augmentation method. Also, we propose an entropy minimization (EM) term which is flexible and easy for calculation to boost the semi-supervised learning. Specifically, experiments show that our semi-supervised framework with PC and EM outperforms supervised U-net by %0.3 and %0.5 on OASIS and Hammers datasets, respectively. Also, entropy minimization accelerates the convergence of training, namely, reducing nearly %50 of training time, which is beneficial to real-world application.

articleTitle: Multi-dictionary learning with superpixel-based clustering for SAR Image despeckling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, a despeckling method is proposed to reduce the speckle noise from synthetic aperture radar images, which is based on the sparse model. First, we use logarithmic function to transform speckle noise to additive noise in order to simple the despeckling process, while the image is transformed to logarithmic domain. Then, simple linear iterative clustering, which has the merits of quick computation speed and high accuracy among superpixel algorithms, is employed to segment the log-intensity image. Considering the difference of texture and edge, the transformed image is distinguished into different regions by using fuzzy c-means to analyze superpixels. Final, the output image is obtained by multi-dictionary learning, which homogeneous regions of original image are represented by corresponding dictionary. From simulated and actual experiments, the proposed method can provide the better performance than other competing methods.

articleTitle: A compact dual frequency absorber based on frequency selective surface
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This article proposes a compact dual-band frequency selective surface absorber with dual frequency suppression features, the pattern of one cycle of the frequency selective surface is similar to that of "S". The parameters of the surface element are described in detail, and The transmission properties of the surface components were investigated using the equivalent circuit method. The proposed design also tests the stable response of incidence angle variations to TE/TM polarisation patterns.. The simulation results and the measured results are verified again by experiments. Finally, a novel frequency selective surface element structure is provided, which can be effectively applied to antenna stealth.

articleTitle: InfoPCT: Mutual Information Maximization based Point Cloud Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Point cloud transformer is a hot topic in the field of point cloud understanding. Some existing studies have explored the possibility of the combination of point cloud deep learning and transformer models, with the outstanding results. However, in specific tasks, such as point cloud classification and segmentation tasks, there is still room for improvement in accuracy. Motivated to improve the capture of semantic and discriminative features of point clouds by transformer, we propose a novel point cloud transformer-InfoPCT, which combines the self-attention mechanism and mutual information maximization that facilities deep learning on point clouds. Moreover, a mutual information maximization-based loss function is employed, so that the point cloud transformer can be trained simultaneously with the mutual information maximization module without pre-training. Compared with both CNN-based and transformer-based existing works, our superior results indicate the efficacy of InfoPCT.

articleTitle: MLE Based Rotor Angle Stability Assessment of Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Fast and accurate rotor angle stability assessment is of great significance for the safety of the power system. This paper presents a novel online rotor angle stability assessment approach for the power system based on Maximum Lyapunov Exponent (MLE). First, the Jacobian algorithm on the basis of QR decomposition is deduced to accurately calculate the MLE of multi-machine power system without using the rotor angle information. Next, the mapping relationship between phase trajectory motion trend and MLE curve is established, and stability criteria on the basis of MLE are proposed to determine the rotor angle stability of the disturbed power system. At last, the IEEE 39-bus power system is employed as test power system to validate the effectiveness and robustness and of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Security Transmission Design Based on Concatenated LT and LDPC Codes
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of security transmission in the space-terrestrial integrated networks, this paper proposes a physical layer secure transmission architecture based on concatenated LT and LDPC Codes. The outer code LT code adopts real-time random sampling coding, which can form a complex random interconnection structure and fully expand the randomness. The inner code LDPC code generates different codes through the random change of cyclic shift vector, Reduce the node interconnection deterioration caused by randomization on soft decision decoding, and obtain weak randomness high-performance error correction coding through storage optimized high-performance check matrix combined with soft decision decoding. The analysis and simulation results show that the proposed security transmission method not only improves the security of transmission, but also maintains the high transmission efficiency. Therefore it can be applied to the field of secure communication.

articleTitle: Construction of Intelligent Student Management Information System Platform Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the wide application of big data technology, various management information systems in colleges and universities have accumulated a large amount of data. The use of data mining technology in teaching and management can make full use of these data and effectively improve teaching to a certain extent. The purpose of this paper is to study the construction of an intelligent student management information system platform based on big data analysis. This paper documents the construction and performance of a student management system, an example of data collection according to the data mining process. The platform interface will be seen by teachers, students and teaching supervisors in a friendly way, providing humanized services for different groups of people. In this paper, data mining technology is applied to the student achievement information management system to assist and support management decision-making. Through the use of clustering, association rules and other data mining techniques to sort out and analyze the student achievement information. The experimental study shows that the use of the intelligent student management information system platform based on big data analysis to analyze the students' performance, it is found that the average score of more than half of the students in the public courses is lower than 70 points, which will greatly affect the later professional courses.

articleTitle: Design of Online Reading System Based on Human-Computer Interaction Information Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Information technology has the functions of visual presentation, scene blending, human-computer interaction, and information fusion. It integrates various forms of information resources such as video, audio, pictures and text, so as to integrate them into the organic whole, and better serve Chinese teachers and students provide services to bring students fresh learning experience. Aiming at the limitations of the alternative and fast-food reading modes of traditional primary school Chinese reading teaching, the online reading system is constructed based on modern information technology to provide students with expanded reading and answer-based reading. In actual teaching, it is also necessary to use information technology to create situations to stimulate students' interest in reading; use information technology to import extracurricular resources to enrich teaching materials; extend the classroom based on information technology and broaden students' horizons.

articleTitle: Research on the Modular System of Tourism Practice Course Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: “Research on the application of professional interactive teaching platform for tour guides based on virtual reality technology (VR)” is based on 3D real scene technology, combined with today’s advanced image simulation display technology, splicing image edge fusion technology, automatic tracking recording and broadcasting technology, computer A special solution for simulated tour guide teaching and training developed by network and multimedia technology. The article describes the interactive module, audio-visual system and interactive interface (UI) design method of the tour guide training platform in the human-computer interaction design process, as well as the three-dimensional modeling, UV coordinate and texture drawing, and three-dimensional scene used in the interactive realization process. Key technologies such as roaming, multimedia embedding and camera animation.
