articleTitle: Accounting Cyber Security Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of digital economic life, cyber threats are increasing. The accounting system is the majority of enterprises in the economic process of the participants, and cyber security is the primary guarantee of accounting information security. Accounting processes are getting more complex so that computer communications technology is improving and cyber threats are rising. Accounting is required as the foundation of enterprise cyber security. The external cyber threat is to steal accounting data, especially commercial confidential data. The internal cyber threat is to whitewash accounting statements maliciously to obtain improper interests. This study focuses on accounting cyber security and links the use of blockchain to accounting cyber security issues. The research is based on the combined analysis of block chain and accounting cyber security. The main results are: proposed the advantages of blockchain to construct the accounting cyber security system, proposed a feasible solution to secure data of accounting. which contributes to the application of blockchain in the accounting field.

articleTitle: Distributed architecture design of big data platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper designs a big data platform based on Hadoop (HDFS, MapReduce) and hive. The platform is built on VMware/openstack cloud platform. Firstly, multiple virtual machines are created on the cloud platform(A virtual machine is equivalent to an instance node of big data,instance node), Then deploy Hadoop distributed storage system on the virtual machine (Hadoop Distributed File System)And distributed computing system (MapReduce and spark real-time computing framework), and deployed the query analysis platform of hive data warehouse based on Hadoop. At the same time, we conducted a case study of Internet search and social data analysis based on the big data platform. The experimental results show that in terms of Internet big data loading, mapping, query and statistical analysis, the big data platform cluster built by multiple machines has higher processing efficiency and throughput than a single machine.

articleTitle: Positioning of Basketball Robot Target Recognition System Based on Data Mining Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Robot basketball is an emerging cross-discipline, involving robotics, intelligent control and image processing, computer vision and other fields, but as the amount of data collected by the system increases sharply, this information comes from different times and uses different expressions As the amount of information continues to increase, its effectiveness is limited. The purpose of this article is to study the positioning of the basketball robot’s target recognition system based on data mining algorithms. Based on the research of data mining, support vector machines and related technologies, this paper establishes an SVM method to realize basketball robot target recognition. Experimental research shows that, according to the measurement accuracy characteristics of the binocular vision system, when the object distance L=500mm~600mm is used, the relative error of the measurement is small and the system accuracy is high.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection Based on Gradient Direction Histogram
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the field of intelligent video surveillance, in order to realize the real-time detection of moving pedestrians in surveillance video, this paper introduces a method to realize pedestrian detection by using the gradient histogram (HOG) feature of image and support vector machine (SVM). In this method, the local gradient histogram of positive and negative sample images is extracted, and the support vector machine is used for sample training to obtain the pedestrian classifier. Finally, the trained classifier is used for pedestrian detection. Experimental results show that this method can effectively detect moving pedestrians in surveillance video, and has good detection effect.

articleTitle: An Image Denoising and Enhancement Approach for Dynamic Low-light Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Image enhancement technology can greatly improve the visual recognition accuracy of robots in low-light environments. In the past few years, there have been several effective low light enhancement algorithms. However, a supervised deep-learning algorithm requires paired data, which is difficult to collect in dynamic scenes. Meanwhile, there are problems of color distortion and noise amplification in the enhanced image. In this paper, we train an effective image denoise and enhancement model. Furthermore, our method only uses low-light images as training data without ground truth to solve the difficulty of data collection. Extensive experiments on a variety of benchmarks have demonstrated that proposed model is qualitatively and quantitatively better than state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Information Price Intelligent Prediction Model of Major Equipment in Power Grid Projects Based on the SSA-LSSVM Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: At present, the estimation for the next period information prices of equipment and materials of the power grid projects are based on those prices collected from the bid prices of equipment and materials which have been tendered recently. The source is real and reliable, but those prices are not the market prices due to time lag. During this period, if bulk raw material prices rise and fall sharply, using those prices gathered from the previous period to guide the information prices at this stage, would result in a large exceed or surplus of the project costs between two phases. That is not conducive to the control of the project costs. It is particularly important to pay close attention to the timeliness of the equipment and material prices, because of their large proportion of the project costs. In this paper, the Salp Swarm Algorithm (SSA)-the Least Squares Support Vector Machine (LSSVM) prediction model is used. On the one hand, SSA can improve the prediction accuracy of LSSVM. On the other hand, it can introduce multiple factors such as the production costs, the market environment and the policy environment to forecast the information prices and solve complex nonlinear problems. Ultimately, the prediction accuracy of the information prices can be improved and the price trends can be predicted in advance, which solve the defects of the statistical information prices from the big data sample. The empirical result shows that the SSA-LSSVM model has good applicability and practical value.

Author Keywords: the Least Squares Support Vector Machine

articleTitle: Research on The Identification of Benign and Malignant Thyroid Nodule Ultrasound Images Based on Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The incidence of thyroid cancer has been on the rise in recent years and early diagnosis of thyroid nodules can effectively reduce the mortality rate of thyroid cancer. In the field of medical imaging of the thyroid gland ultrasound testing is the preferred option with low harm to the body. Clinically, the manual diagnosis of benign and malignant thyroid nodules is closely related to the clinical experience of the physician. With the continuous development of artificial intelligence technology, deep learning has made tremendous progress in ultrasound map detection. Based on the ultrasound image, we can build a detection model to detect the location of thyroid nodules and classify them as benign or malignant. It can assist doctors in intelligent diagnosis. In this paper, based on the acquisition of thyroid nodules ultrasonogram. Firstly, the image data are preprocessed, and secondly, the YOLOv5 algorithm is improved by adding the SENet attention module to the convolutional layer, while replacing the SiLU activation function with FReLU, and improving the PANet feature fusion network by adding a jump connection, and the new deep learning model constructed can achieve more accurate benign and malignant recognition.

articleTitle: Application of RFID Information Technology in Logistics Warehouse Management
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to give full play to the advantages of RFID technology and improve the quality of logistics warehousing management, this paper studies the application of RFID technology in logistics warehousing. Firstly, RFID technology is studied, and the principle, advantages and application fields of RFID technology are pointed out. Then, it expounds the specific application of RFID technology in enter-warehouse management, in-warehouse management, out-of-warehouse management, transfer and stock transfer, inventory check.

articleTitle: Visualization of images of theoretical physics problems and research assistance supported by Maple
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: It is a research direction of educational technology that advanced computer language can be used to promote the modernization of physics teaching. Theoretical physics is characterized by abstract concepts, difficult to understand physical images and complex formula derivation, which makes students feel difficult in learning theoretical physics. Among the more popular scientific computing languages, Maple language has unique advantages in the modern application of theoretical physics teaching, including powerful symbolic computing function, intuitive language, a variety of built-in commands and functions, and solving general mathematical problems without complex programming. Taking two typical theoretical physics problems as examples, this paper demonstrates the application of Maple language in theoretical physics teaching techniques. These teaching techniques enable students to intuitively understand physical images. It uses powerful scientific computing functions to make it easier for college students to participate in research training or solve engineering problems.

articleTitle: Intelligent Vehicle Trajectory Tracking and Identification Technology Based on Multi-Fitness Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Track control is an important technology of intelligent vehicle control. The purpose of track control system is to make it possible by controlling the speed and direction of the vehicle under the premise of satisfying certain comfort, safety and stability. The purpose of this paper is to study the intelligent vehicle trajectory tracking (IVTT) and recognition technology based on multi-fitness genetic algorithm (GA). This paper analyzes the GA and the characteristics of the GA, and analyzes the vehicle model and the experimental simulation design, and draws the experimental results. The empirical analysis results show that the multi-fitness GA uses rolling, optimization and feedback correction, and the solution results are used for intelligent car control, with good real-time performance. The algorithm is verified by hardware-in-the-loop simulation test, which shows that the algorithm has good performance, has stable and accurate tracking ability for the tracked trajectory, and has sufficient real-time performance. After adopting the multi-fitness GA, the performance of the traditional IVTT and identification technology has been greatly improved, and we conducted a questionnaire and found that more than 88% of the people felt that the design of the IVTT and identification technology used multi-adaptability GA, found that the design efficiency has become high.

articleTitle: Implementation of Hotel Intelligent Management System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid economic development, the hotel industry is rising rapidly. The traditional hotel management system(MS) is designed with financial management as the central idea, which cannot meet the requirements of comprehensive hotel information management. If hotel companies want to survive in the fierce market competition, they must design an intelligent MS to improve their management level and reduce operating costs. Based on the background of the information age, this paper uses big data technology and computer network technology to design a MS suitable for hotels. The structure and function of the system are tested. It is found that the system is suitable for hotel reservation management, customer basic information statistics and other modules. It can realize automation and intelligence, and provide customers with efficient and fast hotel services.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Coordinated Optimal Scheduling of Virtual Power Plants Based on Demand Side Response
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The large-scale access of distributed new energy sources and the large number of grid connections of diversified flexible resources on the user side make the power system facing unprecedented tests. In order to ensure the safety, stability and economic and efficient operation of the power grid, various flexible resources need to be optimally scheduled and coordinated. In this paper, a multi-objective coordinated optimal scheduling method for virtual power plants based on demand side response is proposed, which aims to solve the dual uncertainty of source and load and realize the unified scheduling of source and load resources in a wide area. Firstly, the energy storage system, the flexible load, the electric vehicle and the distributed new energy are aggregated into a virtual power plant, and the virtual power plant as a whole participates in the unified scheduling of the power grid. Then, a multi-objective optimal scheduling model considering the peak load regulation capacity, operation cost and compensation revenue of users is established. Based on the model, the operation mode of various resources is optimized, and the power grid peak shaving capacity and new energy consumption capacity are greatly improved. An actual system in a certain area is used for testing, and the test results of an example verify the correctness and effectiveness of the model and method in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on Text and Community Marketing of Little Red Book UGC Platform under Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The Little Red Book has harvested a large number of users because of UGC attributes and soft-text marketing strategies. In order to explore the Little Red Book UGC community and traditional online community differences and advantages, as well as the Little Red Book app soft-text marketing and community marketing characteristics. The simple model method is used to compare and analyze it, and the content analysis is carried out based on the soft-text marketing theory of "equilibrium hardness". This method conducts overall observation from the perspective of local language and consumer psychology. In addition, the sentiment analysis model based on natural language processing acts on the huge online comment content of the community, transforming the abstract text content into data that is convenient for quantitative analysis. It is concluded that the Little Red Book app has carried out in-depth exploration and innovative development of the ugh model. Based on soft text marketing and community marketing, Little Red Book actively explores new channels for paying communities and sales transformation.

articleTitle: Human Resource Database Management Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the current Internet development environment, database technology came into being and has been applied quickly and efficiently. This paper provides a design method to help organization management based on the principle of Apriori algorithm. Firstly, the system extracts association rules and task models from the data structure, and then generates a decision table by reasonably allocating user information, analyzing and processing it, so as to realize the effective classification of massive large files. Finally, the database connection function is completed in combination with the transaction diagram and specific use cases, and finally an efficient and reliable human resources database is formed. At the same time, the performance of the database is tested. This experiment tests their load capacity, running capacity and resource utilization from five modules. As can be seen from the figure, the performance of these five modules meets the system operation requirements.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Simulation Virtual Reality Simulation Technology in the Statistical Analysis of Urban Building Communities
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The sustainable development of urban building communities in China needs the support of new concepts and integrated technologies such as virtual geographic environment. Based on the related theories and technical methods of virtual geographic environment, this paper proposes a multi-disciplinary cross-discipline such as planning and design, surveying and mapping geographic information, geotechnical engineering, ecological protection; planning designers, GIS analysts, government departments, project owners, the public and other roles participate; multi-link integration of urban building community statistics. Experiments show that this method can create different types of virtual scenes of three-dimensional architectural spaces such as residences, public buildings, gardens and landscapes, and has better real-time performance and better user experience.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Image Processing and Information Extraction Technology Research in Geological Recognition Application
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Application of hyperspectral remote sensing technology in geological identification has highlighted its advantages, but the identification accuracy of metal mineral cations is limited. In this paper, the dominant spectrum of domestic HJ-1A data and Hyperion data are used for collaborative processing, realize multi-source hyperspectral image fusion and information extraction and recognition, mapping of mineral alteration information in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau. The adopted method improves the identification accuracy of metal mineral cations in the visible light and near-infrared range. After comparative verification analysis and statistical evaluation of results, it is confirmed that this method has important application value for the identification of metal mineral cations in complex geological environment.

articleTitle: Study on Lightning Thermal Damage Characteristics of ZnO Varistor under Operating Duty
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of thermal collapse and fire burning of ZnO varistors in power system applications often caused by lightning, the experimental study on thermal damage characteristics of ZnO varistors under multi-pulse lightning operating duty was carried out, and the thermal damage characteristics and damage mechanism of ZnO varistors under multi-pulse were analyzed from two aspects including failure mode and temperature rise characteristics. The research shows that: during the multi-pulse lightning impulse, the heat lost by ZnO varistors is far less than the heat injected by multi-pulses, and the huge energy exerted by successive pulses causes disturbance. When the operating duty power frequency current is superimposed, the shock energy is absorbed and thermal damage is caused. Moreover, the temperature rise exceeds the allowable limit of ZnO varistors, which leads to the thermal balance out of control and finally results in fire and combustion. The research results are helpful to further reveal the lightning damage mechanism of ZnO varistors, and have important reference value for the research and development of multi-pulse surge protectors in power systems.

articleTitle: Ultrasonic phased array detection technology of porcelain bushing based on double crystal linear array
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Porcelain bushing is a part of important equipment in power transmission network. In this paper, ultrasonic phased array detection technology is discussed to solve the problem of internal defect detection of porcelain bushing. By studying the acoustic properties such as the propagation and attenuation law of ultrasonic waves in ceramic materials, this paper provides experimental data and basis for the design of special ultrasonic phased array transducer. The detection ability of the detection system is then verified through the positioning and defect detection experiments on the calibration test block and simulation test block based on the double crystal linear array probes. This simplifies the steps of original detection technology and provides a technological feasibility for overcoming the difficulties in in-service detection of the internal defects of porcelain bushing.

articleTitle: Design of Aeration Control System for Sewage Treatment Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's economy, water pollution has become a major issue that we have to face, especially how to deal with domestic sewage has become the top priority of our daily lives. Although traditional sewage treatment methods can solve the problem of water pollution to a certain extent, the effect is not as good as expected. However, domestic sewage treatment plants basically use the activated sludge sewage treatment process. This process is a dynamic system with multiple inputs and multiple outputs, which has strong coupling, uncertainty, nonlinearity and large hysteresis. And so on, and the modeling of this process is also quite difficult, it is easy to achieve the ideal control effect. Therefore, the in-depth study of the control measures of the aeration system has important historical, practical significance and broad application prospects for its application in the field of sewage treatment. The main purpose of this article is to in-depth discuss the control method of the aeration system of the sewage treatment plant. Through a large number of referenced documents and analyze the operation status of the sewage treatment plant under actual conditions, at the same time, it solves the sewage treatment aeration system in a targeted manner. Technical difficulties such as intermittency, nonlinearity, large hysteresis and linear control variables in the control work are difficult to carry out online detection. The control parameters of each link in the aeration system have been determined, and the simulation simulation of each link of the aeration system has been established. The practice and application of the fuzzy control technology of the air system in the aeration system of the sewage treatment plant and the realization of the fuzzy control strategy on the plc. The experimental research results show that the established inverse control system of dissolved ozone lssvm has good dynamic traceability, high precision, fast speed, good anti-interference ability and good robust characteristics. This kind of dissolved oxygen intelligent control system can realize the stability of the effluent water quality under the restrictive conditions of ensuring that the effluent index is reached, effectively realize the optimization of the aeration energy-saving technology, and reduce the operating cost.

articleTitle: Cost-oriented Information Construction for Enterprise Based on ERP System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the context of the information age, cost control has received extensive attention from enterprises in the whole society, which is related to the competitiveness and sustainable development ability of enterprises in related fields. To further account and control the cost of the enterprise, the ERP system is introduced as an enterprise management tool in the enterprise management process. However, the current research on the ERP system still has structural and application deficiencies. This paper first sorts out the theoretical basis of the ERP system and completes the research content by defining the concepts of cost accounting and cost control informatization. On this basis, an enterprise information cost control system based on the ERP system was established, and the information flow, enterprise logistics, value flow, cost accounting procedures, etc. integrated in view of ERP system were optimized, and get analyzed and summarized in the perspective of system program operation.

articleTitle: A Trusted Energy Data Sharing System Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Sharing the statistic results of energy data on the blockchain has huge practical significance. However, the ability to store and analysis large data set is limited by the throughput of the blockchain. Introducing a data center as a third party to do the statistical task brings new issues of trust. In this paper, we put forward three different solutions to guarantee on-chain statistic availability, according to different scenarios. All our solution has on-chain time complexity sublinear to the number of pieces of data, which supports large size data set. Data availability are guaranteed by cryptographic techniques with high security level.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of OPC UA Standard and Test
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: OPC UA has been widely applied in the interconnection and interoperability of industrial Internet and intelligent manufacturing, the standards are the criterion of OPC UA technology, the address space is the basis for realizing OPC UA, the information model is the core feature of OPC UA. The quality of developed products must be ensured after passing the test and certification. The key Technologies of OPC UA which showing in this papers will guide development and application of OPC UA.

articleTitle: Electrical Automation Control System Based on Brovey Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The development of industrial enterprises can drive the rapid development of the country’s social economy, and industrial enterprises want to stably and quickly improve the quality and speed of production, they are inseparable from the innovation and application of science and technology. Production efficiency in industrial manufacturing is extremely important, which requires a high-performance electrical automation control system to assist industrial production. Therefore, this paper studies the electrical automation control system based on Brovey algorithm, the purpose is to design an efficient and stable electrical automation control system for industrial production. At the beginning, the related content of Brovey algorithm and the acquisition of hyperspectral image data of mechanical equipment based on Brovey algorithm were introduced, and the characteristics of electrical automation technology and its main functions were analyzed. In the establishment of the model, the information fed back by the band data is used to collect the data, and the corresponding simulation and no-load test are done to test the operation effect. The final experiment found that the trough overshoot in the automatic control system based on the Brovey algorithm was 3.81%, and the maximum time lag in the cycle was 1.92%. Meet the requirements of electrical automation control system for overshoot attenuation and time lag.

articleTitle: Application of solar energy in ship power field
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the level of social and economic development and the rapid development of navigation in China, relevant academic circles pay more and more attention to the impact of ship shipping exhaust on air pollution. In the context of social development in the new era, in order to effectively carry out the development mode of green shipping and achieve the vision of energy conservation, emission reduction and environmental protection, the state not only invested a lot of human, material and financial resources, but also gave relevant policy support from multiple angles to carry out green and efficient shipping. In view of this, based on the principle of solar energy utilization, this paper mainly expounds the application of solar energy in ship power utilization.

articleTitle: Intelligent Algorithms of English Semantic Analysis Based on Deep Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The grammatical relationship between words often plays an important role in word understanding and word processing, and is widely used in fields such as information retrieval, word processing, dictionaries, and understanding construction. This article aims to study an intelligent algorithm for English translation analysis based on deep learning technology. It highlights the research background and the importance of semantic analysis, and explains the research status. To show the relevant science and technology used, the word checking algorithm studied in this article uses the two word embedding methods to process the data in the training corpus. Then it will be used as the input of the long and short-term memory neural network. Finally, the algorithm is realized by training the neural network to obtain the language model. The trained language model is used to predict the output of the word at a specific location and compare it with the original word and feed it back to the user. In this paper, the average F-value of the semantic analysis of English composition under 5 themes is 95.00%.

articleTitle: Intelligent skin detection system based on multimodal depth learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Skin detection technology is an important branch in the field of image recognition, and has been widely used in the field of computer vision. It has great potential and good application prospects.Malignant melanoma is a kind of skin cancer with high mortality rate. Its incidence rate is increasing year by year, and has the characteristics of fast metastasis and poor prognosis. Early diagnosis and clinical intervention are the most effective methods for prognosis and mortality reduction. However, because the number of doctors with melanoma detection ability is difficult to match the incidence rate, and the detection and diagnosis of tumor by naked eye are subjective, the reproducibility of the diagnosis is not ideal. At present, melanoma detection technology based on dermoscopic image is an effective way to solve these problems, but the complexity of dermoscopic image itself, such as blurred lesion boundary, intra group variation and inter group similarity, poses a great technical challenge to melanoma detection. Based on these problems, this paper designs a deep learning technology using convolutional neural network, which can automatically learn hierarchical features from data, avoid complex manual extraction, and show advanced results in the field of natural image and medical image analysis.The system adopts multi-modal deep learning. The image information collected by the image sensor is combined with metadata such as user age and skin past medical history for multi-modal feature fusion and collaborative learning. Then, the detection results of freckle and melanoma in the skin are obtained through full convolution neural network and deep convolution neural network. In this paper, a region segmentation model of melanoma lesions based on full convolution neural network is proposed, and a series of effective training strategies are proposed accordingly.It has great use value and research value

articleTitle: Intelligent Positioning Boots for Miners' Fall Monitoring Based on ZigBee Communication Protocol and ADXL345 Acceleration Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Currently, China's mining personnel positioning system is obviously lacking and will be gradually replaced by ZigBee or ultra-wideband technology in the future. Therefore, this paper starts from the existing problems, taking boots as the carrier, applying ZigBee communication protocol and ADXL345 acceleration sensor, and is committed to solving the current technical difficulties and monitoring the occurrence of miners' falls. As a result, it would be helpful in the subsequent search for the miners who have already fallen. This paper proposes an intelligent positioning boot for monitoring miners' fall based on ZigBee communication protocol and ADXL345 acceleration sensor, supplemented by safety fence, ultra-long standby, track playback, and other functions. The acceleration sensor ADXL345 and the pressure sensor FSR402 can detect whether miners fall or not, and the ZigBee communication protocol, which obtains the location information and the fall alarm information, sends them to the monitoring center for better management. Through the function of a safety fence, it can prevent mine accidents and give a timely and effective search for the location of miners after the occurrence of the fall. The research results can upgrade the existing mine personnel positioning and emergency rescue systems. Therefore, it can promote the construction of the intelligent mine and meet the market and policy needs.

articleTitle: Research on Head and Shoulders Detection Algorithm in Complex Scene Based on YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: For subway stations and other places with dense traffic, the effect of pedestrian detection is easily affected by occlusion. At the same time, the head and shoulder detection has strong anti occlusion ability and low computational requirements. In view of the existing problems, this paper proposes a head and shoulder detection algorithm based on yolov5 in complex scenes, and designs and adds a deformable convolution network and attention mechanism module in the feature extraction network to improve the ability of feature extraction. The experiment is designed to train and test the pedestrian head and shoulder data set in the subway complex environment. The experimental results show that the accuracy of pedestrian head and shoulder detection for small target is improved in subway complex scene.

articleTitle: Spam Comment Recognition of E-commerce Products Based on Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, the way people express their opinions and communicate with each other has also changed. In the field of e-commerce product reviews, people increasingly prefer to post their opinions on products on shopping sites, and these user reviews contain a lot of useful information. At the same time, these views are full of useless and untrue spam, and the presence of such spam can affect the quality of product review mining. This paper aims to study a method for identifying spam reviews of e-commerce products based on collaborative filtering algorithm. This paper analyzes the definition of collaborative filtering algorithm, the advantages and disadvantages of collaborative filtering algorithm and the definition of spam in the field of product reviews, and also analyzes feature extraction methods and experimental dataset sources and obtained experimental results. The empirical analysis results show that there are various types of spam comments in e-commerce product reviews, and the existence of these spam comments affects people's important interests and affects the performance of automatic opinion mining systems. Therefore, analyzing and identifying spam comments is a very meaningful study. After adopting the collaborative filtering algorithm, the performance of the traditional e-commerce product spam comment identification method has been greatly improved, and we conducted a survey and found that more than 87% of people felt that the design of the e-commerce product spam comment identification method applied the collaborative filtering algorithm, and found that the design efficiency has become higher.

articleTitle: Research on the precise marketing method of agricultural products e-commerce platform based on user recommendation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of China's major agricultural products e-commerce platforms, a large amount of information about users and agricultural products has been generated, resulting in the phenomenon of "information overload", which makes it more and more difficult for users to browse the agricultural products they are interested in and to purchase the agricultural products that meet their needs in a timely and effective manner. Therefore, to address this situation, this paper further mines the consumer behavior and other information generated when consumers interact with e-commerce platforms, predicts users' interests and preferences by constructing dynamic user portraits of groups, and solves the problem of "information overload" through personalized recommendation systems. In this paper, we mainly study the user portrait and group dynamic user portrait, the personalized recommendation method for agricultural products and the system architecture design of agricultural products e-commerce platform. This paper meets the demand for such products in the market and lays a certain theoretical and practical foundation for the subsequent research and development.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Smart Cold Chain Logistics Simulation Model Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of people’s quality of life and tremendous changes in consumption concepts, people’s demand for fresh agricultural products is increasing, which has led to a huge gap in the supply of fresh agricultural products logistics. In recent years, frequent food quality and safety issues have attracted the attention of consumers and have been highly valued by the country, making enterprises deeply aware of the importance of the refrigeration supply chain. However, the traditional cold chain supply of agricultural products is far from being able to meet the strict quality requirements of food for consumers in terms of production, processing, storage, transportation and sales. Therefore, how to improve the efficiency of the product refrigeration supply chain, reduce logistics costs, and ensure product freshness and quality assurance has become the focus and difficulty of establishing a cold chain supply chain business. This article is based on the analysis and design of the intelligent cold chain logistics simulation model under the Internet of Things technology. Firstly, the literature research method is used to summarize the problems of the intelligent cold chain logistics under the Internet of Things technology and the advantages of the intelligent cold chain logistics under the Internet of Things technology. The feasibility of the intelligent cold chain logistics simulation model under the Internet of Things technology, and then through the analysis of the cold chain logistics process unit and organization, the modeling is carried out based on the analysis results.

articleTitle: Thermodynamic Simulation Analysis of TSV under Temperature Cycle
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The thermo mechanical reliability of TSV (Through Silicon Via) has become an important factor restricting the market-oriented application of TSV. The maximum stress-strain point of TSV in high temperature stage and low temperature stage is the same in a cycle; The stress-strain value of the metal bump between the chip and the chip is higher than that of the copper column in the chip. The results show that under the condition of temperature cycle, when the TSV height is changed, with the increase of TSV height, the maximum equivalent stress and strain of the chip first decrease and then increase in the high temperature stage, and gradually decrease in the low temperature stage.

articleTitle: Microgrid multi-energy system considering distributed energy storage and multi-scenario dynamic electricity price coordination run optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In view of the traditional time-of-use tariff can not meet the optimization needs of distribution network, this paper proposes a scheduling operation strategy considering the cooperative optimization of distributed energy storage and dynamic electricity price, and defines the dynamic electricity price in multiple scenarios. Based on the analysis of the different effects of distributed energy storage on the distribution network in the multi-energy system of micro-grid, a multi-objective function is constructed to minimize the loss and voltage deviationof distribution network. The results verify the efficiency of operation optimization strategy in improving energy utilization and power efficiency.

articleTitle: Research Progress on the Application of Machine Learning in Power System Security
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Machine learning is considered to be an emerging technology that can be widely used. The construction of power system has always been an important field of social livelihood security and development in China. In recent years, the application of machine learning in power system security has also made great progress in the environment of increasing attention to the research on the intersection and integration of machine learning and various disciplines. According to the latest progress, the application of machine learning in this field is mainly divided into hardware layer and software layer. The research on security guarantee of hardware layer mainly focuses on the prediction and evaluation of transient stability and load forecasting, while the research on software layer mainly focuses on network attack detection, and most of the research focuses on model and method innovation. Using machine learning to quickly evaluate and predict the operation state of power system, so as to realize in-depth analysis and facilitate the operation and maintenance personnel to make appropriate human intervention, which can represent the current research trend of machine learning in the field of power system security.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Abnormal Electricity Analysis and Electricity Stealing Site Evidence
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Adopt big data technology and pattern recognition technology to design and develop an abnormal electricity analysis and electricity theft on-site evidence collection device. Based on the analysis of marketing big data to realize the accurate positioning of users with abnormal electricity consumption, the use of machine vision and artificial intelligence algorithms to realize the intelligent recognition of component-level hardware changes, at the same time, the parameter pattern recognition technology is used to identify the parameter changes of the electric energy meter, and the development and development of portable on-site anti-theft electricity The proof device improves the efficiency and success rate of on-site anti-electricity theft. The on-site anti-electricity theft intelligent analysis device is the first to be piloted in the anti-electricity theft work of the power supply company and the power office to continuously improve the accuracy of the anti-electricity theft identification. At the same time, it can also support the electric power office's anti-electricity theft on-site proof work, which has a good prospect of promotion and application.

articleTitle: Optimization of FFT Algorithm Based on Target Location
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of the existing methods of acquiring fixed-range and fixed-velocity information for reconnaissance on the battlefield, a method that can improve precise positioning and speed-fixing is proposed, aiming to optimize the existing positioning and speed-fixing algorithm, using computational sparse fast Fourier transform (SFT) has long existed due to its high efficiency and wide practicability. The algorithm calculates the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) through its unique method. This article mainly uses the SFT algorithm of the aliasing filter. Transform the information in the time domain into the information processing method in the frequency domain, effectively integrate and classify the huge data, greatly reduce the amount of calculation, and then visualize and analyze the data through MATLAB simulation, which really effectively improves the positioning The accuracy of fixed speed provides a more reliable source of information and data support for command and decision-making.

articleTitle: Research on Differential Bus Dead Zone Protection of 4 Busbar Based on the New Six-Unification Standard
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the formation of UHV AC-DC hybrid power grid, the adaptability of conventional substation protection to the change of power grid characteristics needs to be improved. This paper detailedly demonstrates the double bus and double section TA dead zone fault bus protection cut-off time is too long that affects the safe and stable operation of the power grid, mainly explains the 220kV section and bus link dead zone protection action mode and dead zone protection action time limit based on the new six-unification relay protection provisions. It has strong practicability and high typicality

Author Keywords: double section connection with double bus

articleTitle: Multipath detection method based on CCRW-like technique for GNSS receivers
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Multipath detection and mitigation has always been paid great attention. In former research, CCRW (Code Correlation Reference Wave) is used for multipath mitigation. A multipath detection method based on CCRW-like technique is proposed in this paper. It’s performance is determined by the wave construct and it can be analised. This method only needs a separate correlation channel to get the detection metirc, which is easier to realize compared to other detection methods And the performance analization method is showed in this paper. This method is analysed based on the hypothesis that there is only one mulitpath, but it applies to scenrios of complex scenrios where there could be many multipath. The detection performance can be analyzed combined with the information of the variance of noise.

articleTitle: Design of Fuel Supply Control System for Automobile Dual Fuel Tanks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The dual fuel tank can not only meet the needs of long-distance, but also ensure the balance of the vehicle and reduce the fuel sloshing in the fuel tank. This paper presents a design of dual fuel tank oil supply control system for automobile. Firstly, the key components of dual fuel tank are designed and selected. Secondly, the single chip microcomputer module is introduced to intelligently switch the dual fuel tank oil supply, and connect the OBD module of the whole vehicle to better diagnose the fault of fuel tank system, which provides a theoretical basis for subsequent in-depth research and production.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis on Temperature Field and Electric Field of DC Cable
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Flexible HVDC transmission has the characteristics of flexible operating power range, simple power direction control, independent operation, and superior transmission performance. The synchronous operation stability does not limit its conveying capacity and conveying distance, and also avoids the influence due to low frequency oscillation. The systems with the same or different rated frequencies can be connected in parallel, so that they work according to their own voltage and frequency, do not need to run synchronously, and are not affected by the network, so if a fault occurs, it will not cause a large-scale power outage and reduce losses. Therefore, HVDC transmission has received increasing attention. In this paper, a coupled simulation of the main physical field—electric field and temperature field of the HVDC cable terminal is carried out, to explore the influence of temperature on the electric field distribution of the HVDC cable terminal, and to provide a basis for cable design and actual conditions.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of ‘Wet’ State Critical Speed of the Wet Submersible Motor Rotor System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The water friction generated by the viscosity of axial cooling water in wet submersible motor could affect the rotor dynamic characteristics, which is applied to rotor outer surface in a prestressed manner. We take an 850QS-3200 type wet submersible motor as the research object. In this work, the internal fluid flow is simulated based on the numerical simulation through ANSYS Fluent software. For studying the quantitative relationship the surface roughness of rotor outer surface, rotor speed and axial cooling water flow rate between stator and rotor. After this, the finite element method is used to get ‘wet’ state critical speed by loading the water friction on the rotor system. Then the quantitative relationship is compared and analyzed between the ‘wet’ and ‘dry’ state critical speed of rotor system. Results show that the rotor rotating speed has a great influence on the ‘wet’ state critical speed, but the water friction upon that is negligible. The simulation analysis is verified through vibration experiment. The results of this study would provide a theoretical basis for the improvement of the rotor system in wet submersible motor.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Target Detection Algorithm in the Field of Unmanned Driving
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on the rapid development of deep learning and the application of high-performance embedded devices, the fusion application of target detection algorithms based on deep convolutional neural networks in the field of unmanned driving is described. Through the research of two types of target detection algorithms based on candidate regions and regression, an example of the application process of YOLO (You Only Look Once) real-time target detection series algorithms for target detection on traffic roads is proposed. Vehicles can have better road sign recognition capabilities, providing the basis for vehicle unmanned behavior decision-making.

articleTitle: Design of Automation Systems in Industrial Production under Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Among all new generation of information technologies that are rapidly evolving, including mobile broadband internet, big data and cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI) technology has emerged as the highlight. As the world is at the critical juncture of transforming from a market-driven development model to an innovation driven one, this paper explores the function of AI in intelligent manufacturing, characteristics and edges of applying AI in industrial production and how AI can be applied to designing automation systems in industrial production with assistance of specific technologies. In other words, this paper discovers the connotation, characteristics and edges of applying AI to industrial production. It finds that industrial production is advancing towards “digitalization”, “networking” and “intelligence”. In this regard, application of AI in industrial production not only has technological basis like sensing technology and modeling technology, but also can optimize the design of automation systems in industrial production, creating a more productive intelligent manufacturing system.

articleTitle: Robot Intelligent Health Assessment Algorithm Based on Multi-sensor Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Intelligent robot is one of the important equipment in machining. After long-term processing and operation, the performance of its key components will gradually decline with the passage of time. At present, the degree of mechanical, electrical and hydraulic integration of the equipment is greatly improved, and the objectives of health status assessment are more complex. Using data fusion method to analyze the data of multi-source sensors is of great significance to robot health assessment. In order to design the robot health management system, this paper needs to analyze the possible faults of the health subsystem, discuss the concepts of decision-making level data fusion, data fusion and wireless sensor network communication technology, and analyze the research status of intelligent health assessment methods.

articleTitle: Study on Optimizing Configuration of Precise Functional Modules for UAV Products Based on Users' Personalized Needs under Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on optimization of the precise configuration of functional modules. Customers usually face difficulties in explaining their personalized requirements clearly as they are lack of professional knowledge. Under the environment of big data, this paper resolves this issue by analyzing the numerous real operating data in order to gain the authentic user needs which may not be discovered in customer investigation. By using fuzzy c-means clustering method to divide the users’ expected functions and performance, the classification of user’s personalized demand can be obtained. The weights of each category of users are then calculated. Finally, the appropriate functional modules that can meet the customer needs well can be acquired. An example of UVA product is also indicated in this paper to prove the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on Plasma Grating Electrode Structure Photoconductive Antenna Based on Extraordinary Optical Transmission
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The discovery of Extraordinary Optical Transmission (EOT) has greatly promoted the progress of surface plasmons from the aspects of theory and potential application. Terahertz plasma photoconductive antenna is based on the enhancement of surface electric field to achieve higher absorption of photons and stronger transmission field strength from medium to substrate material, thus achieving greater photocurrent and radiating high-power terahertz waves. In this paper, according to the strict solution of Maxwell equation, the photoconductive antenna with groove structure is simulated and analyzed, and the influence of groove depth, width and position on electric field intensity is also analyzed. The results show that the groove can effectively adjust the light wave, enhance the transmittance and local electric field.

articleTitle: Design of Highway Bridge Construction Technology Quality Monitoring System Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: the application of the latest information technologies such as information technology, remote sensing technology and Internet of things technology in the design of monitoring system for highway and bridge construction technology can prolong the time of monitoring road quality and expand its monitoring area. It has the advantages of wide coverage and many monitoring sizes and types. This paper discusses the way of using genetic algorithm to optimize the quality monitoring system of highway and bridge construction technology, and emphasizes that the quality monitoring and management of highway and bridge construction technology based on data center subsystem is the general trend in the field of quality monitoring. This paper first combs the relevant concepts, and then leads to the advantages that genetic algorithm can quickly perform the storage, processing and analysis of data operations, reduce the storage space, data processing and continuously generate a large number of highway and bridge construction technology quality inspection data. It can avoid the problems of poor query performance, low processing efficiency and premature feedback in the traditional bridge quality monitoring system. The paper then puts forward the suggestion of establishing a quality monitoring and early warning system based on genetic algorithm combined with the latest information technology, realizes the interaction between external data and genetic algorithm, and finally develops a network-based bridge construction quality monitoring and early warning platform to promote the construction of data real-time analysis, evaluation and early warning system, and improve the efficiency of bridge construction quality control and process management.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of College Students' Psychological Test System Based on Apriori Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Association rules reflect the interdependence and correlation between things, and are used to extract valuable correlations between data items from large amounts of data. The Apriori algorithm is a typical association rule algorithm that mines association rules through frequent item sets. Based on the Apriori algorithm, this paper is an effective means of implementing psychological health education and solving psychological health problems among university students by discovering the common problems of psychological health among university students through data mining and taking targeted measures. The core work of this paper is to design a psychological test process and a psychological test scaling for university students based on the Apriori algorithm, to support the development of a psychological test system for university students, to comprehensively address the psychological health problems of university students through psychological tests, and to help cultivate high quality talents.

articleTitle: A Convenient and Efficient Scene Shop Recognition Assistant Tool for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Obtaining information about outdoor scenes has always been a great difficulty for visually impaired people. One of the urgent needs is to obtain the name of all the stores in the scenes where the visually impaired people are when they want to go shopping in an unfamiliar environment without asking others. However, there are no mature assistant tools to help them get this information so far, which bring them great inconvenience. To address this problem, we employ the latest OCR technology and the most mature speech recognition technology to create a scene shop recognition application based on Android system which can recognize the name of all shops in front of the visually impaired conveniently and efficiently by just taking a picture with a mobile phone. With the assistance of this application, the travel experience of the visually impaired can be greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Network Fault Diagnosis Based on Fault Tree Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As the network grows in size and the complexity of the structure increases, a failure or abnormal performance can cause incalculable damage to service providers or users, and timely diagnosis and identification of faults is critical to reliable network operation. The theory of fault tree analysis ensures that dynamic systems are highly reliable by means of replacement techniques for spare parts, defect coverage techniques, fault repair techniques and redundancy techniques. This paper analyses the types of network fault, designs the workflow of fault tree analysis, illustrates the method of building fault trees, and studies the qualitative and quantitative fault tree analysis techniques. The fault diagnosis method based on fault tree analysis is applied to help network maintenance managers to find out the fault location with maximum probability and improve the efficiency of network fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Schematic Design of a Wireless Detection System for Structure Safety in Large Port Handling Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Port is one of the main nodes of modern logistics. The port crane and large port handling equipment are important production equipment in ports. it will seriously affect port cargo handling if failure occurs. In order to evaluate the safety test and problems of port crane structure, the online detection system of stress and strain for port cranes based on the wireless detection and BeeNet network protocol was constructed in this paper, there are features of simple layout, safety and reliability in comparison with the traditional wiring detection method, and there will be a broad application prospect in the field of health test of large port handling equipment in future.

articleTitle: Modeling and fault simulation of power generation unit in shipboard zonal distribution power system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To ensure the stable operation of the ship’s power system, the most effective and direct method is to ensure the stability of the ship’s power grid voltage and frequency. The excitation control system of the synchronous generator determines the voltage stability and reactive power output, and the prime mover speed control system determines the frequency stability and active power output. Based on Matlab/Simulink, this paper establishes a model of ship power generation unit and a shipboard zonal distribution power system. Finally, the common working conditions and faults in ships are simulated. The results show the validity of the model. Provides a basis for studying the control of power generation units and the faults of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Large Grid Risk Warning Assessment Prediction Based on LSTM Model and Apriori Algorithm for Dense Transmission Corridors
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Due to the lack of unified visualization early warning means, the current extreme natural disasters pose an increasingly serious threat to the safe operation and production of China's power grid, especially the safety of dense transmission channel operation. Based on this, this paper proposes a large grid risk early warning assessment method based on LSTM model and Apriori algorithm for dense transmission channels. Firstly, the LSTM model is constructed by selecting the disaster characteristic factors and typical extreme disaster technical elements based on the disaster characteristic information, and the risk warning data with time-series characteristics are fully mined and analyzed for state prediction; secondly, the association rules between the quantified disaster characteristic factors and risk technical elements are mined by Apriori algorithm to quantify the risk of grid safety operation considering external disasters and other information. Secondly, the Apriori algorithm is used to quantify the risk of grid safety operation considering external hazards and other information by mining the association rules between quantified hazard characteristic factors and risk technical elements, and to quickly realize the integrated and unified risk warning of large grid considering intensive transmission channel disasters. The results show that the accuracy of the improved model is improved, the model can converge faster, and it can better find the global optimal solution with good adaptability.

Author Keywords: LSTM long short-term memory neural network

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Big Data Crawling and Visualization System Based on COVID-19 Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on the Scrapy framework, the system crawls the open COVID-19 data with Python crawler technology, and then stores it in the MYSQL database after data cleaning. Django framework is used as the front-end interface and react environment is used as the front-end framework to build the front-end of epidemic data. The covid-19 web page adopts a combination of map and visual graphics. With the help of rich visualization graphics library and map elements in Ant Design technology, the epidemic data are displayed in a diversified way, and the visualization of the new crown pneumonia epidemic data is realized. It plays a vital role in improving the awareness of self-protection and preventing epidemic disease.

articleTitle: Noether-Li Symmetry and the Motion Constant of Kepler System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The study of symmetry and motion constant of dynamic systems is a very important concept in the field of natural science. The concept of symmetry is applied to general mechanics, and the research objects are mainly mechanical quantities and mechanical laws. It is also a development direction of analytical mechanics. In this paper, we first wrote the differential equations of motion of the Kepler system, some Noether-Li symmetry theorems and determinant equations for Kepler system were given and briefly proved. Then the theorem asserting that the Noethe-Li symmetry for the system leads to both the Noether motion constant and the Hojman motion constant were presented. Finally, the application of the results of this paper was illustrated by taking the plane kapler system as an example.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Internet Technology in the Management System of Student Borrowing and Reading in University Library
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The main direction of this paper is to carry out the education management of college students. Through the application of fingerprint recognition technology in the library student reader management system, the working principle and composition of the existing library student education management system are studied, and the proposed A more advanced student work management program. This paper designs a general interface between the fingerprint collection system and the existing library reader management system, so as to realize the seamless integration between the college students' loan management system. Experiments show that the management system realizes the library’s identity authentication function for college students' readers and the realization of the corresponding management work through the identification of readers' fingerprints.

articleTitle: Research of implementation of tower cable detection and maintenance technology and system based on magnetic leakage detection and ultrasonic pickling technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the gradual development and expansion of power grid, the daily maintenance and inspection of power grid is more and more important and frequent. Cable tower is very common in power grid. However, due to the influence of the environment, the cable of the tower needs to be maintained and replaced frequently. The traditional maintenance method of the cable mainly relies on manual replacement, which is low in efficiency, and the manual replacement is less efficient and more difficult in the harsh environment. In order to solve the above problems, this paper studies a tower cable detection and maintenance device based on magnetic leakage detection and ultrasonic pickling technology. The device can transmit the aging degree of the wire to the staff through a small camera, and then the staff control the machine to remove rust and maintain the wire. Thus, the cable life can be prolonged and the labor cost can be reduced.

articleTitle: The Application of Artificial Intelligence-based Fireworks Recognition Technology in Fire Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Fire has the characteristics of suddenness and randomness. It not only has a high probability of accidents, but also causes great damage to the environment. How to quickly and effectively implement fire-related alarm measures and significantly reduce fire-related losses has become an important part of fire prevention and research. Firework detection is one of the obvious physical characteristics that are easy to be inspected in the early stage of a major fire. Therefore, firework detection is an important subject with theoretical and practical value. This article mainly focuses on the actual application of artificial intelligence-based wireless pyrotechnic identification technology in fire detection. First, the literature research method is used to explain the pyrotechnic identification process and the fire process of the fire, and then the desired detection technology is introduced. Finally, the firework recognition experiment is mainly to compare the accuracy of artificial intelligence firework recognition technology. The experimental results show that the effect of pure application for flame recognition is very unsatisfactory, especially under long-distance conditions, the accuracy rate is only about 60%, the recognition effect of BP neural network is obviously better than that of Bayesian recognition.

articleTitle: Optimization Model of Agricultural Product Logistics Network Based on Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: "Internet +" era has arrived, it provides new products through network platform and traditional industries, provide new value, new services, mining new business model; the development of the Internet can penetrate into all walks of life, can create infinite value, provide great convenience and creativity to people's life. With the development of the logistics industry, it has become the nuclear pillar of the national industry. In every logistics process, it needs the support of the Internet, and it has become a very precious asset of logistics enterprises. With the Internet and big data, it will help logistics enterprises to transform and upgrade in the direction of intelligent logistics, so that enterprises can quickly grasp the market environment and understand customer needs, so as to make correct and effective decisions. China is a big agricultural country and agriculture is the basic industry of national economic development. As an agricultural country, most agricultural logistics, circulation links and long circulation cycle, and the greatest economic benefit and the quality and safety of agricultural products. n order to solve this problem, this paper mainly by literature research, comparative analysis and network research methods, combined with logistics management knowledge, the introduction of intelligent logistics, agricultural products logistics integration theory, X province in 2015-2020 forestry animal husbandry fishery total output value and 2020 per capita disposable income (10186 yuan) data integration, in-depth research on the Internet brings opportunities and challenges for agricultural products logistics enterprises.

articleTitle: Realization of Retrieval Based on Tibetan Proverbs Databas
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Proverbs are the artistic summary of people’s longterm observation of natural phenomenon, social phenomenon. It is an educational folk language that fully expresses the struggle experience and thoughts and feelings of the working people in rhythmic language. This study included 489 Tibetan proverbs in the Database of Tibetan Proverbs and the query system is analyzed to realize the rapid query and retrieval of Tibetan pro-verbs database and effectively meet the needs of users.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data Multimodal Teaching Mode in College
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Many applications of computer-assisted English learning in colleges and universities lack the evaluation and feedback of multimodal learning. The article describes a multimodal teaching system of spoken English in colleges and universities using speech recognition technology. In addition to the usual pronunciation scoring, we also provide error detection based on phoneme association and phoneme recognition. Combines improvement suggestions from the Correction Knowledge Base and Prosody Correction Speech. The system can help learners in a timely manner. The experimental results show that the system can correct most of the unintentional mistakes of learners with a certain base.

articleTitle: High Gain Buck-Boost Converter with Active Coupled Inductor Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the voltage gain of conventional Buck-Boost converter and reduce the voltage stress of switching tube, a high gain buck-Boost converter with active coupling inductor structure was proposed. The converter combines the traditional Buck-Boost converter with the equivalent Buck-Boost converter, adding the switching capacitor mixed group structure to greatly improve the voltage gain of the converter, and introducing the coupling inductor structure to reduce the voltage stress of the switching tube. The different working modes of the converter are analyzed and the expressions of voltage gain and voltage stress of the switching device and the critical working conditions of the excitation inductor are derived. Compared with conventional Buck-Boost converters, the voltage gain of the converter is increased by a factor of (5+D+2n)/D , and the voltage gain can be flexibly adjusted by the turn ratio n. The voltage stress of the switching device is reduced to 1/(5+D+2n) times the output voltage. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis is verified by simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Financial Risk Early Warning Model Based on Kernel Function Adjustment Algorithm and Information Digitization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of my country’s market economy and the reform of the management system, the risks in company investment and financial operations have gradually become prominent. In the thesis, the financial status risk early warning model of digital companies based on the kernel function adjustment algorithm is studied, and the relevant theoretical knowledge about the financial status risk of digital companies is understood on the basis of literature data, and then the digital company that adopts the kernel function adjustment algorithm. The financial status risk early warning model is established, and the newly established model is tested. According to the experimental conclusions, it is concluded that the improved algorithm studied in this paper is better than PCA-SVM in reducing the number of support vectors.

articleTitle: Research on incremental update mechanism of moving target tracking based on user interest change
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Target tracking is a hot topic in the field of computer vision. It uses the context information of video or image sequence to model the appearance and motion information of the target, so as to predict the motion state of the target and calibrate the position of the target. From the perspective of building models, target tracking algorithms can be divided into generative models and discriminant models; From the number of tracking targets, it can be divided into single target tracking and multi-target tracking. Target tracking integrates the theories and algorithms of image processing, machine learning, optimization and other fields.
