It is the premise and foundation to complete higher-level image understanding.The basic task of target tracking is to give the initial position of the target in a video sequence and continuously track and locate the target in each subsequent frame. In this process, a priori conditions such as the color, shape and size of the target will not be provided, that is, the tracking algorithm can track only by learning the target in the first frame. The traditional solution is to calculate the project similarity offline and save it in the system for algorithm call, but it can not make full use of the latest scoring data to reflect the change of user interest. To solve the above problems, a target tracking item similarity incremental update mechanism suitable for online applications is proposed, so that the recommendation system can update the similarity data between the corresponding item and other items in real time after the current user submits the item score, so that the recommendation system can recommend based on the latest item similarity data, To adapt to changes in user interests.

articleTitle: Coal Mine Safety Risk Prediction Based on Incremental Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Safety is the most important part of coal industry production. The existing safety monitoring for coal mines mainly adopts the hard division of the values collected by sensors, the analysis and processing means of related information are single, and the overall scheme of intelligent mining of risk situation is lack. Based on the temporal and spatial distribution law of coal mine production big data, this paper constructs a coal mine safety risk assessment model, and combines the incremental extreme learning machine to predict the coal mine production safety risk. This method fully selects the optimal time granularity of the time window characteristics before the accident, focuses on the impact of recent sample characteristics on the risk development trend, and dynamically selects more appropriate characteristics, which can effectively meet the parameter update of coal mine safety risk model under the condition of incremental data. Experiments on multi class monitoring data from several mines show that this method has better accuracy than other similar methods.

articleTitle: Cherry Image Recognition Based on Homomorphic Filtering and Convolutional Neural Network Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Under natural conditions, light has an impact on cherry fruit recognition, which will affect whether machine vision can accurately identify cherries and then affect the accuracy of machine picking. Through the technical analysis of the convolutional neural network image recognition algorithm, this paper proposes a cherry recognition algorithm that combines morphological filtering and convolutional neural network. The algorithm uses homomorphic filtering to compensate for natural light. Through the natural light compensation method, the problem of low accuracy of cherry recognition caused by light is solved, and then the convolutional neural network algorithm was used to accurate cherry recognition. Compared with a single convolutional neural network algorithm, the use of homomorphic filtering to compensate natural light has good identification under the conditions of front light, backlight and side light, with recognition rate increased by 5%, 20% and 25% respectively. In addition, the running time is shortened by 20%, This paper provid a new method for cherry identification in natural environment.

articleTitle: 3D Art Pattern Modeling Algorithm Design Based on Neural Network Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the invention and popularization of computers, the rapid growth of network speed and computing power has profoundly affected and changed people's production and life styles. Among them, the influence of 3D technology is the most prominent. Image 3D modeling technology is currently one of the main research directions in the field of image processing. This article mainly studies how to extract 3D information from images, the latest image 3D modeling method based on neural networks. Finally, this article reproduces the 3D art pattern reconstruction algorithm based on a single image from multiple angles. The experiment is based on the Matlab platform, and the image data and training network come from the computer vision course of Carnegie Mellon University. Experimental results show that the algorithm can generate accurate 2D image depth maps, and relatively complete reconstruction of the 3D model of the image.

articleTitle: Design of charging pile charging control unit based on AM3354
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Design a charging control unit that complies with the technical specifications of the State Grid Corporation’s charging piles, with the AM3354 processor as the control core. The control unit is composed of functional modules such as metering, billing, positioning, control, storage, encryption, decryption, communication and display, and realizes charging control management of DC charging piles. The program-controlled interactive interface adopts the embedded Linux operating system development design to achieve better human-computer interaction, people-oriented, and convenient for users to operate. The design and implementation of the charging pile billing control unit is conducive to the rapid development of the charging facility system.

articleTitle: Frequency Estimation Based on Gaussian Fitting in Frequency Domain
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, the most typical resonator SAW (Surface Acoustic Wave) temperature sensor system is taken as an example. According to the characteristics of its echo signal, analyzed and compared the signal processing methods, the methods to improve the frequency resolution are proposed. In time-domain FFT (Fast Fourier Transform) method, due to the limited length of received signal, the frequency discrete sampling restriction exists. Then it will reduce the estimation accuracy of signal frequency. Rife algorithm improves the accuracy by interpolation, Grandke algorithm improves the accuracy by windowing. Both algorithms increase the amount of computation. At the same time the signal obtained may be very biased. In this paper, a frequency estimation algorithm based on Gaussian fitting in frequency domain is proposed. The corresponding echo signal is obtained by increasing the step frequency step by step on the excitation signal. The amplitude of the echo signal is accumulated in a certain period of time. Excitation signal with different frequencies and cumulative amplitude of echo signalare fitted by Gaussian fitting. From the Gaussian fitting, we can get the frequency. The experimental results show that this method does not need FFT transformation, the amount of computation is relatively small, and the accuracy is much higher than Rife algorithm and Grandke algorithm.

articleTitle: Security State Estimation Algorithm of Data Transmission Channel in Wireless Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the scene of high-speed vehicle networking, the full-duplex relay communication C-V2X wireless communication network suffers from strong interference, which leads to poor channel security of communication system and low error rate of communication output. A channel security state estimation algorithm of full-duplex relay communication CV2x wireless communication network in high-speed vehicle networking scene based on linear least mean square error estimation is proposed. The channel model of full-duplex relay communication CV2x wireless communication network in high-speed vehicle networking scene is constructed, and the concept of propagation loss is used to describe the energy loss of relay communication CV2x wireless communication. In each array element, the deep learning network is used to directly perform blind channel equalization on the received data. Under different transmission speeds, the channel gain control model of the full-duplex relay communication C-V2X wireless network in the high-speed vehicle networking scene is constructed with the intensity and propagation time of multipath waves as constraint parameters. The error rate estimation is used to estimate the output state of the communication channel in real time. The simulation results show that the full-duplex relay communication C-V2X wireless data transmission with this method in the high-speed vehicle networking scene has high channel security, low bit error rate and strong anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Research on three-dimensional scene production methods of cultural and creative games based on Unity technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the increasing attention paid by the cultural and creative industry to IP, IP extension not only includes ordinary peripheral products such as handicrafts, toys, cultural shirts, etc., but also carries out multi-dimensional expansion in the diversified development of its products. Game development is an important field of IP expansion of cultural and creative products in recent years. At present, most of the game development is based on Unity 3D technology. The most important part of game development is the three-dimensional scene production of the game. Therefore, on the basis of the above background, this paper systematically explores the specific application of Unity technology in the three-dimensional scene production process by studying the three-dimensional scene production of cultural and creative games.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated Electronically Controlled Two-gear Main Reducer Used in Baja Racing Car
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Baja racing car, as an off-road vehicle for competition, has higher requirements for the quality of the vehicle itself. In order to ensure the lightweight and power performance, at the same time, vigorously improve the passability of Baja racing cars in the cross-country field, a main reducer in the power transmission system is designed in this paper. According to the different driving conditions, the servo motor can be used to change the gear of the main reducer. at the same time, the differential can be locked according to the need. The main reducer designed in this project can greatly improve the power performance and adaptability to the terrain of the racing car. on the one hand, automatic shift can improve fuel efficiency and increase the safety of the whole vehicle. At the same time, the single-chip microcomputer system is used to control the gear servo motor to improve the life of the reducer. Under the background of lightweight racing car, we integrate the two-stage two-speed reducer, differential and differential lock with more complex structure, which greatly improves the space utilization. At the same time, the functions of shift and locking are creatively controlled by a motor, which is not only lightweight, but also more reliable and economical.

articleTitle: Remote 3D Clothing Network Customization Platform Based on Cloud Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of information technology and e-commerce, online shopping has become a trend. However, the current domestic clothing e-commerce website, mostly flat, to a certain extent, inhibit the fun of people shopping and purchase desire. In order to better solve the related problems and make online shopping more interesting, this paper analyzes the 3D clothing online customization platform combined with cloud intelligence technology. This paper selects 20 clothing stores as the experimental objects, 10 of them as the experimental group, constructs the remote 3D clothing network customization platform under the cloud intelligent technology, and the other 10 2D plane websites as the control group. The experimental period is one year. The statistical and comparative analysis uses the statistical spss software to analyze and compare its one-year operation situation and results, and at the same time, uses the intelligent cloud technology to analyze the Chinese clothing industry the clothing online shopping situation in recent 5 years was systematically investigated and analyzed. The results show that the turnover growth rate of the experimental group is 40% compared with a year ago, while that of the control group is only 12%, so the experimental group has achieved obvious results. It can be seen that the research on cloud intelligent technology and Remote 3D clothing network customization platform is of great value.

articleTitle: A Large-Scale Privacy Measurement of Novel TLS 1.3 Protocol
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of people's awareness of network security, also the increasing needs of network security and privacy protection, more and more websites begin to use full encryption technologies (such as TLS1.3, DoT, ESNI/ECH). From the perspective of passive traffic, network behavior is completely invisible, which greatly protects user privacy. However, the destination IP accessed by the user is still visible, which still bring the risk. In this paper, we aim to measure the privacy leakage of the novel protocols by studying the relationship between Domain and IP. We have collected a large number of domain and IP datasets from China's major academic backbone networks, with a scale of 53.4 billion and a time range of July 2021. We use IP anonymity, domain popularity, and Domain-IP dynamics to quantify the degree of privacy protection. Through a comprehensive analysis of large-scale real-world DNS data, we conduct an assessment of the privacy leakage risks of the novel protocols in current open networks. We find that 0.64% of the domains have not gained any privacy benefit since they have a one-to-one mapping between domain and IP, 1.4% of IP (with anonymity greater than 10k) host 83% of domains, which can obtain high privacy protection. Less popular sites get higher privacy protections. 0.02% (10 million) of domains change IP every day, and these websites get better privacy protection. Finally, we discuss the potential methods of privacy protection in the novel protocol.

articleTitle: Intelligent System Construction of Gymnasium Based on Internet of Things Resource Sharing Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: School sports resources are the necessary guarantee for sports development, in which space resources are one of the basic conditions for sports activities. Due to the increasing demand of urban residents for sports and physical conditions, and the serious shortage of space resources at present. In this case, it is particularly important to put forward a mechanism for sharing school sports venue resources with the society. So what kind of way should we take to open the existing campus and what kind of management mechanism should we take after opening it? The purpose of this paper is to study the model design of social sports and school cooperation based on the Internet of things. In this paper, the development status of the Internet of things at home and abroad is analyzed in detail, and the intelligent and modern system of the gymnasium on campus is proposed to ensure the safety of students. Then it studies and explores the cooperation mode with social sports groups, and comes to the conclusion that cooperation with off campus clubs can make profits. According to the questionnaire data, whether students, school presidents, professors or social sports association managers are relatively satisfied.

articleTitle: Analysis and calculation of medium and long term demand of pumped storage power station in Zhejiang Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to meet the current and future large scale and high proportion development of new energy in Zhejiang Province and the needs of building a new power system in the new period, facing the demand of power system for pumped storage development in 2035, based on the resource planning of pumped storage stations in Zhejiang Province, the general idea, main tasks, major layout and guarantee measures for the future development of pumped storage in Zhejiang Province are put forward to guide the construction of pumped storage power stations in the future and promote the high-quality and sustainable development of pumped storage power stations.

articleTitle: Design of 3D Interactive Landscape Roaming Algorithm Based on Deep Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The algorithm design for 3D interactive landscape roaming has been paid more and more attention, landscape design requires a large number of design drawings, renderings and animated roaming to express the designer's design intention. At present, with the continuous improvement and development of algorithm, the application of 3D interactive technology for landscape design has made a major breakthrough. The design of 3D interactive landscape roaming algorithm can better produce 3D effect drawings and dynamic simulation of the landscape design, so as to achieve the fulfillment of the industry.

articleTitle: An information perspective based on architecture design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Architecture design technology, this paper focus on the information demand research, exploration, especially in the information mechanism, and the data information system in the view of operations to the reshaping of the structure and function of the elaboration, enrich the theory of information view research storage, to engage in battle command, program planning, construction and management, system design, technology research and development and system maintenance work and so on all kinds of personnel, Provide a "common language" for communication, so that the theoretical framework of information resource services is gradually improved and accurate. In terms of system nature, information demand research is a concept and top-level design of a higher level. The information demand reflects the ability demand of information system construction, interprets and changes from the perspective of information on the ability points needed to be improved, and provides theoretical layout and hints for the final system construction and application.

articleTitle: Development of Civil Aircraft Cockpit Control Device Based on System Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Cockpit control device is defined as the device used by flight crew to operate, configure and manage aircraft, flight control surface, control system and other equipment. Cockpit products development based on system engineering is a cross professional, cross departmental and cross enterprise technology and management method which aims for customer needs, focus on the whole product life cycle, and achieve global optimization through product integration and process integration. Need, Function, Requirements and Physics (N-FR-P) are the core design points in the development of cockpit control device, which determines whether the product scheme is technically feasible and meets the needs of customers. This paper focuses on the above points, and deeply discuss the input, output, process and method of cockpit control device design activities.

articleTitle: Study on the Application of Multimeter Intelligent Device with Electrified Alarm and Self-locking Function
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: An external protection device for a multimeter has been developed with the functions of verifying the gear selection and the measured object, issuing an alarm, and protecting the multimeter to protect electrical equipment, multimeter, personal safety and economic benefits. In other words, it is to reduce accidents that seriously affect the normal operation of electrical equipment, such as short circuit and unexpected action of control function caused by wrong gear selection of electric meter in circuit maintenance, improve the accuracy and safety of maintenance and reduce the cost of accidents of power enterprises.

articleTitle: A liquid crystal polarization grating beam scanning component driver based on MCU
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Liquid crystal polarization grating (LCPG) is a new type of grating device based on geometric phase principle which has electro-optic tunability and polarization tunability. In this paper, a multi-channel programmable LCPG driver is designed for the cascaded LCPG components. The programmable beam direction of the beam scanning component based on the LCPG is realized by adjusting the driving voltage at both ends of each monolithic LCPG. The driver voltage adjustment range is 0Vpp-38Vpp, and the voltage resolution is 0.0195V. Taking the 3-piece cascaded LCPG beam scanning system as an example for the driver performance test. The results show that the driver designed in this paper has good driving performance for the cascaded LCPG.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Internet Financial Sharing Technology in Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the era of big data and Internet +, financial sharing services as a new type of financial management model are being widely accepted and applied. A financial sharing system is designed. The system uses Web services, data integration, triggers and other technologies to share various financial systems of the enterprise to ensure that the department can obtain the financial information of each enterprise at any time. The research shows that the computer financial sharing system realizes the collaborative work of various departments of the enterprise, and the practical application of enterprise network reimbursement has verified the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Big Data Model Based on Deep Volume Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of information and communication technology, the amount of global data is increasing explosively. How to effectively analyze massive and complex data, mine and realize its potential value and make rational use of it is one of the important topics at present. An incomplete big data filling algorithm based on deep learning is proposed. Firstly, the filling automatic coder is established based on the automatic coder. On this basis, the depth filling network model is constructed, the depth characteristics of incomplete big data are analyzed, and the network parameters are calculated according to the layer by layer training idea and back propagation algorithm The target detection algorithm based on deep learning is far ahead of the traditional target detection algorithm in detection accuracy. Relying on big data to automatically learn and extract features, the effect is far better than that of manually designed features. Although big data has brought great potential to many fields such as industry, education and health care, it is a very arduous task to obtain valuable knowledge from big data. Learning the characteristics of big data and mining the information hidden in big data requires both advanced technology and interdisciplinary cooperation. Based on the deep convolution NN model of deep learning algorithm, the proposed field of computer vision has made remarkable achievements in recognition ability. This paper mainly discusses the application of deep convolution NN in computer vision.

articleTitle: Performance Parameters and Running Speed of Computer System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Speed is the most important parameter of computer performance, and all methods devoted to improving computer performance aim to speed up computation. The development of multi-core parallel programs has made the improvement of computer performance a research hotspot. In this context, this paper analyzes the selection of computer system performance parameters and the influence of multi-core architecture on system running speed, and tests serial and parallel Monte Carlo in big data environment. The CPU utilization under the algorithm and the crawling effect of single-thread and multi-thread crawler are tested, and it is found that multi-core parallelism can improve the performance and speed of the computer system. Therefore, the parallelism of the computer system is fully utilized to improve the computing performance.

articleTitle: Intelligent wheelchair design based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper designs an intelligent wheelchair based on STM32 microcontroller, including control board, drive module, balance control module, ultrasonic module, tracking module, voltage regulator module and power module; Drive module, balance control module, ultrasonic module and tracking module are connected with the control motherboard; The voltage stabilizer module is connected with the power supply module, used to stabilize the power supply voltage and power supply to the control motherboard, drive module, balance control module, ultrasonic module and tracking module; The driving module is used to provide power for a two-way motor installed in the wheel position of the wheelchair; The balance control module is used to obtain the Angle and posture information of the wheelchair and keep the body balance of the wheelchair; The ultrasonic module is used to identify obstacles and automatically avoid obstacles; The tracking module for automatic navigation; On the basis of ordinary electric wheelchair, the balance control and automatic obstacle avoidance structure are added to provide safety guarantee.

articleTitle: Automated Coral Planting Unmanned Boat Applied to Grid Plate
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on the current status of coral planting work and the current underwater working methods, this paper proposes to design an automated coral planting unmanned boat applied to grid plates to complete coral planting in the reef area to be repaired. It is planned to carry out mechanical structure design, including mechanism motion design, part structure design, and mechanical parts, component design and simulation assembly; and carry out size check and strength check on its key components; finally propose a mechanical claw for the manipulator Structural design plan and control system design plan. The overall design is mainly designed around its expected functions, and the combination and innovation of different institutions are carried out to achieve the predetermined goals.

articleTitle: Research on Image Detection and Coordinate Reading of 2D Machining Path
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Traditional image recognition technology is easily affected by environmental factors, has poor anti-noise ability, low image recognition accuracy, low efficiency and poor application flexibility. In actual industrial production, image recognition technology has a wide range of applications. Therefore, this paper aims to optimize traditional image recognition technology, apply MATLAB software to process images to obtain path information, and provide path information for driving devices more accurately, stably and quickly.

articleTitle: Two forms of frequency standard deviation of a sine signal on multi-period measurements
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper implements three algorithms for frequency measurement of a sinusoidal signal in noise, including zero-crossing method, Fourier transform method and nonlinear curve fitting method. Simulation results for multi-period present two forms of correspondence between the standard deviation of the frequency and the number of measurement periods. This paper analyzes these two relationships.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Engine Rail Pressure Overrun
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the process of vehicle experiments, PRV valve of a diesel engine frequently opens resulting in failure of engine function during the normal process, Through the screening of low pressure oil pipe diameter and pressure, Everything is all right; in addition we collect the vehicle actual operation data, and debug data, through a series of solutions, rail pressure is in a good control condition, so we summarize some effective solutions about how to deal with the problem of PRV valve opened.

articleTitle: Research and Application of 220kV Short-Circuit Current Limiting Measures Based on Fast Switch
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of power grid capacity, the short-circuit current in local areas is too high, which seriously threatens the stable and safe operation of the system. The paper proposes a multi-break series connection high-voltage fast switching type fault current limiter, through the isolation transformer to operate the mechanism and the break isotropic, using "one with two" type electromagnetic repulsion mechanism, eliminating the insulated tie, not only to achieve rapid breaking and closing, but also to solve the fault current limiter using capacitive voltage transformer energy supply when the system is not charged with the problem of breaking and closing. Finally, a 220kV transmission line is selected for engineering application, and a single-phase artificial short-circuit test is conducted to verify the short-circuit current limiting capability of the fast-switching type short-circuit current limiter in the process of single-phase grounding of the line to ensure the feasibility and safety of the line circuit breaker action.

articleTitle: Research on technical solution of common mode failure caused by avionics transmission errors for civil aircraft wing anti icing system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on the common mode analysis method of civil aircraft, this paper analyzes the independence requirements of wing anti icing system and the safety judgment under the influence of common mode errors of avionics system transmission. In view of the unacceptable safety analysis results, the CRC mechanism is proposed to verify wing anti icing system alarm message and eliminate common mode failure, and the advantages and limitations of this proposal are put forward in the conclusion.

articleTitle: Key Frame Extraction Based on Sports Statistical Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to enable users to quickly obtain the most informative frame in the video, we proposed a sports video summarization technology that comprehensively applies the global optical flow and local optical flow characteristic. On the premise of capturing visual differences, we consider the simple semantic features of sports video. In this method, shot segmentation is done based on color features and some denoise process is added. Then we used spline curve to obtain the global optical flow and local optical flow of each frame, and obtain the camera motion function. The significant difference of camera motion function in one shot between frames is used to extract shot key frames. Then, we introduce local optical flow to solve the problem of redundant frames.

articleTitle: Design of Foreign Language Intelligent Translation Recognition System Based on Improved GLR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous progress of information technology, foreign language intelligent translation recognition is also constantly updated. From the comparison of mobile translation tools at home and abroad, foreign mobile translation tools started earlier, with mature technology and rich types. This paper summarizes the concept of GLR algorithm, puts forward the improved scheme of GLR algorithm, discusses statistical machine translation, analyzes intelligent matching, briefly introduces the speech recognition system, and finally tests the online translation software system. The results show that the query module can not work, mainly because after opening the voice setting, some models of operating systems do not support Pico voice engine.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Water Force Field Physical Properties and Build Water Force Field Based on Generate Antagonistic-Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on the Generate Antagonistic-Recurrent Neural Network (GAN-RNN), a model for accurately and quickly predicting molecular dynamic potential parameters was established. By training water molecular force field dataset, the mapping relation between its properties and physical properties was established. New water force fields parameters were generated based on GAN through molecular dynamics simulation verification. The simulation results were close to the experimental values This may provide a new procedure for the rapid and accurate construction of water force fields.

articleTitle: Intelligent Classification and Evaluation Model for Safety Risks of Water Conservancy Projects Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The intelligent classification and evaluation method for safety risks in water conservancy projects is proposed to improve the efficiency and accuracy of risk assessment in water conservancy projects. The method uses a preprocess of word segmentation and data augmentation to extract key information in Chinese risk source texts. Then input the segmented words into the embedding layer based on Word2Vec to characterize them as word vectors, and input the word vectors into the bidirectional long short-term memory network for bidirectional semantic feature learning. The attention mechanism is applied at last for feature enhancement and risk level prediction. The results show that the method has better performance than traditional machine learning classification methods in prediction accuracy rate. The method provides credible risk prevention advice for construction staff of water conservancy projects.

articleTitle: "Energy-saving heating" theoretical design of mechanical devices for seedling greenhouses
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In response to the current problem of high energy consumption of greenhouse greenhouse heating, this paper introduces a new design of energy-saving heating device for seedling greenhouses. The efficiency of the device is improved by self-developed heat exchanger and rolling heater, and the overall performance of the device is evaluated as a whole by three-dimensional modeling and stress analysis of the device through inventor.

articleTitle: Considerations on Fully Intelligent Upgrading of Traditional Container Terminals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of the global economy, the quantity of container shipping in the world is showing an increasing trend, and container ships are also developing towards the large scale. Stable, high-efficiency, energy-saving, environmentally-friendly and low-cost container handling has become the focus of the container terminals. The automation and intelligence of container terminal operations are showing an inevitable development trend, and the only way to achieve high-quality development is upgrading and transforming traditional container terminals. Combining the intelligent upgrading project of Xiamen container terminals, this paper mainly analyzes the challenges and opportunities in the intelligent upgrading of traditional domestic container terminals; in order to solve the difficult problems in the intelligent upgrading of traditional container terminals,the technical solutions for the port intelligent upgrading of Xiamen container terminals were put forward.

articleTitle: Research on Rectenna for Microwave Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of 5G communications and wireless sensor networks have been applied in many fields, such as disaster management, infrastructure, monitoring, etc. At present, batteries are still the main power source for sensor nodes, but as the distributed environment of sensor networks becomes wider and more complex, battery maintenance and replacement will become a very difficult problem. In addition, with the development of micro-electromechanical systems and low-power electronic technologies, more and more small, low-power handheld mobile devices have appeared on the market. In addition, the battery itself has a limited lifespan, which can also cause environmental pollution. Using rectennas to power these devices with microwave energy in the environment will provide these devices with sustainable electrical energy and can also avoid environmental pollution from waste batteries.

articleTitle: Study on the Surface Roughness Improvement for Silicon Samples with Millimeter-Size Openings
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Substrate-free MEMS and MOEMS devices are becoming the hotspots for micro systems. Fabrication of substrate-free devices usually involves the release of backside silicon through the deep reactive ion etch (DRIE) process. And smoothness of etch cavities during DRIE is of vital importance for the performance of devices. The electrical state of electrically isolated samples was optimized to obtain better roughness when etching parameters were fixed. After the isolated sample was electrically grounded, the number of etch grass on the surface decreased and lower root-mean-square roughness was obtained. This technique helps in the fabrication of substrate-free micro-system devices.

articleTitle: Structure and Control Analysis Based on Solar Panel Pleaning Pevice
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of dust accumulation and high temperature in the working process of solar panels, a solar panel dust removal device is designed, which can keep the solar panels working under the condition of high power. This paper mainly introduces its research significance, further refines its control system and analyzes its structure.

articleTitle: Information Management System of Engineering Cost Based on Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The determination of engineering project cost (PC) is one of the important contents of engineering project management, but the estimation of engineering cost (EC) generally has the disadvantages of large error and long preparation time. With the continuous development of computer science, big data technology is one of the very popular research topics. The purpose of this article is to study the EC information management(IM) system based on big data. This article analyzes the cost information collection, cost information storage, platform function maintenance and other aspects of the PC information management platform(IMP), combines the hadoop technology to build the PC IMP, and tests the acceleration status and system operation efficiency under the hadoop technology to realize the construction of EC IMP, and then meet the actual needs of EC IM and information control. The experimental results show that in the relatively small amount of data, the number of data nodes increases, and the processing speed index gradually increases. In the case of a large amount of data, the acceleration ratio is positively correlated with the data nodes. The operating efficiency of the hadoop cluster will gradually increase, and the operating status is relatively stable. When the amount of data is 1 million and the number of nodes is 4, the running time is 10 seconds.

articleTitle: Application of roof photovoltaic grid connected power station in Tibet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In addition to saving energy and reducing environmental pollution, the large-scale promotion of photovoltaic grid connected power generation can also stimulate the rapid growth of photovoltaic industry and achieve the purpose of energy sustainable development. Photovoltaic grid connection is widely used in our region. The desert area of our region is vast. The construction of large-scale photovoltaic power stations in the desert will have great development. Design and develop key technologies and equipment with independent intellectual property rights, develop and utilize excellent solar energy resources, make full use of the vast desert and Gobi area, and build large and super large grid connected photovoltaic power generation systems, It is one of the ways to solve the problems of China’s economic development and energy supply. The research of this paper lays a technical foundation for realizing the national planning objectives and promotes the industrialization of photovoltaic grid connected inverter equipment and solar photovoltaic tracking equipment.

articleTitle: Design of Voice Smart Drawer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the existing traditional home drawers are cumbersome, lack of organization, and difficult to quickly find the required items, a voice smart drawer is designed. It uses Arduino as the control core and Chipintelli Cl 1122 chip as the voice interaction core. After receiving and recognizing the voice command, it can control the opening and closing of the drawer by voice and query the items by voice. It is suitable for the storage of small items in life and saves the time for users to find and retrieve items.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence for Metal Foreign Body on the Shielding Case of Miniaturized GIS and Its Detection Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The millimeter and micron-level metal foreign bodies are inevitably generated during GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear) installation and operation, which seriously affects the internal insulation state during their operation. Based on 363kV miniaturized GIS, a test platform with 520kV power frequency withstand voltage and 1175kV lightning impulse withstand voltage is built to analyze the influence of insulation state under different sizes of metal foreign bodies. First, when the foreign of different sizes is adsorbed to the high voltage electrode of the circuit breaker, the internal insulation margin of the GIS is checked to obtain the level of internal insulation deterioration of the circuit breaker. Later, the high voltage method was used to obtain the insulation state change rules of GIS when different sizes of foreign bodies are adsorbed to high voltage electrodes. Finally, the foreign body detection method of two-light source contrast is proposed based on the sensitive optical characteristics of the foreign body, to reduce the impact of the foreign adsorption of the high voltage electrode on the insulation margin of the GIS equipment before the handover test.

articleTitle: Frame Attention Mechanism and Transfer Learning Network for Classification on Motion Video
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Video content classification has a wide range of application scenarios. In situations such as public place security and behavior prediction, the type of behavior of a person is inferred from the continuous images in the video. Video data adds the concept of time compared to image data, which inevitably increases the overall computational effort. A typical research tool uses 3D convolution for feature map extraction in the time domain, but such methods exhibit significant performance loss due to frame down sampling. Inspired by the human judgment of video content, this study computes features on a single frame by transfer learning and then encodes the position of the resulting set of features. An attention mechanism is used to determine the keyframe locations. Finally, a multilayer perceptron is combined to achieve video content classification. The results of the study show that with the chosen dataset. Our model outperforms the 3D convolutional model in discriminative accuracy, confusion matrix, and down sampling conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Strategy of Trade Economy Supply Chain Based on PBFT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In developing SMEs(SMEs) in my country, the advantages of structural industrialization and related adjustments have played a significant role. However, due to the fragmented industry and small scale of enterprises, they cannot make good use of the scale effect to provide corresponding support to the market. Therefore, It is necessary to rebuild the financial supply chain for SMEs and carry out related innovations from a market-oriented perspective. In the process of supply chain construction, the strategy of trust distribution and node election has always been difficult in system construction. Under the above background, this article analyzes my country's Internet trade economy supply chain's current situation and analyzes related technical routes. On this basis, in response to the above problems, this article designs a blockchain technology-based trade economy supply chain and realizes the block In the process of building a trade economy supply chain under chain technology, by constructing the logical structure of the PBFT algorithm, the overall mechanism has been improved in terms of trust distribution, thereby optimizing its performance.

articleTitle: Research on Mathematical Modelling and Analysis Mothod of Vehicle-bridge Coupled Vibration
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The existing vehicle-bridge coupled vibration analysis of the vehicle model cannot accurately consider the vehicle dynamic characteristics and the impact of flexible tires on the vehicle-bridge coupled vibration response. This paper analyzes the surface contact on the vehicle-bridge coupled vibration by establishing a new three-dimensional wheel model The contact surface between the wheel and the road surface is simulated as a rectangle, and the vehicle-bridge coupled vibration equation is established through the coordinated displacement conditions and force interaction between the contact surfaces. The vertical acceleration of bridges and car bodies is significantly affected by track irregularities. Improving line conditions can effectively improve the comfort of trains; at the same time, the higher the speed, the greater the root mean square of the random response of bridges and vehicles, which is caused by track irregularities. The greater the dispersion of the vibration response of the coupled system.

articleTitle: Prediction of Typhoon Tracks Based on Seq2Seq with Sliding Window Attention
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Typhoon have always been a matter of great concern to meteorologists, and there have been many studies on axisymmetric structures, physical dynamics mechanisms and prediction techniques in the past few years. However, the physical parameterization scheme in the physical dynamic mechanism has greater uncertainty, and the dynamic framework needs to be further improved. As deep learning technology has made breakthroughs in many fields, more and more researchers have begun to try to introduce deep learning technology into typhoon trajectory prediction. Considering the time relevance of typhoon path information, this paper introduces Seq2Seq With Sliding Window Attention (SWA-Seq2Seq) network to predict typhoon path. This model can effectively improve the accuracy of typhoon path prediction, and the model is more stable and efficient.

articleTitle: Intelligent Early Education Auxiliary System Based on Vision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous internationalization of the market economy and the continuous progress of technology, the early education industry follows the development, and has more stringent requirements for visual algorithms. Based on the increasingly intensified market competition, the diversity of customer demand in the market competition environment is becoming more and more significant. With the continuous strengthening of national reform and continuous optimization of economic structure, the development and design of intelligent early education auxiliary system is the same. This paper studies the meaning, concept, classification and future development direction of intelligent early education auxiliary system based on visual algorithm, and lists the application cases of visual algorithm in early education industry. / auxiliary system in basic system, increase the large data model, sorting out the customer relationship, customer information, customer demand, customer value model is set up, customer usage range model, customer iteration model of intelligent/auxiliary system, from the data prove that intelligent/auxiliary system based on visual algorithm development and design of scientific, reasonable, In this way, the intelligent early education auxiliary system can be truly intelligent and scientific. Based on visual algorithm, the advantages of the comprehensive utilization of big data model, through the huge amounts of data to analyze customer value, customer value mining can improve space, improve intelligence/auxiliary system based on visual algorithm development and design of function and demand, improve their own quality, tested, check students' scores, edit the student information, subjects to change, The scores of question bank management were 89.4%, 96.5%, 90.4% and 90.2%.

articleTitle: Simulation on tread Rubber Cutting Resistance of Aircraft tire
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of aerospace industry, the take-off speed, landing speed and load of aircraft suffered by the aircraft are getting larger and larger. The requirements for tire performance are also getting higher and higher, especially for large aircraft tires. Aircraft tires as the only grounding parts of aircraft, plays an important role in aircraft safety. Due to the large aircraft landing speed, aircraft tires leaving a black mark on the ground when contacting with it, which is the rubber particles caused by the severe wear between the rubber and various sharp objects under the conditions of high temperature, high pressure and high speed difference. Abrasion resistance at high speed is an important indicators of aircraft tires, which is a direct impact on the safety of the tire. Therefore, the aircraft tire tread rubber is used as the research object in this paper, the high-speed cutting is used to characterize the wear resistance of the tread rubber and different sharp objects in the high-speed landing of the aircraft tire. Based on the Mooney-Rivilin constitutive model of rubber, a high-speed cutting model of tread rubber and different sharp objects was developed by ABAQUS software. The cutting performance of different sharp objects and tread materials was systematically studied under different tool angles and speed, which can evaluate the wear resistance of tread rubber in this harsh environment. Results indicated that the cutting force, cutting temperature have great relevance to the cutting resistance of tread rubber, which can be used to characterize the wear resistance of aircraft tires under harsh environment.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Model of Key Indicators of Power Internet Health Status
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of large identification errors in traditional attack information identification methods, a machine learning-based power Internet attack information identification method is proposed. The research of this project is to evaluate the key indicators of the health of the power Internet business, such as infrastructure (cpu, memory), data operation status during business operation or the operation status of the full link of the business, etc. Evaluation. Based on this system, the test environment is built as an implementation case, and the health status of the communication network equipment, network and business can be obtained through health examination and online diagnostic analysis to assist the operation and maintenance personnel to fully grasp the operation status of the communication network. In this paper, through the collection of internal and external data of electric power, through intelligent information fusion and other technologies, to realize data cross-border fusion, and tap the potential value of electric power big data. Through data analysis and cross-border integration, a comprehensive management platform for cross-border big data based on power security is built.

articleTitle: Research on Mathematical Statistics Model Algorithm under Improved Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The current evolutionary algorithms for solving multi-objective optimization mainly consider how to deal with the optimization of multiple conflicting objectives, and rarely consider the problem of processing constraints. Therefore, we propose a differential evolution algorithm for elite retention and non-dominated solution set migration operations in the evolution process to ensure the diversity of Pareto optimal solutions for multi-objective optimization problems. The performance of the basic differential evolution algorithm is improved through group chaotic initialization, adaptive crossover and mutation operations. The simulation results of three classic test functions show that the algorithm in this paper is better than the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm in terms of uniformity, approximation and convergence speed, and the convergence speed is also better than the other two improved evolutionary algorithms.

articleTitle: Networked Control System Information Security Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of industrial informatization, information security in the power production industry is becoming more and more important. In the power production industry, as the critical information egress of the industrial control system, the information security of the Networked Control System is particularly important. This paper proposes a construction method for an information security platform of Networked Control System, which is used for research, testing and training of Networked Control System information security.

articleTitle: The BER Performance Analysis of Relay Selection Technology Based on BPSK Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the future 5G mobile communication system, relay cooperation is known as one of the significant technologies to implement green communication. In a cooperative communication system, the selection of relay mode determines the performance of the system to a certain extent. This paper focused on a three-terminal relay network to compare with the performance of three relay selection techniques, i.e., amplify-and-forward (AF), decode-and-forward (DF), and code cooperation (CC), taking bit error rate (BER) as an indicator, in the additive white gaussian noise and Rayleigh fading channel, adopting the mode of Binary Phase Shift Keying (BPSK). Meanwhile, the closed expression of their BER was deduced, utilizing the simulation software MATLAB in the same channel conditions are compared with their performance, and the simulation results demonstrated that employing BPSK scheme, the performance of three relay selection techniques was obviously better than that of the direct transfer mode, however, the BER of DF cooperative transmission model was always superior to that of AF cooperative transmission mode and CC transmission mode.

articleTitle: Discussion on the design of OPGW connector box with large cores
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A more scientific OPGW connecting device is designed and trial-produced from the aspects of large core number, reliable sealing and convenient construction in this study.The design of OPGW optical unit is improved in the aspects of cable inlet seal, fiber disk structure and box sealing, and the application materials of each part of the device are rechecked and improved. The application of the new type connector box can simplify and optimize the process control difficulty in engineering construction, overcome the problems and defects found in the existing engineering and operation, and improve the reliability and service life of the joint device.To avoid the interruption of transmission channel and the deterioration of communication performance caused by the failure of junction box, that will further enhance the security and reliability of power communication network.

Author Keywords: large core number OPGW connector box

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Recommender Algorithm Optimization and Intelligent Systems Construction for Business Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Business analysis plays an essential role in numerous companies and industries, which involves data collection, data analysis, and the construction of intelligent systems to make critical business decisions. By using a data model to filter through consumers' data, it is easier than ever to make recommendations to consumers for what they would enjoy using or purchasing. Added a real-time product Recommendation System framework, the Reinforcement Learning model is used to automatically learn the optimal recommendation strategy. Also, the Deep Q-Network (DQN) algorithm is modified by replacing the convolutional neural network with the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The solution analyzes and predicts consumers' preferences in real-time, and makes up for the lack of iterative optimization of traditional Recommendation Systems in real scenarios.

articleTitle: Coupling Coordination Analysis of Urbanization and Eco-environment Based on Multi-source Big Data and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Coordinating the relationship between urbanization and environmental protection has received continuous attention from academia. From the perspective of the interaction between urban development and eco-environment, remote sensing data and statistical data have been used in this paper to construct the urbanization stress index and ecological environment quality index of Wuhan urban agglomerations, and quantitatively studies the spatial-temporal evolution of the coordinated development type between urbanization and eco-environment in Wuhan urban agglomeration from 2005 to 2019 based on the coupling coordination degree model. The results show that: (1) During the study period, Wuhan urban agglomeration’s coordination degree has increased from 0.57 to 0.62, entering the stage of moderately coordinated development. (2) Spatially, the coordination pattern has evolved from a double-circle pattern to a three-group pattern.

articleTitle: An Improved Ikeda System and Its Application in Image Encryption
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on the enhanced Ikeda time delay system derived from modified nonlinear function, a multi-rounds image encryption scheme is proposed. It is constructed by adding arctangent functions to nonlinear terms. Not only is the stability condition of the improved system analyzed theoretically, but also the stability and chaos characteristics of the system are studied from the aspects of solution response, phase diagram by using numerical analysis method. And then, the current time response sequence and delay time sequence are used to scramble and replace the pixel sequence of the plain image, respectively. As a characteristic of encryption algorithm, when multi-rounds encryption is carried out, it is necessary to use the pixels of the previous encrypted image to update the control parameters of the system dynamically. Simulation results show that the cryptosystem has excellent encryption performance, and can resist various attacks.

articleTitle: GFFS: Gravitational-Force Feature Real Time Segmentation of 3D Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Segmentation of point cloud is a momentous technology for autonomous vehicles. Due to the diversity and complexity of road environment, instance segmentation based on point cloud is a challenging task. Addressing this challenge, a gravitational-force feature segmentation of 3D point cloud (GFFS) is proposed. Firstly it divides the point into areas, secondly it sets the radius of the spherical neighborhood corresponding to each area based on the size and density of point cloud, thirdly it calculates the gravitational forces between the space of each spherical neighborhood and the barycenter of the area. GFFS performs instance segmentation of all kinds of objects in point cloud scene by analyzing the magnitude and continuity of gravitational forces. Finally, the superiority and effectiveness of the algorithm are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A Review of LinguaSnapp: a Crowd-sourcing Mobile App for Mapping Linguistic Landscape
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper offers a review of LinguaSnapp, a crowdsourcing smartphone app for collecting, archiving and analyzing linguistic landscape (LL) data. It compares the conventional linguistic landscaping process to the new mapping approach as provided by the LinguaSnapp app, which is specially designed to resolve the sore points of the old method with regards to data tagging, retrieval and geographic visualization. Also, this study gives a complete overview of the analytical descriptor menu of LinguaSnapp, namely, the submenus and choices within main menus of Language, Context and Analysis, which are at the core of this app that helps to describe the LL data photos in great detail. In addition, the advantages of the appointed editorial at the backend is also discussed. Furthermore, this paper probes into some of the potential drawbacks in LinguaSnapp, e.g. professional conceit may manifest in the editorial process, and the issues of copyright infringement and transfer.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Technology in English Teaching
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The article designs a scheme of an English online teaching system based on computer artificial intelligence technology, which focuses on the overall structure of the English online teaching system program, the design of the core modules, key technologies and specific implementation. The application results show that the application of this system could not only provide teachers and students with a favorable user interface for online communication, but also realize the functions of user registration, course information viewing, online exams, homework upload and download, and data management. Having applied this system, the realization of college English online teaching could be effectively promoted, and students' self-directed learning ability improved. Moreover, Effective combination of English teaching and computer artificial intelligence technology make it possible that the process of natural language computer processing in corpus linguistics is an important part.

articleTitle: Desert grass grid paving device and intelligent control equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: At present, sand prevention and control in the desert mainly adopt the method of laying sand barriers, and laying grass grids is a simple and effective control method with low cost and good effect. In the process of laying grass grids, large engineering vehicles are used for laying, which has high cost and low flexibility; manual laying is low in efficiency and labor-intensive. In response to the above problems, this device has designed a desert grass grid paving device. This device is a semi-automatic machine with low cost, stable work and high efficiency. The device and manual cooperation can greatly improve the efficiency of grass grid laying. DC control box control, stable operation, can be combined with intelligent monitoring and other equipment at the same time, the application prospect is broad.

articleTitle: Design of Stadium Building Energy Consumption Monitoring System Based on Data Acquisition Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the advancement of China's urbanization process, the amount of building energy consumption is gradually increasing every year, building energy consumption accounts for about one-third of the annual total energy consumption, the total amount is huge and there is a lot of energy waste, so the energy conservation of building energy consumption has become an important part of the "energy conservation and emission reduction" work. Before making plans for building energy conservation, the relevant data of energy consumption within the whole system need to be obtained first, so the building energy consumption monitoring system arises at the historic moment. In this paper, the overall design of building energy consumption monitoring system for stadiums and gymnasiums is based on data acquisition technology. The building energy consumption monitoring system required by this project mainly includes comprehensive collection of electricity and water consumption data of the whole stadium, classified statistics of the collected energy consumption data of each floor, and output various daily, monthly and annual reports. Finally, through the performance test of the system, the feasibility of the system is verified to meet the needs of users on the system.

articleTitle: Design of e-commerce platform based on collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In today’s increasingly prosperous e-commerce, the reliance on e-commerce platforms is becoming more and more serious, and the construction of e-commerce platforms often requires unique and innovative to complete survival in the context of a fierce society, researching and designing a low-cost and high-profit accurate push e-commerce platform is the current mainstream direction. Personalized recommendation technology is used to solve the problem of crowded mouth and improve user viscosity and popularity. In this paper, we propose a collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm-based e-commerce platform design, optimizing the algorithm from two aspects: user-based collaborative filtering algorithm and item-based collaborative filtering algorithm, and using SpringMVC framework to build an e-commerce platform to realize the design of various user preferences, which can further improve the sales and profitability of products while ensuring user retention.

articleTitle: SemSegFPA: Semantic Segmentation Feature Pyramid Network with Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, we address semantic segmentation tasks through combining multi-level feature representations with attention mechanism. Different from previous works that only capture contexts from the last layer of the backbone, we propose Semantic Segmentation Feature Pyramid Network with Attention Module (SemSegFPA) to adaptively collect local features from different feature levels and effectively utilize those features that have different information to generate global context. Specifically, we create two types of attention modules for better information extracting, which respectively encodes important information in weights in spatial and channel dimensions. Our modules effectively improve the performance of the model with marginal extra cost. Our method outperforms SemSegFPN and achieves competitive performance compared to other mainstream methods, with the least runtime, on four challenging semantic segmentation datasets, i.e., ADE20K, PASCAL VOC 2012, and PASCAL Context, and LIP.

articleTitle: Financial ERP System Management and Design Based on Grid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the popularization of the Internet and the greatly reduced cost of the Internet and the change of traditional computing with the performance of the computer, grid computing has gradually become an important trend in the development of supercomputing. Financial information management in grid computing environment is a considerable challenge due to the resource characteristics of its environment. A wide range of complex resources will greatly affect the performance of the computation. Grid financial information management is just like the financial management system in traditional distributed computing environment or cluster computing environment. This system has three functions: job request management, financial management and financial information allocation and scheduling, that is, users submit application resource request to network system through job management function; Identify and monitor the status of network resources, gather information about resource usage during running jobs, and manage cluster resources. Receiving application resources Specify the resources required by the job based on the policy. Financial ERP system based on grid algorithm is necessary and an inevitable choice to comply with the development of The Times.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Cable Terminals in Electrothermal Coupling Field
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: DC transmission plays an increasingly important role in the development of power grids. DC transmission has many advantages but AC transmission does not. As an important transmission device for DC transmission, HVDC cable is the focus of scientific research, and cable accessories have high research value as an important connection device. As one of the cable accessories, the cable terminal directly affects the safety of the entire system. Under the DC field, the electric field distribution of the terminal is mainly affected by the conductivity, and the electric field homogenization problem has become the focus of research. In this paper, the simulation of the cable terminal under the electrothermal coupling field is carried out, and the variation law of conductivity and electric field strength is analyzed, which is of great significance.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Integrated Management of Engineering Project Based on Genetic Hybrid Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Under the background of the rapid development of computer network technology, the algorithm used in engineering is also making continuous progress. The multi-objective integrated management of engineering projects must adapt to the pace of development of The Times, and constantly improve the optimization algorithm, so that the algorithm can serve the field of engineering projects. The optimization and improvement of algorithm are of great significance to engineering project management, especially multi-objective integrated management of engineering project. It is necessary to strengthen the research of genetic hybrid optimization algorithm for engineering project development. This article studied the genetic hybrid optimization algorithm based on the study of the multi-objective integrated project management, is introduced to define genetic hybrid optimization algorithm, principle of multi-objective project related theory and knowledge, etc., by using functional analysis method based on genetic hybrid optimization algorithm of the multi-objective integrated project management effect comparison, Compare the advantages of genetic hybrid optimization algorithm. This paper uses data to analyze the effect of engineering projects, which has significant advantages in many aspects of multi-objective integrated management of engineering projects. Through data testing, the comprehensive evaluation rate of engineering projects reaches 89.12%, 90.23%, 95.32%, 98.10% respectively.

articleTitle: Lossless Compression Method of Color Image Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Image target recognition is realized by lossless compression of multi-scale fusion saliency color image features. A lossless compression algorithm of multi-scale fusion saliency color image features based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the collected multi-scale fusion saliency color images are preprocessed by wavelet denoising, and then RGB-D saliency detection is carried out on the noise-reduced and purified multi-scale fusion saliency color images. Laplacian contrast is used as pheromone for information combination optimization and fusion, adaptive weight balanced segmentation method is used to extract the visual characteristics of salient objects of multi-scale fused salient color images, and improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to realize feature lossless compression through global contrast information fusion, particle swarm evolution and information fusion. Finally, the performance test is carried out through simulation experiments. The results show that the output peak signal-to-noise ratio of the feature lossless compression of multi-scale fusion saliency color images with this method is higher, and the root mean square error is smaller, which improves the feature point detection and recognition ability of feature lossless compression.

articleTitle: Study on operation optimization of electric-heat multi-energy system considering clean energy heating
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In Inner Mongolia, China, wind energy is abundant but can not be effectively utilized. To solve this problem, China puts forward the policy of using wind energy and other clean energy heating. Based on this policy, this paper proposes a two-stage robust economic dispatching model for regional clean energy heating. In this paper, the uncertain characteristics of solar energy and load side are determined based on historical data, and a two-stage robust optimization model for regional clean energy heating is constructed. The model is solved by column constraint and generation (CCG) algorithm. At the end of this paper, according to the data of the electric clean heating project in Mengdong, a case study is conducted to prove the economy and effectiveness of the two-stage robust optimization model for regional clean energy heating in terms of renewable energy consumption.

articleTitle: A method of generating Key.Net sub-pixel key-points by local gradient fitting
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new approach for sub-pixel registration based on Key.Net combined with a local gradient fitting method. Considering Key.Net of pixel-level accuracy cannot meet the need of high-precision image matching, we innovatively calculate the gradient of the response values of key-point and its neighbors in the response map obtained from the Key.Net, which effectively avoids errors caused by factors such as illumination and shadow for gray value calculation by traditional gradient methods. We first apply the Key.Net detector to extract multi-scale key-points from input images, then build response a map using response values of all pixels on each scale plane and calculate the sub-pixel offset of a pixel-level key-point based on the local gradient relations of the key-point and its neighbors in the response map.
