Finally, we get the sub-pixel coordinates of the key-point. The experimental results show that the proposed method successfully matched some low-quality images and detected large numbers of correct matching points. The localization accuracy of key-points was improved to 0.1 pixels, while the excellent feature detection ability of Key.Net was retained. When testing using the HPatches sequences dataset, our method achieved the highest matching score for view-point, which is 15.5% higher than SIFT, and 0.6% higher than Key. Net-HardNet after increasing the number of scale layers.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Auxiliary Software Platform for Prediction of Coal Shipping Price Index
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper examines the index calculation model and illustrates the technology used to determine the price of coal for coastal shipping. The software hierarchy design of the shipping price index forecast and analysis system is carried out using the MVC model. Additionally, the software’s function module is designed. Echarts technology enables data visualization, and the data cache mechanism alleviates server load during data retrieval. Additionally, the system is created and implemented. It enables the use of more representative sample routes when compiling freight indexes, as well as index prediction, analysis, and report document generation.

articleTitle: Quenching circuit for SPAD detectors based on monostable trigger
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Single Photon Avalanche Diode(SPAD) is a common single photon detector in laser ranging field because of its ultra-high sensitivity and the ability of remote target detection and imaging. In this paper, aiming at the avalanche current suppression problem of SPAD, the interface circuit based on MOS tube and the SPAD active and passive mixed quenching circuit based on monostable trigger are designed and simulated, which realize the rapid quenching and extraction of SPAD avalanche signal, eliminate the influence of after-pulse, and improve the single photon detection efficiency of SPAD. The results show that the quenching time of the active and passive hybrid quenching circuit designed in this paper is 478ps and the death time is 4.8ns, the maximum photon count rate is close to 188Mcps, which can meet the application requirements of laser detection and imaging.

articleTitle: Sparsity Regularization Model Based on Network Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Neural networks are widely used in image classification, but there is an overfitting problem in image classification using neural networks. Regularized sparse models can solve the problem of overfitting in modeling. Many existing regularization methods directly use L1 parametric as the regularization penalty term, but Ll regularization is mainly designed to remove redundant weights, and its performance in removing redundant nodes is not satisfactory. There are also some research works based on the Dropout regularization method to remove the nodes in the network in a completely random way, and the resulting local network lacks the discriminative property for different samples. For these problems, a sparse regularization model based on the network structure is proposed, using an optimized L1/2 parametric as the penalty term of the loss function for removing redundant weights; at the same time, sparsity and relevance restrictions are introduced to the nodes of the neural network during training, and the probability of nodes being removed is chosen according to the magnitude of both, so that the network removes nodes with low activation value and high relevance with higher probability to retain The experimental results on the public dataset show that the regularization model in this paper has better generalization ability than the traditional method.

articleTitle: A method for determining the status monitoring objects and parameters of complex systems from aspects of function level and component level
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper presents a method of how to select the equipment condition monitoring objects and parameters of complex system equipments. The method determines the condition monitoring objects and parameters from the two levels of function and components. At the functional level, the monitoring objects and parameters of the system are identified by using the method of funtion-based-fault mode and effect analysis (FMEA); at the component level, FMEA and risk analysis (RA) are used to ascertain the Maintenance significant items (MSI). Then, we use Analytic hierarchy process (AHP) method to determine the priority order of MSI. This paper takes the on-board equipment of train operation control system as an example. At the function level, on-board equipment can be divided into six functional modules and the condition monitoring parameters are determined by using the method, funtion-based FMEA. At the component level, eight MSI are selected based on the results of FMEA-RA and the priority of these eight MSI is finally determined based on AHP, which lays a foundation for condition-based maintenance (CBM) of complex system equipments.

articleTitle: Multi-Time Scale Collaborative Optimization of Distribution Network Based on Photovoltaic Generation Clusters
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The large-scale access of distributed renewable power sources poses a huge challenge to the planning and operation of traditional power distribution systems. In order to improve the consumption capacity of renewable energy and the stability of system operation, this paper proposes a multi-time scale collaborative optimization method for the power distribution network based on photovoltaic power generation clusters. Based on the idea of cluster collaborative optimization, this method divides dispersed photovoltaics into photovoltaic power generation clusters, and constructs a day-ahead, intra-day collaborative optimization model for the distribution network with virtual power plants. Where, the day-ahead optimization model takes the economics in the operation of the power distribution network and the revenue of the virtual power plant as the main objectives to ensure the benefits of users; The intra-day optimization model evaluates the risk of node voltage overrunning and branch power flow overrunning in the system, which uses evaluation value as a safety target to achieve the safety of the power distribution network’s intra-day operation. The improved IEEE34-node system is used for testing, and the test results of calculation examples verify the correctness and effectiveness of the model and method in this paper.

articleTitle: Multi-target Pedestrian Tracking Based on YOLOv5 and DeepSORT
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Target detection and tracking are crucial in autonomous driving and intelligent transportation, especially in pedestrians and traffic safety. The dynamic pedestrian tracking algorithm using YOLOv5 and DeepSORT is proposed to improve accuracy and robustness, based on the classical tracking-by-detection approach, to achieve real-time monitoring and tracking of pedestrians in the video. The YOLOv5 algorithm is used for pedestrian detection in the video. The YOLOv5 algorithm is used to detect the pedestrian targets in the video and calculate the pedestrian distance to assess the risk. The detected pedestrian features are tracked in real-time using the DeepSORT algorithm to complete the pedestrian trajectory tracking. The experimental results show that the method is effective in detecting pedestrians when coping with the problems of abrupt and rapid movement, occlusion, and appearance deformations, which is suitable for online real-time tracking of pedestrians.

articleTitle: Takeover Performance and Workload under Varying Automation Levels, Time Budget and Road Curvature
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In SAE Level 2 (L2) and Level 3 (L3) automated driving, drivers are required to take over control from automation when reaching system boundaries. The length of time budget is the vital parameter that needs to be determined to ensure a safe takeover manner. Existing literature on this issue rarely considers potential interactions between time budget and other factors, and a variable time budget seemed to be paradoxical in critical unplanned transitions. To this end, this study investigated drivers’ takeover performance and workload under varying automation levels, time budget and road curvature. We employed the operational design domain (ODD) exiting event as the transition scenario where the ego car was about to leave the highway. Results showed that drivers in L3 takeovers performed worse and elicited higher workload than L2 when entering a curved ramp with a limited time budget. Takeovers when entering a curved ramp yielded worse performance and higher workload, as compared to entering a straight ramp. Such detrimental effects caused by loss of situation awareness (SA) and change of road curvature can be mitigated by increasing the length of time budget. All these findings suggest that even in simplified ODD exiting scenarios, the length of time budget should vary according to the state of the driver and the environment.

articleTitle: Detection of Power Line Insulator Based on Enhanced YOLO Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As a special insulation device, insulators play an important role in aerial transmission lines. It can be easily influenced by the wind load, snow load and wire swing in severe weather. The fault of the insulator will seriously affect and destroy the safety and normal operation of the entire transmission line. Therefore, in the operation and inspection of the transmission line, the detection of insulator defects must be strengthened. Since the insulators are constructed in a complex environment and the background of the images collected by air is also extremely complicated, traditional defect detection methods rely on specific scenarios for specific analysis and the robustness is weak. Changes in scenes, changes in UAV’s shooting angles, and changes in lighting conditions will all make it difficult for the model to get good inspection results. This paper proposes an algorithm for locating and detecting insulator defects based on an enhanced YOLO model. Due to the electromagnetic interference during the power inspection of the UAV, there is a certain amount of noise in the image of the aerial insulator. At the same time, in order to solve the problem of few shots which leads to training difficulty, this paper uses a variety of data augmentation, including affine transformation, Gaussian blur processing, gray scale transformation, brightness and contrast transformation and random erasing of pixels, and then the augmentation data is used to train different YOLO models. The results show that the detection algorithm based on the YOLO model meets the robustness and accuracy of insulator defect detection, and augmented experiment results are better than those of the conventional YOLOs in power line insulator defect detection tasks.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-based Platform of Housing Provident Fund Asset-backed Securitization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a platform of housing provident fund asset-backed securitization based on blockchain to solve existing problems caused by opacity and barrier of data. Firstly, we introduce the system architecture consisting of four parts corresponding to different functions. Secondly, the specific program is illustrated in different modules during the whole life cycle of housing provident fund asset-backed securitization. Lastly, a real pilot project in Chongqing is introduced to prove the feasibility and benefit of the platform design. This platform realizes both the efficiency and data transparency under the premise of security with the help of blockchain technology.

articleTitle: Applications of the Decentralized Finance (DeFi) on the Ethereum
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the popularity of blockchain technology, more and more financial fields are ready to apply or have applied the blockchain technology to achieve technological upgrade. The Ether is the most popular platform which we can establish the smart contract to apply the blockchain technology. Decentralized financial DeFi is an important part of realizing the blockchain technology upgrade in the financial application. Based on blockchain technology, this paper introduces the basic working principle of blockchain and Ethernet. Then explains how it provides the technical foundation for decentralized finance as a technical innovation. It then proposes the advantages that DeFi apply in the financial sector and how it can bring benefits to individuals or enterprises based on the features of blockchain such as decentralization, no personal tampering and automatic information uploading.

articleTitle: 3D Object Detection Based on Multi-view Adaptive Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that multi-view features are difficult to fuse effectively, a multi-view feature adaptive fusion 3D object detection framework is proposed, and new solutions are proposed in two aspects: depth feature fusion and loss function design. It mainly cooperates the bird’s-eye view and cylindrical view, carries out adaptive feature fusion on the premise of considering the interaction between views and the contribution of different view features to the detection task, and improves the importance of network learning structure information and local features through the information of two additional tasks: foreground classification and central regression, At the same time, the loss calculation is optimized in the detection process to improve the regression effect of the target boundary box. Experiments on KITTI dataset show that this method achieves higher performance in all single-stage fusion methods, is better than most two-stage fusion methods, and achieves a good balance between speed and accuracy on KITTI benchmark.

articleTitle: Accurate Identification of Infrared Ship in Island-Shore Background Based on Visual Attention
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Infrared ship identification is incredibly challenging in the island-shore background due to the high intensity of the island and shore in the infrared image and low contrast between background and ship. Interference of complex background leads to low accuracy of infrared ship identification. This paper proposes an improved YOLOv5 model based on visual attention to identifying infrared ships in the island-shore background. The Convolution Block Attention Module (CBAM) is first integrated into YOLOv5 to focus the network on informative parts. Then, we use dilated convolution to enlarge the receptive field and obtain more detailed context information. In addition, the K-means clustering algorithm is utilized to select the initial anchor boxes that are more appropriate for our dataset in order for the network to regress the bounding boxes of the ships accurately. The experimental results show that the AP result of the proposed method is 0.872, which is 2.2% higher than YOLOv5. Our method effectively suppresses the interference of complex island-shore backgrounds and improves the accuracy of infrared ship identification.

articleTitle: Multi-View Depth Estimation with Color-Aware Propagation and Texture-Aware Triangulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: PatchMatch-based multi-view stereo relies on photometric consistency to estimate the depth map for each view. However, due to the matching ambiguity introduced by photo-consistency metrics, it often lacks completeness on textureless areas. In this paper, we propose a novel Multi-View Stereo algorithm for the multi-view depth map estimation problem. First, assuming local areas with similar colors are on the same piecewise plane, depth hypotheses are propagated with color-aware weights during PatchMatch propagation. Second, we propose a texture-aware triangulation to generate reliable planes to approximate the textureless regions, which helps to decrease the matching ambiguities in textureless areas. Moreover, a probabilistic filter is proposed aiming to optimize the estimated depth map with small speckles. The effectiveness of our method has been validated on the ETH3D benchmark. Experiments of our method show competing performance against the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: Overview of Distributed Storage of Power Grid Control Resources Data
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the successive promotion and deepening of the building of smart grid, the real-time data access is becoming larger and larger, and the lots of different data generated by behavior of power grid and hardware detection is also increasing exponentially. Therefore, how to effectively store these power grid control resources data has become a very important and challenging issue of common concern in both industry and academia. Given the great application and research significance of the power grid control resources data storage, it is necessary to summarize the current situation and challenges for storing of the big data in the power grid application system, so as to provide a valuable reference for the construction of relevant applications in the future. In this overview, we first introduce the sources and characteristics of power grid control resources data, and then analyze the requirements, objectives, and challenges of the storage of power grid control resources data. On this basis, the current mainstream system of the distributed storage of power grid control resources data are introduced in detail.

Author Keywords: the storage of big power grid data

articleTitle: Classification of Mobile Encryption Services Based on Context Feature Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Smart phones have become the preferred way for Chinese Internet users currently. The mobile phone traffic is large from the operating system. These traffic is mainly generated by the services. In the context of the universal encryption of the traffic, classification identification of mobile encryption services can effectively reduce the difficulty of analytical difficulty due to mobile terminals and operating system diversity, and can more accurately identify user access targets, and then enhance service quality and network security management. The existing mobile encryption service classification methods have two shortcomings in feature selection: First, the DL model is used as a black box, and the features of large dimensions are not distinguished as input of classification model, which resulting in sharp increase in calculation complexity, and the actual application is limited. Second, the existing feature selection method is insufficient to use the time and space associated information of traffic, resulting in less robustness and low accuracy of the classification. In this paper, we propose a feature enhancement method based on adjacent flow contextual features and evaluate the Apple encryption service traffic collected from the real world. Based on 5 DL classification models, the refined classification accuracy of Apple services is significantly improved. Our work can provide an effective solution for the fine management of mobile encryption services.

articleTitle: Device Action Prediction Based on K-means and Apriori for Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper proposes to use K-means and Apriori to prediction device action based on time in Smart Home System. In the existing methods, the system provides services to human when conditions are met, such as high temperature and low humidity. However, those methods ignoring the correlation between device action and human activity time. In order to solve this problem, we combine K-means and Apriori algorithm to generate association rules with time information. First, calculate the appropriate K-value for K-means. We select consecutive data in weeks. The data contains the time information of device action. Second, run K-means to classify based on device action time information, and run Apriori to mine association rules based on classification. Finally, decode the associate rules and realize device action prediction. In our work, K-means experiments show that clustering according to the difference of working days is an effective way to process user time information; Apriori experiments proved that the association rules mined with the results of K-means can predict device actions in the Smart Home environment.

articleTitle: Leakage Location Method of Water Supply Pipe Network Based on Integrated Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Concerning the problem that selecting the monitoring points and locating the leakage points accurate in the water supply network, a method of locating leakage points based on integrated neural network model is proposed. Based on the similarity of water supply pipe network node pressure, a fuzzy C-means clustering fusion algorithm (FCMCF) was used to select the limited monitoring points, instead of randomly selecting monitoring points; on this basis, according to the distribution structure of water supply pipe network, the hydraulic simulation was carried out by using EPANET pipe network adjustment software, and the water pressure of all nodes before and after leakage was obtained 24hours, the integrated neural network combining the convolutional neural network (CNN) and long and short time memory network (LSTM) was used to locate the leakage points of water supply pipe network. In the experimental part, the application of a model LangXi County Xuan City, an area of underground water supply pipe network leakage problem, through FCMCF selected five monitoring stations, using EPANET software simulate the 396 kinds of fault state, through the integrated neural network model training and testing, finally realizes the accurate positioning of the leak, model accuracy reached 90.25% and loss rate of the model is up to 20.24%. Compared with the empirical mode decomposition (EMD) combined with LSTM structure, the accuracy of the model is significantly improved, while the loss rate is significantly reduced. The experimental results show that the leakage location method of water supply pipe network based on integrated neural network can effectively solve the problem of actual leakage location.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Improvement Strategy of Regional Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to further guide the construction, transformation, operation and maintenance and management of urban and rural distribution networks, and to comprehensively promote the improvement of power supply reliability indicators, lay a solid foundation. Improve the quality of equipment, improve the level of power outage management and control, and increase the application of non-interruption operations. According to the current situation of power supply reliability of a domestic power supply bureau in the past three years, according to the number of outages, outage time, and outage scope, research is in line with the reliability assessment method of the region, and proposed Suggestions for improving the reliability of power supply in this area.

articleTitle: Fatigue Detection Using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The development of motor market during the last few years has already shown the inevitable trend of artificial intelligence. Fatigue detection, among other functional requirements, is more and more urgently demanded for modern vehicles. This paper focuses on recent studies and results regarding fatigue detection using machine learning methods. We divided machine learning into classic machine learning algorithms and deep learning using neutral network algorithms. We make comparisons among different algorithms and conclude their drawbacks and advantages. Hopefully, this paper will help to find effective machine learning approaches for improvement and feasible recommendations on fatigue detection.

articleTitle: An intelligent floating bridge system with strong maneuverability on the sea
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Floating bridge is a kind of river crossing traffic facility with a long history. Because of its simple structure, fast erection speed, and strong maneuverability, it is widely used in the fields of military transportation and water emergency rescue. As a temporary transportation equipment, the future development trend of floating bridges will inevitably require them to have the advantages of good maneuverability, light structure, generalization, serialization, modularization and reliability, maintainability, and supportability. Because most traditional floating bridges have problems such as large size, heavy weight, difficult transportation, insufficient maneuverability, and low degree of intelligence, this paper designs and introduces a strong maneuverable marine intelligent floating bridge system. The design adopts generalized modular technology and designed a light-weight pontoon main structure with "inflatable air bag, steel frame, upper and lower panels". The floating bridge designed in this paper adopts new composite materials, electromechanical integration technology and information technology to improve the mobility and information level of the floating bridge. In this paper, the existing algorithm and control system are improved for the floating bridge system, and the process optimization is achieved by relying on the information interaction between the floating bridge units.

articleTitle: Construction and design of visual information platform in human-computer interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper focuses on the construction and design of visual information platforms in human-computer interaction and explores the perceptual user interface, motion perception technology, interaction design methods, and user interface models, and verifies them through visual information platform implementation. The background, definition, and meaning of human-computer social interaction are studied and analyzed, and the conceptual model of human-computer interaction is proposed. In addition, a visual information platform strategy for HCI is constructed from three aspects, namely, needs, behaviors, and emotions, combined with the results of quantitative and qualitative studies such as questionnaires, interviews, and workshops. Based on the validation of HCI theory and interaction design strategy, the feasibility of the design theory and strategy is verified through the design practice of intelligent visual information platform construction and interaction. This paper reinterprets the demand layer, behavior layer, and emotion layer for human-computer interaction design. At the same time, the research on human-computer interaction provides some theoretical basis with a reference value for the commercialization and popularization of visual information platforms. It is innovative, forward-looking, and has certain academic research, industry, and social values.

articleTitle: Single Image Defogging Method Based on Improved Generative Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of blurred image content, reduced contrast, color distortion, loss of information, and degradation of scene images caused by haze weather, an improved end-to-end single image defogging method is proposed. This method can learn transmission map, atmospheric light value and dehazing at the same time, including two stages: physical stage and deep learning stage. Then two kinds of modules are introduced in the second stage, including; attention mechanism and inception. The experimental results show that compared with the benchmark method of this article, the dehazing rate of psnr and ssim in the indoor and outdoor data sets are improved by 0.1 and 2.0 points, respectively. To mention the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Movie Recommendation Algorithm Based on Optimized K-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the advent of the big data era, there is an increasing amount of information available on the internet, resulting in an explosion of information and information overload, making it impossible for users to access the information they want in a short period of time. In this regard, the recommendation system uses algorithmic deep mining of users' personal information and historical data to find out what they want and gives them a list of personal recommendations. The collaborative filtering algorithm looks for users with similar behaviour, the algorithm is not affected by new items and has a better recommendation accuracy in comparison. This paper analyses and compares content-based and user-based collaborative filtering algorithms and adds clustering algorithms to the algorithm's practical optimization process. The collaborative filtering algorithm suffers from poor recommendation accuracy, so the time-based interest calculation is added to optimize the similarity formula. Before calculating user similarity, the clustering algorithm is used to cluster users, aggregating users with similar behaviour interests into a class. Then PCA algorithm is used to reduce the dimension of project attributes, and finally the similarity was calculated by combining the optimized user data to obtain the final Top-N recommendation list. The experimental data were obtained using the public Movielens dataset, with 70% of the data used in the training set and 30% in the test set. The experiments show that the model is effective in extracting user features, while the recall and accuracy of the inference and storage techniques is improved. The hybrid optimization of the kmeans model with collaborative filtering is therefore a great contribution to the development of recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Optimized methods on comparator design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper introduces four types of optimization methods on comparators to improve its performance. The first comparator adopts a triple-latch feedforward design, performing a much lower delay less than 26.8ps. It dissipates 2.2mW at 13.5Gb/s, holding a wide common mode and supply range in less than 70ps delay. Compared to the conventional version with an offset standard deviation of only 2.05mV, the second one improves the speed of the comparator by adding additional parallel paths to the output node, which increases around 50% speed. The third comparator uses a PMOS transistor at the input of the preamplifier of the comparator and the latch stage controlled by a local clock generator, which sets the optimum delay for preamplification at a 30% higher speed and decreases power consumption up to 50%. The fourth comparator presents two designs. Referred to the conventional strong-arm latch topology, the first one proposes a DB integration using a pair of tail capacitor to reach a lower input common-mode voltage and a better power efficiency. However, the design becomes infeasible in specific extreme input voltage corner. To solve the drawback, it puts forward a floating inverter pre-amplifier with reservoir capacitor, which saves seven times energy efficiency to the conventional design.

articleTitle: Code management platform of PLC in tobacco primary processing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As one of the fundamental ideas of software configuration management, reversion control has been widely valued and applied in IT industry. But in the traditional industrial field, this idea has not been widely recognized, and software developers in this field have troubles in code storing, tracking, managing, security disclosure and so on. In order to solve these problems, a two-way encryption reversion control system for tobacco primary processing electronic control is presented. In addition to the implementation of reversion traceability, paralleled code development, modification and update in real time, and unified storage management, in order to eliminate the omission of the code and code leaks in the process of development, additional bilateral control and code encryption were realized.

articleTitle: Missing recognition of highway shading board based on deep convolution segmentation and correction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The lack of highway shading panels poses a major hidden danger to driving safety. It is urgent to study a method that can automatically detect the disease of the anti-glare panel and provide help for the maintenance of traffic safety auxiliary facilities. In the method for identifying the absence of shading panels on highways based on deep convolutional image segmentation and correction, the PointRend model based on deep convolutional networks (CNN) is first used to achieve the pixel-level fine segmentation of the shading plate area, and then the multiple images in the same image are segmented. A shading plate area, on the largest outer polygon estimated by the convex hull algorithm, the optimal outer quadrilateral is determined according to the distance between the vertices, and then the shading plate area correction is completed by affine transformation, and finally through the image one-dimensional projection mapping and adjacent shading The distance correlation between the boards realizes the identification and positioning of the missing light-shielding board. The highway shading plate missing recognition method based on deep convolution image segmentation and correction uses the vertex distance to quickly determine the external quadrilateral, which is suitable for estimating the shape of the area in a dynamic scene. After actual testing and verification, it can accurately and efficiently identify the disease of the anti-glare plate. Compared with traditional image segmentation methods, the method using the PointRend target segmentation model has better segmentation quality for target details, and it is more robust when dealing with background interference.

articleTitle: Underwater target electric field location algorithm based on electric dipole
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the field of underwater complex situation location, electric field location technology has important research significance. This technique needs to establish the forward model of electric dipole positioning. Aiming at this problem, the position of electric dipole in horizontal and non-horizontal states is analyzed and discussed. For the electric dipole in horizontal state, binary image boundary extraction, least square linear fitting and Gauss-Newton iterative method were used for direction finding, while for the electric dipole in non-horizontal state, multi-polarization MUSIC and particle swarm optimization algorithm were used for direction finding. Experimental results show that the above direction finding algorithm greatly optimizes the process of underwater target electric field location algorithm, and improves the accuracy and effectiveness of underwater target electric field location.

articleTitle: Human-machine Collaboration Method Based on Key Nodes of Human Posture
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the personal safety problems in the complex working conditions and high-risk working environments such as high temperature and high radiation in the industrial field, a human-machine collaboration method based on the key nodes of human posture is proposed. First, compare the human pose detection performance of AlphaPose, OpenPose, and HRNet models in complex environments such as different lighting, different human poses, and occlusions, and select AlphaPose, which is suitable for real-time human-machine collaboration, as the basic model of human-machine collaboration; then, formulate standard human actions, establish the mapping relationship between human actions and robot actions; then, use the spatial position data of key human nodes to establish a human action recognition algorithm to calculate the similarity between the action to be detected and the standard human action to identify the human action; finally, real-time control according to the mapping relationship the movement of the robot realizes the collaboration between human and robot. Experimental results show that the average action recognition accuracy of the method proposed in this paper can reach 91.2%, the average action recognition speed can reach 67ms, the average action recognition accuracy under 0-60 Lux illumination intensity can reach 90.4%, and the average recognition accuracy under partial occlusion conditions up to 87.6%.

articleTitle: Blockchain Innovation in the Agriculture Aspect
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Since its birth, blockchain technology has demonstrated promising growth prospects, and its strong functionalities allow it to be used in a wide range of fields, with the potential to bring about revolutionary changes. Within this paper, we'll start with a quick overview of the blockchain, including its role and value in agriculture. After that, concentrate on the four areas of blockchain’s applicability in agriculture. The four aspects are Distributed Agriculture system, Smart Transportation, Blockchain application in product retail and agricultural insurance. Then, we will discuss the Opportunities and Defects of blockchain in agriculture. Finally, we summarize our current work of blockchain technology in the agriculture aspect.

articleTitle: Research on Assembly Precision Prediction Method of Mechanical
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To achieve the assembly accuracy prediction of complex product and provide a basis for tolerance optimization design, this paper analyzes error transfer properties and error accumulation method of assembly joint surface as the key point of error transfer and accumulation. The interactions between associated joint surfaces are analyzed, and the method of solving error transfer properties of joint surface group also the error calculation method of each joint surface is proposed. A new method of describing assembly relationship based on polychromatic sets theory is put forward, named Joint Surface Symbols matrix. Based on the matrix, the error transfer path search method of complex assembly is analyzed and the distribution of key error is determined. Assembly accuracy prediction is achieved by combining with the assembly error model based on multi-body dynamics and the accuracy of parts’ surfaces. At the last part, the feasibility and practicability of the research method is verified by an example.

articleTitle: Reserve sow pose recognition based on improved YOLOv4
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: To address the problems of low accuracy of reserve sow pose recognition and high computational load of the algorithm, a reserve sow pose recognition method based on ESCMobileNetv3-YOLOv4 is proposed in this paper. Firstly, in order to solve the problem of over-fitting caused by unbalanced samples, Few Label Guide Data Augmentation (FLGDA) technique is designed for data augmentation. Secondly, with YOLOv4 as the basic network model, ESCMobileNetv3 is obtained by introducing Extremely Separated Convol in MobileNetv3, which is used as the backbone network of YOLOv4 to improve the recognition accuracy and reduce the number of parameters. Finally, Embedding depth separable convolution in feature fusion and output prediction makes the model further lightweight. Experiments showed that the average recognition accuracy of the lightweight model ESCMobileNetv3-YOLOv4 was 97.44%, 96.43%, 96.57% and 96.89% for the four types of postures of standing, sitting, ventral recumbent and lateral recumbent of reserve sow posture definitions, respectively, and the average recall rate was 95.67%, with the average accuracy mean value reaching 96.83%, which was better than the original The model parametric number is 86.1% smaller than YOLOv4, which saves memory space and facilitates portability to removable devices. The single-frame inference speed on Nvida RTX 2070 is 43.8 % higher than YOLOv4, which improves the efficiency of sow pose recognition.

articleTitle: Autonomous obstacle avoidance assistant system for unmanned surface vehicle based on Intelligent Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In view of the current situation of ship borne automatic identification system, automatic radar and vision based technology applied in the field of ship collision avoidance at home and abroad, there are common shortcomings, that is, it is difficult to accurately identify in the poor navigation environment with low visibility such as night and fog, or in the complex navigation environment with dense targets such as narrow channel and heavy traffic, and the contrast of collected image information is lowDue to the problems of low signal-to-noise ratio and easy missing detection and loss, the intelligent obstacle avoidance system of unmanned surface vehicle based on intelligent vision constructed in this project can not only overcome the adverse environmental factors of fog and improve the perception accuracy;It can also solve the detection problem when the targets are dense and the navigation environment is complex, and obtain more intuitive external navigation environment information.The intelligent obstacle avoidance system of unmanned surface vehicle based on intelligent vision constructed in this project is mainly composed of three parts: visual perception enhancement, obstacle target autonomous recognition and unmanned boat autonomous obstacle avoidance.Firstly, the obtained video image is processed;Secondly, yolov4 target detection network is used to identify and enhance obstacles in video images.Then, the obstacle blocking angle in the image is obtained by computer technology, and the obstacle distance is measured by millimeter wave radar to realize the fusion of vision and radar information.Finally, the intelligent collision avoidance of unmanned craft is realized based on VFH obstacle avoidance algorithm.While solving the problems of the current ship borne identification system, it enhances the type identification effect of obstacles, realizes the effect of accurate identification, and greatly reduces the impact of external interference factors on the safe navigation of unmanned craft. It has high application value and prospect.

articleTitle: Research and design of four axis aircraft based on TM4C123G
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of UAVs, more and more technologies are applied to UAVs. New wing shapes and light materials have greatly increased the endurance of UAVs. The use of advanced signal processing and communication technologies has improved UAVs’ performance. Image transmission speed and digital transmission speed; the application of these technologies has improved the technical performance of UAVs and enlarged the application range of UAVs. With the continuous innovation in the technical field and the strong support of the country, I believe that the update and development of drone technology is becoming more and more perfect, and the future prospects of drones will be infinitely great. With UAV obstacle avoidance and tracking technology becoming the focus of the industry, it has important application value in cruising, tracking and other fields. This project aims to take the interest of drones as the carrier, with the TI Cup competition problem circumventing aircraft as the goal, to explore the UAV obstacle avoidance system. The quadrotor has reasonable structure, small size, light weight, and peripheral hardware circuit requirements. The advantages of low height, relatively simple control procedures, and vertical take-off and landing have made quadrotors more widely used. This project focuses on UAV obstacle avoidance, with STM32 chip as the main control, and elaborates on UAV information reading, calculation and control. This design is based on reality and uses STM32 series single-chip microcomputer as the control core. The real drone of this project realizes the acquisition of information through a number of sensors, and then the drone’s master STM32 chip reads its own sensor data, including the roll angle of the aircraft. , Pitch angle and yaw angle and other key information. After the UAV master control obtains the information, the cascade PID algorithm is used to calculate the speed of the four motors. Finally, the main controller sends the resolved information to the ESC through the interface to adjust the states of the four motors, thereby realizing the control of the flight attitude and ensuring the smooth operation of the aircraft.

articleTitle: Research on Filling Control of Wet Clutch Based on Direct-drive Pump-controlled Actuator
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A novel direct-drive pump-controlled actuator is taken as the research object, and a system method of oil charging control is proposed for the filling phase of the wet dual clutch. First, a dynamic model of the clutch hydraulic actuator in the filling phase is established, and the singular perturbation theory is introduced to decouple the mechanical/hydraulic coupling system into an integral series system to achieve the model reduction. Then, based on the reduced-order model, the active disturbance rejection control algorithm is used to obtain the reference trajectory for motor speed. Finally, in order to track the speed reference trajectory and consider the influence of system parameter perturbation and time-varying load, a linear active disturbance rejection controller of speed loop is designed. The feasibility and superiority of the controller are verified by MATLAB/Simulink platform, and compared with the PID algorithm, which is used in industry. The results show that the tracking performance of the speed loop active disturbance rejection controller is better than that of the PID controller, and it has strong robustness to parameter perturbation and load disturbance, and can make the clutch piston reach the specified position.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Accounting Reform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the advent of the era of artificial intelligence, information technology has been widely used in various industries. The accounting industry has also followed in the footsteps of the times, from the original manual accounting to the accounting informatization. The application of advanced information technology not only improves the efficiency of accounting treatment of enterprises, but also brings some accounting information risk factors to enterprises, which affects the stable development of enterprises. This paper analyzes the technical risks, operational risks and legal risks of accounting informatization in the new era, and then reforms accounting informatization through optical character recognition technology, natural language processing technology, and data mining in artificial intelligence technology. A precautionary strategy is presented for reference.

articleTitle: Multibody Dynamic Characteristics of Non-lightweight Parallel Spring-Tension Rope System of Electric Nail Shooter
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the design stage of the nail shooting device, it is important to understand the response of its key components during the nail shooting process. Multibody dynamics analysis can provide valuable information about these components at different moments of nail shooting. The non-lightweight parallel spring-tension rope system of electric nail shooters includes two non-lightweight springs, one tension rope, one striker, a set of screw nuts, two movable rings, and four rollers, which are connected by tension rope. This study analyzes the multibody dynamics characteristics of the system, establishes the kinematics and dynamics model of the system, derives the dynamic theory equation of the system, and clarifies the main factors that affect the energy of the nail. Aiming for a multibody dynamics study, a model in MSC ADAMS was built taking into account the dynamic interactions of the different components. Define parameter quantification, such as the mass and characteristic curves of springs and strikers, to support problem definition and describe the overall behavior of the system. According to the research results, the kinetic energy of the electric nailing device can be adjusted to provide a theoretical basis for the development of the electric nailing power system.

articleTitle: A Combined early warning model based on the internal and external influence factors of construction safety
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Due to high labor intensity and poor working environment, the accident risk rate of the construction industry is usually higher than that of other industries. Based on the idea that industry safety changes are affected by the internal environment and external environment, this study used the accident data and related economic data from 2003 to 2020 of the construction industry in the United States to establish predictive models respectively, and formed a combined early warning model through D-S evidence theory fusion, which contributes to building safety management. The parameters of GM(1,1) model was carried out through a trial algorithm, and it was found that the error increased by 10.48% for each increase in the number of prediction periods, and T+2 accident prediction has been selected at last. Through job object analysis, the economic environment indicators with CPI as the core were selected, and MIV was used to sort the importance of the indicators. It was found that CPI of education, CPI of transportation and employment scale were the most relevant. After removing the weaker indicators, BP neural network was established, and the error reached 1.83%. Finally, the D-S evidence theory was used for model fusion, MAPE of the D-S model reached 1.47%, and the model performance was further improved. The idea of combining the internal and external environmental impacts of the construction industry's safety will provide new ideas for the study of construction safety prediction, the introduction of MIV for variable screening is also worth learning.

articleTitle: Research of Music Influence Based on Network Science and TOPSIS Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this article, after processing and analyzing the data, we have established an analysis-based music influence characteristic measurement model. The method of network science to judge the influence changes in the process of music development. At the same time, the directed network of artists and followers are established by using a given unique data set. Through data analysis, this article uses the TOPSIS method modified by entropy method to process the artist’s influence model, and analyzes the correlation characteristics, attributes, year, genre and other data between music. Through method principal component analysis, this article obtains the corresponding musical characteristics of the principal components for each year and the musical characteristics of the main component artists of each year, which is used as a model change for artists and their styles, and draws the images of different artists and their works in different eras. And use them to obtain music changes, which will be used as the main reason to identify major changes and significant changes in the model that are consistent with historical development facts. Finally, our team wrote relevant content to express the value of the analysis data on the research, and put forward some suggestions for the model. We are eager to add relevant data to the optimization of the model in historical development. Richer data will make the model results richer and more accurate. This article hopes to complete the prediction of the impact or identify the combination of music culture with the existing time or environment.

articleTitle: IOAS: A Discrete Path Planning Algorithm for Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: For the path planning problem of mobile robots in static environment, there are some problems that the planned path is not optimized enough and it is difficult to solve the environment models with narrow channels or traps. To solve these problems, this paper proposes an Iterative Obstacle Avoidance Search (IOAS) algorithm, which can quickly plan the optimal path and can be applied to various environment models. Firstly, a path network is established by IOAS algorithm, and the nature that the path network must contain the shortest path is proved, and then the Dijkstra algorithm is used to plan the shortest path. In the process of establishing the path network, for reducing the number of the edges, the algorithm uses the positions of the start point and the target point of the mobile robot and the obstacles information to construct the path network, and uses a method to bypass the obstacle when the path collides with them. Experimental results show that by using the path network, the IOAS algorithm can solve the shortest path, and it takes less time to solve the shortest path than using the full path network on large scale problems. At the same time, the IOAS algorithm is better than two state-of-the-art algorithms in the literature on the solving quality.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Approaches to Detect Covid-19 with X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In 2019, the outbreak of COVID-19 impacted on people’s life and the economy around the world. In medical science circle, scientists invented and utilized a reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) to search for this infectious disease. However, due to the hidden disease that spreads fast, the method of RT-PCR did not test for a large number of people in a short period. Therefore, it is urgent for researchers to find an alternation as a method for diagnosis. Deep learning is a crucial method to replace the original way in the medical imaging. The enough images are critical deficiency in the beginning of the outbreak of COVID-19. Moreover, we collect tomography (CT) images and X-ray images from different websites to detect COVID-19. Initially, this method was used to prepare a database of two classes: COVID-19 and Normal, and then comparing different DL models to search for two models that have better performance. Now, the usage of two models could be applied in three classes classification: Pneumonia, COVID-19 and Normal. The two deep learning models we choose (ResNet50 and VGG16) are fine-tuned and trained through transfer learning. The final result is 95.6% of overall accuracy. The accuracy is the most accurate by comparing the different classification algorithms.

articleTitle: Study on Classification System of Rape Root Tumors Based on TPU
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Rape is a very economic plant in China, and its yield is closely related to root tumors. Therefore, it is of great significance to establish a monitoring and grading system for rape root tumors. Aiming at this problem, under the framework of Caffe deep learning technology, which is becoming more and more mature in recent years, a rape root tumor classification and detection system for edge computing is built based on neural network tensor processor (TPU) and FPGA SOC chip. The system not only solves the problem of rape root tumor classification, but also solves the problem between the huge consumption of computing resources caused by deep learning and the limitation of computing resources in edge computing environment. In this paper, a new heterogeneous edge computing architecture, which is equipped with TPU soft core on FPGA SOC chip and works in cooperation with ARM CPU in the chip, is used to accelerate the calculation and improve the accuracy of deep neural network model. Compared with other deep learning edge computing platforms with different computing architectures, it is proved that the system has obvious advantages in accelerating the calculation of small-scale deep neural networks without reducing the accuracy. On this basis, based on the rape root tumor data set provided by Wuhan Oil Research Institute, an effective classification system for rape root tumors is completed. The system has the advantages of high accuracy, low power consumption and fast calculation speed.

articleTitle: Survey of Distributed Transparent Access Control Platform in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Due to the large scale and wide geographical scope of distributed transparent access control platform in power grid, it has brought many challenges to the control of the power platform. In view of the application value and research significance of distributed transparent access control platform, this survey platformatically summarizes the transparent access control algorithms. In order to better introduce transparent access in power grid, we first introduce the progress of transparent access in distributed platform and related aspects, and then introduce the progress of control platform in power grid. Then, we introduce the mainstream distributed access control algorithms used in power platform and analyze the characteristics of each distributed access control algorithm. On this basis, finally, the applications of various distributed access control algorithms are combed in detail.

articleTitle: Agent-based modeling in global pandemic propagation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Agent-based modeling has been widely used in the simulation of global pandemics, which provides useful policy implications and helps contain the pandemic's spread. Through agent-based modeling (ABM), people gain insight into the transmission of the pandemic and develop better policies to contain its spread. This article introduces the existing agent-based models used in the pandemic, such as smallpox, H1N1, and COVID-19, and the conclusions about pandemic forecasting that the scientists have reached through ABM. The introduction also shows the development and improvement of ABM as the computational power increases. It has been concluded from the existing research that implementing contact tracing and lockdown regulations could contribute to the achievement of digital herd immunity and contain the spread of the pandemic. Currently, scientists are dedicated to making a more scalable version of the agent-based model to analyze the transmission of the virus on a global scale.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of GPU-based parallelization of spiking neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Spiking neural networks are sparse, parallel and bionic, which are widely used in deep learning. As spiking neural networks grow, the time cost of training the spiking neural network becomes larger. GPUs, as general-purpose computing hardware, are accessible and suitable for parallel computing, which can effectively accelerate the training of spiking neural network models. However, existing training methods of spiking neural network did not yet make full use of the GPU’s memory, threads, and other resources. We proposed a novel parallelization strategy of training spiking neural network model on GPU to address these issues, including a novel layer-driven simulation strategy based on time-driven and event-driven. This strategy converted the process of serial input into the process of parallel input and avoided a large number of spike-free operations by detecting spikes by layer, while proposing a data pre-caching technique to optimize the transfer and computation time, which effectively improved the computational efficiency of the GPU. Experimental results on the GeForce 2080Ti showed that the proposed strategy was more efficient than the traditional simulation strategy, and the strategy worked well on different datasets, with an absolute speedup ratio of 2.22 on the MNIST dataset and 6.26 on the Caltech Face/Motorbike dataset.

articleTitle: Classification of Chinese Text in the Power Field Using FastText with Electric Power Keywords
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Text classification has always been a hot research topic in the field of natural language processing. Fasttext is a model which is simple in structure and has the advantage of fast and efficient. In order to analyze the situation of electric power intellectual property in recent years, this paper use the model of FastText to process Chinese electric power core journals and patents in recent five years. The text information in the company's intellectual property rights is divided into a series of phrases representing individual meanings though word segmentation basing on the Jieba word segmentation tool. The stop words unrelated to the power industry in the phrases are removed, and the word related the power industry frequency corresponding to the phrases and the frequency of occurrence in the text are counted. According to the characteristics of power industry word aggregation, the phrase can be divided into 26 categories. The text classification model based on keywords of power industry was designed, and the machine learning algorithm Fasttext is used to complete the text classification. Based on each subdivision field of power, the publication situation of intellectual property is analyzed and counted, and the results of power system intellectual property are visualized.

Author Keywords: Chinese electric power articles and patents

articleTitle: Mechanical Performance Analysis of Bridges Based on Improved Damage Algorithm and Intelligent Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Top load-bearing arch bridges are widely distributed in China because of their beautiful structure, harmony with the surrounding environment, and excellent seismic performance. With the development and development of the national economy and technology, the span of the arch bridge continues to increase. Considering the material nonlinearity of the arch bridge, the shrinkage of concrete and the influence of temperature, the arch bridge will become very complicated. In addition, especially in the construction process, the design process of the long-span top arch bridge is complex, the construction process is numerous, and the construction quality is very high. In order to ensure the safety of the bridge structure during the construction process and the bridge operation process. The purpose of this paper is to study the mechanical performance analysis of bridges based on improved damage algorithm and intelligent simulation. This paper analyzes the concept and characteristics of intelligent simulation, the basic composition of intelligent simulation system, the dynamic analysis theory of CFST arch bridge and the calculation theory of static performance of CFST arch bridge, and the experimental results are obtained. The empirical analysis results show that after using the improved damage algorithm and intelligent simulation, the mechanical performance of traditional bridges has been greatly improved, and we conducted a questionnaire and found that more than 88% of people felt that the analysis of the mechanical performance of bridges was applied to the improved damage algorithm. And intelligent simulation, found that the design efficiency has become high.

articleTitle: Clustering and Evolutionary System Analysis of Data Mining Algorithms in the Field of Football
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Football is a competitive sport in China. It plays an important role in modern sports. Its development level directly affects people's health. In recent years, with the advent and popularization of economic globalization and the information age, athletes pay more attention to their own achievements. Therefore, it is particularly necessary to analyze and study the competition rules. Firstly, this paper introduces clustering mining and expounds the development of data mining. Then, the application of clustering mining technology is studied, the system structure of information clustering mining in the field of football is designed, and the relevant information of football players in a football club is extracted for testing. Finally, the test results show that the system can mine specific information from a large number of messy information data, and can effectively analyze the data value and present it to football trainers.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Global and Local Vibration of New Scientific Research Ship Based on MSC. Patran & NASTRAN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: MSC.PATRAN & NASTRAN is used to establish the detailed finite element model of the new scientific research ship and calculate the overall and local ship vibration mode. Comprehensively calculate and analyze the excitation frequency of possible resonance of the ship under the main excitation forces and excitation moments such as full swing pod and generator set under different working conditions, which provide data support for a comprehensive understanding of the ship vibration level in the later stage.

articleTitle: Intelligent Path of Machine Translation Based on MATLAB Simulation Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Machine translation is a branch of computer technology and plays an important role in the information age. With the advent of the era of artificial intelligence, artificial intelligence is constantly breaking through itself. The research of machine translation is an important, complex and challenging problem in the development of intelligent robot technology. For this reason, the purpose of this article to study the intelligent path of machine translation based on MATLAB simulation technology is to improve the accuracy of machine translation, in order to achieve the effect of not causing misunderstanding. This article mainly uses the experimental method and the comparative method to carry on the statistics and analysis to the machine translation intelligent path planning and its effect. Experimental data shows that the translation accuracy of the system is above 70%. This shows that the ability of machine translation needs to be improved. At the same time, the longer the sentence, the worse the translation quality. This reminds us that more in-depth research is needed.

articleTitle: Study of Mechanomyography-Based Wrist Movement Classification with Repeatedly Wearing a Signal Acquisition Armband
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: For the field of rehabilitation engineering, pattern recognition of human movements based on mechanomyography (MMG) has certain application value in control of prosthetics, exoskeleton robot and human-machine interaction (HMI). Currently in most experiments, multi-channel MMG are collected by the method of just wearing signal acquisition device at one-time. However, repeatedly wearing the signal acquisition device will affect the signal since the sites of sensors and contact pressure inevitably changes. In this study, an experiment is designed to collect MMG of forearm by repeatedly wearing an acquisition band. support vector machine (SVM) and artificial neural network (ANN) are adopted to build the classifiers for wrist movements, and a novel cross validation method is utilized to evaluate the recognition results. When using 10 time domain features, the performance of ANN is approximate to SVM in the aspects of test subsets and subjects. And using 5 specific time domain feature subsets can obtain classification accuracy similar as using all 10 features. The results demonstrate that although the classification accuracy decreases, it is still feasible to achieve the recognition of wrist movement on the condition of repeatedly wearing the acquisition band.

articleTitle: An Improved Monkey Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Monkey swarm algorithm is generated by simulating the monkey climbing process. The update process is easy to operate and suitable for solving complex practical problems. In order to further enhance its optimization ability, this paper presents an modified monkey swarm algorithm. Using the chaos variables generates the initial feasible solution of the monkey algorithm initially, the decreasing factor is then taken as the climbing step in the climbing process to improve the performance of monkey swarm algorithm. Finally, in the simulation experiment, the solution results of typical functions are given to illustrate the feasibility of the proposed improved method.

articleTitle: Tourism Data Clustering Analysis Based on Random Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Due to the rapid development of the computer and the rapid popularization of the network, people produce a large number of product information on the digital Internet and show an explosive increase, and is moving towards the era of big data analysis. How to use computers to do this, in today’s data age, the effective organization, management and knowledge discovery of seemingly unrelated data is very important, is an important and urgent problem in today’s data age. In order to solve the tourism data clustering of the random forest algorithm, this paper adopts to verify the effect of the improved sample similarity calculation method by using the data set in the UCI database. The results show that, Compared with traditional methods, this method has better fitting and prediction effect.

articleTitle: The Cloud Radiation Forcing Prediction Based on Textural Feature Extraction from Cloud Image
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The intermittency and instability of the solar energy resource brings great challenge to the accurate forecasting of the surface solar irradiation. In this work, based on texture characteristics analysis of sky image collected by TSI combined with SVM model, a new methods for the forecasting of cloud radiative forcing was presented. First, the texture characteristics related to solar irradiation were extracted from sky images through image processing technologies, including contrast, entropy, grayscale and energy; Then regression model was built between image characteristics and irradiation reduction coefficient; Finally, the SVM model was used to forecasting cloud radiation forcing. The experiment results indicated that: the forecasting accuracy of the method based on texture characteristics tends to provide better a performance than traditional forecasting method and forecasting method based on cloud block movement prediction. It can provide important reference for the accurate forecasting of surface solar irradiation on complex climate conditions.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Production Visual Report Subsystem Based on Echarts
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: According to the actual business requirements of a production data statistics, this paper designs and implements a production visual report subsystem. The system mainly applies Echarts technology to realize the report visualization, and adopts Sringboot framework to separate the web page and the server. This system solves the problems of poor real-time and low flexibility which exist in original manual statistics and reporting. It can help administrative staffs to quickly obtain information from massive production data, and it is easier for managers to find the changing trend of manufacturing data and quality data.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Artificial Intelligence Machine Translation System in the Sci-tech Journals
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of artificial intelligence in natural language processing technology, machine translation based on "deep learning technology" has completely transformed from traditional machine translation methods to neural network machine translation methods. The article mainly introduces the engine allocation, development advantages, thesaurus maintenance, and service realization of the multi-engine Web machine translation system. In particular, it introduces the characteristic verb-driven algorithm and methods and strategies to improve the efficiency of grammatical analysis. By using automatic evaluation indicators to test the sci-tech journal translation fusion system, the results of the sci-tech journal translation fusion system are better than a single rule system and a statistical system The results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the fusion method, which can improve the translation performance and quality of the translation system of sci-tech journals.

articleTitle: Multi-object and single-time self-optimizing crane robot
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper designs an autonomously controlled crane robot based on machine vision. The hoisting machine can identify and classify the objects in the storage area according to the order specified by the rules, place them in the storage area inside the machine in an orderly manner, and follow the specified path through the obstacles to reach the stacking area by tracing and avoiding obstacles, and drop the corresponding objects. Realize the picking, stacking, unloading of different types of items and placing them in the target area, with good effect, high accuracy and short time.

articleTitle: Design of Rudder Controller Based on STM32 and FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Brushless DC motor is widely used in industry, and it is also applied to the digital rudder. This paper aims to design an embedded and miniaturized rudder controller for the embedded applications. In the design, STM32 is used to realize control strategy and data transmission, FPGA and MOS tubes are used to realize motor commutation and motor drive, the separation of the two parts helps to improve anti-interference and universality. Furthermore, hardware design, control strategy and software logic are discussed in the article, and the modeling and simulation result means that the controller has a good performance. The project practice shows that the design has development and application value.

articleTitle: Analysis of Magnetic Field Leakage and Eddy Current Loss of Power Transformer Oil Tank
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for electrical energy, power transformers, as an indispensable and important equipment in the power grid, are bound to develop towards larger capacity. At the same time, the transformer stray loss and eddy current loss caused can easily affect the normal operation of the transformer. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze the leakage magnetic field and eddy current field of metal structural parts of power transformers. In this paper, a large-scale power transformer in actual operation is simulated and calculated by the widely used ANSYS finite element software, and the numerical value and distribution of the magnetic flux leakage of the oil tank are obtained and analyzed in detail. On this basis, the eddy current field of the transformer oil tank is calculated and analyzed, and the density distribution law of the eddy current loss and the magnitude of the eddy current loss are obtained.
