The eddy current loss and the maximum eddy current loss density are reduced by adding a magnetic shield to the transformer oil tank, and the influence of different shielding sizes on the effect of reducing the eddy current loss of the oil tank is given. It provides a basis for designing the transformer oil tank more reasonably and reducing its eddy current loss more reasonably in engineering.

articleTitle: Stm32-Based Intelligent System Experience of Multi-Functional Takeout Jackup Cabinet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, a multifunctional take-out self-lifting cabinet based on STM32 is designed, and various modules and sensors are controlled on the main circuit board of the system, thus forming a complete set of multifunctional take-out self-lifting cabinets with convenience for users. The main control chip of the system adopts STM32F103ZET6 single chip microcomputer, and many external devices such as Bluetooth module equipment, fingerprint identification module, heating chip, cooling chip, transformer and WIFI module are added. The main control chip can realize the intelligent function of multifunctional take-out self-lifting cabinet by using C language to write a software program. This paper focuses on the design of communication port control sensor of STM32single-chip microcomputer [1], the design of power supply circuit and the design of external circuit control heating plate and cooling plate. By realizing intelligent functions such as intelligent heating, refrigeration and fingerprint identification, the dining experience of takeaway users can be greatly improved [2].

articleTitle: Application of Internet of Things Technology in Charging Station Operation and Maintenance Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the context of the global energy crisis and severe environmental pollution, the Chinese government is actively promoting the implementation and development of new energy vehicles. As an important supporting infrastructure for the development of new energy vehicles, charging stations have very important social value and economic benefits. This paper takes electric vehicles as an example to explore the application research of Internet of Things technology in the operation and maintenance management system of charging stations. This article mainly explains the concept and architecture of the Internet of Things technology from the network infrastructure and protocol architecture, detailed analysis and description of each layer in the protocol specification. This article tests the relevant parameters in the network system, including data loss rate test and data transmission time. This paper studies the construction and structure of electric vehicle charging stations, and then introduces the design principles and key technologies of the operation and maintenance management platform for electric vehicle charging stations. These key technologies include communication protocol, development language and development platform selection, software architecture design, etc. The experimental results show that the data loss rate of the networking system is less than 3%, and the transmission delay is about 9ms. Therefore, the data collected in the networking system designed in this paper has the characteristics of timeliness and accuracy, and conforms to the current data information. Requirements can be used in practical applications.

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis for Measured Electrical Signal of Representative Electrical Loads in Chinese Indoor Low Voltage Power Line Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Amount of methods has been employed to research the characters of the electrical signals in several fields of electrical power. Nevertheless, the selected methods are almost posteriori. In this paper, a framework is used to research three basic characteristics (nonlinearity, stationarity and determinacy) of electrical signals in order to provide a kind of priori basis. The basis could make the research method more effective. The electrical signals of three typical electrical appliance loads are collected to be three sets of time series in low voltage power line environment. The basic characters are researched by time series analysis methods. The analysis shows that the electrical signals are almost stationary and nonlinear, and there exists deterministic components in the signals.

articleTitle: Facility tomato picking system based on shelf life prediction and fruit maturity discrimination
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to ensure the best taste and maturity of the picked tomatoes during the market, this paper designed a facility tomato picking system based on shelf life prediction and fruit maturity discrimination. Use the deep learning method to predict the shelf life of tomatoes and distinguish the ripeness of tomato fruits, and calculate the best picking time of tomatoes through the shelf life and fruit ripeness. The use of this system avoids the uncertainty of empirical judgment of picking time, improves economic benefits, and is of great significance to the development of intelligent fruit and vegetable picking.

articleTitle: A recommendation algorithm based on local principle component analysis in mobile wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Modern technological advances have created low-cost, low-power, multi-functional micro sensing devices, which can form a network of thousands of sensors distributed in a wide area After data collection, processing and analysis, sensor networks can obtain information at any time and anywhere, so as to become a part of intelligent environment In a wide range of applications, sensor networks have innovated the sensing function This is because of its reliability, accuracy, flexibility, cost performance, and ease of use The data detected and collected by intelligent sensors may involve machine failures, earthquakes, floods, and signs of terrorist attacks The functions of sensor networks are: collecting information, processing information, monitoring the environment, which can be used for military or civil. Sensor network is a comprehensive technology based on wireless communication, digital electronics, MEMS and so on According to the high dimensionality and sparsity of rating matrix in traditional collaborative filtering recommendation system, a new recommendation model based on Local Principle Component Analysis is proposed in mobile wireless sensor networks to make dimension reduction for different subject genre respectively, and remainsthe real interested users in one specific subject of the web pages.

articleTitle: Study on Consecutive Interpretation Automatic Scoring Model Based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of artificial intelligence and the continuous improvement of hardware performance, the era of intelligence is coming rapidly. Using AI technology to help people deal with various practical problems has become increasingly important and urgent. Among them, the field of alternate interpretation has become a deep water area that artificial intelligence technology needs to conquer. In oral English teaching and automatic scoring, in recent years, reading questions, with questions to answer the automatic scoring system has reached the practical level, and reply, interpretation and a given range of automatic scoring method research is in the initial stage, related research results are less. Interpretation test is a comprehensive test of foreign language application ability, including foreign language thinking ability and language organization ability. Research and development of an effective Chinese-English interpretation automatic scoring system can not only provide students with an interpretation practice platform, but also assist teachers in teaching and release the pressure of teachers on teaching and marking. The paper provides the feasibility test of real test data in a provincial self-study test; using the literature research method, investigation method and quantitative analysis method, the average consensus rate of automatic score model results is 77%, which ensures the effectiveness and reliability of automatic score model based on neural network algorithm and can be fully utilized in the future.

articleTitle: Realize the Off-line Electronic Map in the Area of Electric Institute Based on C#.NET
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, javascript is used to realize the offline electronic map of electric institute based on C#.NET. Considering in various cases, based on the platform of map information system, the 16th to 19th layer geographic information data as the main data source to make an offline electronic map. You can drag the map on the map, there are visual buttons to drag the map, for everyone to find the destination to provide convenience. Although the marking on the map was not realized in the production process, it may not be as intuitive as the site map in the search process, but it can basically achieve most of the functions of online electronic map, and this defect will be further improved in the future.

articleTitle: Product Interactive Communication Design Based on 3D Image Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: with the rapid development of digital technology, the product interactive communication design of three-dimensional image vision has ushered in greater opportunities and challenges. Three dimensional images allow products to be displayed not only in physical stores, but also on mobile terminals, expand publicity methods, obtain more attention and interaction from users, strengthen communication between products and people, break invisible barriers between product designers and users, get more efficient and sufficient user feedback, and then continue to transform products, Form a good closed loop of product development. This paper will analyze the visual advantages conveyed by three-dimensional images, and discuss its vast development space and practical significance for product interaction design.

articleTitle: Application of Quantitative Analysis of Controlled Targeted Drugs for Patients Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the treatment of lung cancer patients, the application of big data technology can help doctors analyze the cause and condition of lung cancer patients in order to make a diagnosis. This article introduces the technology of big data, and explains in detail the technical details of the design and development of the big data analysis system for the quantitative treatment of lung cancer with targeted drugs. This helps to improve the therapeutic effect of targeted drugs on lung cancer.

articleTitle: Research on the Information Management System of Small and Medium-sized Enterprises under the Computer Internet Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This article introduces the three aspects of customer management, inventory management and financial management involved in the information management platform of small and medium-sized companies. It focuses on the information platform architecture and implementation methods based on the internationally accepted File Maker Pro file database. The article uses cloud computing model to realize cloud computing of the overall structure of enterprise management information system, and introduces the system construction of management information system for small and medium-sized enterprises in the cloud computing environment and the implementation plan of enterprises in the cloud computing environment.

articleTitle: Research on High Proportion Distributed Photovoltaic Access Planning Considering the Cost of Relay Protection Configuration Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to ensure the power supply security after a high proportion of distributed photovoltaic is connected to the distribution network. Firstly, the influence of photovoltaic power access on the correct action of the relay protection of the distribution network is analyzed. according to the fault characteristics, an improved scheme based on optical difference protection is given. In the planning of distributed photovoltaic access, taking the lowest total cost of power grid operation as the planning goal and taking power balance and voltage deviation as the planning constraints, a planning model of high proportion distributed photovoltaic access considering the optimization cost of relay protection configuration is established. The improved cuckoo search algorithm is used to solve the model, and different planning models are compared in IEEE33 node distribution system.

articleTitle: Research on Sensorless Control Technology of Switched Reluctance Motor Based on Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to detect the position of switched reluctance motor with high cost and complex structure, a sensorless control algorithm of Switched Reluctance Motor Based on sliding detector is proposed, and the position information of the motor is estimated. In this control technology, the deviation between the measured current and the estimated current is taken as the sliding surface, and the rotation speed and position are taken as the state variables. A sliding observer for estimating rotor speed and position is constructed. At the same time, in order to improve the anti jitter ability of the sliding observation system, the transition smooth saturation function is used. Taking 12 / 8 three-phase switched reluctance motor as an example, the switched reluctance motor model and sliding observer model are established in Matlab / Simulink. The simulation results show that the control method can effectively estimate the motor rotation speed and position, with small error, high tracking accuracy and good robustness.

articleTitle: Prediction of Urban Rail Road Network Scale on Account of Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the context of the continuous popularity of the Internet model, the field of algorithms is also making great strides. Traditional statistics and calculation methods are often used to calculate the volume of urban rail(UR) road network, but today, under the condition of rapid growth of network demand, the traditional methods have been very inefficient and far from meeting the current statistical methods. Then, in view of this practical problem, the prediction on account of algorithm is often used. Using the method on account of algorithm to predict the volume of UR road network shows that it is very efficient, which is the sure result of the development of modern network society. We must attach great importance to the research of algorithm. This paper studies the related problems of UR road network scale on account of genetic algorithm, introduces the definition, tenet and related contents on account of genetic algorithm, explains the related problems and knowledge of UR road network, and demonstrates the UR road network scale on account of genetic algorithm, From the perspective of data demonstration, this paper makes an effective method to predict the volume of UR road network. On account of genetic algorithm, this paper uses relevant means to test the prediction problem. The results show that it has achieved good results. The efficiency of fault tolerance, effectiveness, convergence and accuracy of UR road network scale prediction reaches 87.12%, 91.03%, 94.03% and 98.03% respectively.

articleTitle: AIS-based ship information acquisition and trajectory control system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the popularity of IOT technology, the technology of traditional industry is slowly subject to the limitations of the times. Especially in the field of information acquisition and trajectory control of ships, its excessive reliance on manual a priori experience such as captains and sailors greatly increases the demand for talents in the ship industry. In this paper, we propose and design an AIS-based ship information acquisition and trajectory control system. With the data support of AIS system, we complete the information acquisition and analysis positioning of ship operation system by converting coordinate system design, combine with least squares algorithm to complete the final trajectory seeking control, and build an integrated information acquisition and ship control system. It further improves the information acquisition rate and control transmission rate of the ship, and improves the navigation efficiency and capability of the ship.

articleTitle: Intelligent Recognition Translation Optimization Algorithm Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: At this stage, machine vision (MV) technology is developing rapidly, and good results have been achieved in the fields of text recognition, image processing, and natural language processing. Intelligent recognition translation, as an efficient tool, can perform equivalent conversions between different languages, while still maintaining the original semantics, which has important practical significance. Based on this, the purpose of this article is to study the MV - based intelligent recognition translation optimization algorithm. This article proposes a text recognition method based entirely on convolutional neural networks, incorporates attention mechanism, introduces LSTM with "forgetting" function, and introduces the specific structure of a fully convolutional sequence decoder. This article designs an intelligent recognition and translation system, and introduces the end-to-end recognition and translation module. Experimental data shows that the BLUE values of the method in this paper are 25.57, 25.63, and 25.71, respectively. This shows that the method in this paper has a good effect in text recognition and translation.

articleTitle: Phoneme-based lipreading of silent sentences
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of computer vision algorithms, more and more researches on lipreading have been conducted. Most of them use lipreading as support to speech recognition, and based audible videos to predict words. But complex and long sentences can easily lead to semantic ambiguity and the recognition process relies too much on audio information. In this paper, we designed a special method for lipreading based on phonemes that can predict long sentences without audio information. First, we divide the lipreading task into two processes, phonemes are used as taxonomic units, identify phonemes from images, and then predict sentences from phonemes. Second, we use a specially designed spatiotemporal convolution called TCN to classify phonemes, and informer to convert phoneme sequences into sentence sequences, because the introduction of TCN module helps to extract the contextual information of sentences better, thus reducing the probability of ambiguous recognition. The experiments are compared and analyzed with other lipreading methods, and the results show that our model performs better on GRID, LRS, and LRS2 datasets.

articleTitle: Research on the Symbiosis Mode of Large-scale Sports Events Based on Computer Internet Technology and Intelligent Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This article is based on computer Internet technology and uses symbiosis theory to analyze how to better reciprocate symbiosis and interdependence between sports events and cities. At the same time, the article analyzes the requirements of designing a general community sports management framework based on .NET component technology from the perspective of large-scale urban sports events, thereby optimizing the design and design of a general sports event management information system, and analyzes the benefits of the system framework in practical applications. The research results show that a general sports event management information system is implemented based on the .NET component design, and the positive design value is exerted. Compared with the traditional sports event management information system, the general sports event management information system designed by the framework technology has an application benefit of 18.0%.

articleTitle: Use Deep Residual GAN to Inference 3D Space Thin Film Laser Damage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Laser bombardment damage to thin films is one of the more important topics in optical instrumentation. The distribution and morphology of the damaged spot can be studied to measure the directionality and energy stability of the laser. It can also be used to examine the uniformity and purity of the coating, which is a mutually verifiable experiment. After the laser has finished bombarding, the traditional means is to use interference microscopy to obtain the depth matrix of the damaged area, and many scholars and research institutions have used this method. However, compared to electron microscopy, high magnification optical cameras have a more significant advantage in portability and cost. If a way can obtain the spatial depth matrix of the damaged spot using only an optical camera, it will significantly reduce the cost of research in the discipline. This paper proposes a deep residual generative adversarial neural network to infer damage depth matrix using CCD images. It is found that although our model still has some room for improvement, this may be a bold attempt.

articleTitle: Mathematical Evaluation Model and Intelligent Prediction Research about Health Status Based on SSA-DBN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Mental health will affect college students' intellectual quality, personality growth and physical health. The traditional mental health test standard has some limitations, in addition, the evaluation and identification of mental health problems are essentially nonlinear classification problems. Therefore, this paper introduces the method of neural network to study. Firstly, the classical deep belief network is used to analyze the survey data. Secondly, the sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is used to optimize the number of neurons in the hidden layer of DBN, so as to solve the problem of difficult selection of hidden layer parameters of DBN model, and establish an assessment and prediction model of college students' mental health based on SSA-DBN, with an accuracy of 96%. Finally, taking the psychological test scores of 16 undergraduate English majors in Nanchang Institute of Science and Technology as an example, judge and analyze the threshold, and give corresponding suggestions and countermeasures, which can provide theoretical and technical reference for psychological educators in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Improved particle filter algorithm based on piezoelectric Lamb wave monitoring characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The prediction of fatigue crack growth by particle filter algorithm is to establish the state space-model of particle filter by using pairs formula combined with state noise model, to establish the observation space model of particle filter by using Lamb and its damage factor monitoring crack growth method combined with observation noise model, and to predict the crack growth by using the state-space model at the same time. In the process of monitoring fatigue crack growth by Lamb wave, the longer the crack is, the greater the uncertainty of the damage factor is. Based on the above characteristics, an observation space model with an observation noise model continuously modified with crack length is established. The hole edge crack propagation experiments are carried out to predict the crack propagation of particle filter algorithm and the improved particle filter algorithm. The experimental results show that the improved particle filter algorithm is not easy to diverge in the later stage of crack propagation, that is, after 25,000 cycles in this experiment. After 27650 cycles, the crack propagation prediction error is only 0.7mm.

articleTitle: No-Reference Image Quality Assessment via Degenerate Decision Logic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this study, a no-reference (NR) IQA method based on degenerate decision logic (DDL) is proposed. DDL uses wavelet transform to extract the wavelet sub-band features of images and then maps these features to higher- level features through a hybrid network, thereby achieving effective extraction of mixing characteristics and avoiding the redundant information of low level features. DDL also adds decision logic to the assessment, combining decision logic differentiation training and fine-tuning training to allow the assessment result to approach that of human subjective cognition as closely as possible. The performance of the proposed DDL method is evaluated on the LIVE database.

articleTitle: Study on Low Temperature Performance of 10kV Vacuum Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, China is making rapid progress, developing and prospering, along with the common progress of high-voltage related industries, because our development also has increasing requirements for electricity, and more and more power demand requires the progress of power system. High voltage vacuum circuit breaker can open and close line load current, overload current and short-circuit current, which plays a very important role. At present, 10kV high-voltage vacuum circuit breaker is generally installed indoors. The research on the performance of 10kV vacuum circuit breaker is mainly focused on the condition of normal temperature, but in the cold area of North China, sometimes the indoor temperature can reach about - 20 °C. The research on the mechanical and electrical characteristics of vacuum circuit breaker under low temperature has important theoretical significance and practical value. In this paper, the low temperature performance of 10kV vacuum circuit breaker is studied by comparing the mechanical characteristics, circuit resistance and AC withstand voltage test data of 10kV vacuum circuit breaker at different temperatures.

articleTitle: 3D geological modeling and numerical simulation of multi-layer tight sandstone gas reservoir
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: China’s multi-layer tight sandstone gas reservoirs have the characteristics of poor reservoir physical properties, strong heterogeneity, low controlled reserves of single well and poor connectivity of effective sand body, which lead to great difficulty in development<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>. However, it is widely distributed. How to effectively improve the development and utilization of tight sandstone gas reservoirs is an urgent research content, and the geological modeling and numerical simulation of the gas reservoir is the basis of development analysis<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[2]</sup>. Therefore, this paper will take the research block of the Shenmu gas field as an example, carry out multi-layer three-dimensional geological modeling based on the basis of understanding the characteristics of the gas reservoir, introduce the detailed modeling process, optimize the modeling method, establish the three-dimensional fine geological model of the block according to the geological static data by using the principle of combining random modeling and deterministic modeling, and establish the fine sand body model and attribute model at the same time, The porosity, permeability, and saturation models are comprehensively analyzed in-plane and section respectively. Then, the fine numerical simulation model of the target block is established, the simulation process is introduced, and the history fitting is completed in combination with the dynamic production data of the research block, which is of great significance to provide the basis for the design of the overall development scheme of the tight gas reservoir.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Industrial Production Scheduling Strategy Based on Intelligent RGV Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper starts from the dynamic scheduling from the point of view, according to the three specific conditions, to judge the working state of R GV and C NC, through the enumeration method List various situations, schedule the R GV, and find the quantity of ingredients and work efficiency. For the material processing of one process, firstly, the optimal RGV feeding order should be determined and the shortest time is found. Since the CNC on the right side of RGV is less than that of the CNC on the left side of RGV, when the RGV reaches a certain position, feed the CNC on the right first, and then feed the CNC on the left side and go to the next position after completion. Then the first process is solved through the 0-1 variable set the working state of RGV and CNC, establish a CNC status matrix, judge C NC working state, and solve the sum of CNC state, if not working, require loading operation, thus determine the time of RGV consumption and CNC consumption, and then substitute the data into the written code to obtain the finished product quantity and CNC working efficiency. For the material processing of the two processes, assuming that the CNC does not need to be replaced with tools within 8 hours, the distribution of the CNC is first determined. Because the two processes are different, and the number of CNC in each process should be balanced, so the C N C installation ratio should not be too large, and the same position priority rule should be used to determine the installation position. After determining the order of up and down of the two processes, the moving logic and up and down logic are determined respectively according to the relevant formula and code, and finally the system work efficiency of all cases is obtained by cycling. In the case of C NC fault, the fault occurrence node and maintenance status duration of CNC are simulated by random number, and the event-driven policy is adopted, Update the status of the CNC and RGV in real time when a fault occurs, and recalculate the target function value, so as to dynamically schedule the RGV according to the fault interference. Considering the above three cases, the RGV dynamic scheduling model and the corresponding solution algorithm suitable for different working parameters, complex processes, and possible fault interference can be obtained.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of Foundations’ Fundraising Ability in Universities Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The education foundations in universities conform to the requirements of college and university construction in the new era, and provide a strong impetus for the construction of double first-class universities, the cultivation of talents, and the development of disciplines. The exploration of the education foundations’ fundraising ability in universities is of great practical significance. At present, domestic and foreign related researches are mostly limited to the level of theory and data statistics. There is a lack of research on the willingness to donate from multiple factors under different donation channels from the perspective of modeling. Neural network has good fault tolerance and strong self-learning, self-organization and self-adaptability. It is advanced in the processing of multiple data and the construction of nonlinear and complex relationships. Therefore, it is an ideal prediction method. Based on the neural network model and starting from multivariate factors, this paper analyzed the donation data samples of one foundation by constructing a mathematical model to simulate the donation process, and analyzed the influence of different factors on the donations of college and university foundations through the experimental results. The purpose is to put forward instructive suggestions for the fundraising of the foundations in universities.

articleTitle: Route Planning Strategy of intelligent car Based on Camera Sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper takes NXP Intelligent Car Competition as the research background and aims at improving the competition results. In the research process, 32-bit single chip microcomputer tc264 was used as the core controller. Camera ov7725 was used as the main sensor, and AURIX Development software was used as the development tool for research. Road detection information was obtained by ov7725 hardware binary camera. The track information processed by SCM was used to fit the center line of the track. Position type pid was used to control the steering gear of the car model, and incremental pid was used to control the speed of the car model motor in closed loop. Finally, the accuracy rate of 80% and good experimental results were achieved. This method has the characteristics of simple structure, high reliability and high adaptability, and it makes preparation for the future intelligentization of automobiles.

articleTitle: BIM-based method for extension and integration of monitoring information for foundation pits and underground engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The article studies the monitoring information integration method based on IFC, sorts out the data structure shared in the BIM platform, masters the relationship and types of BIM data structures, and establishes a BIM data structure library. The BIM data standard (Industry Foundation Classes, IFC) is extended by the method of extending the attribute set, by defining attributes related to the model and mapping the data one-to-one, IFC-related monitoring data is expressed. Furthermore, the method of batch integration of monitoring data into IFC files is studied, and the corresponding IFC file reading and writing program is set up. Through this method, the monitoring information of the foundation pit construction process is integrated on the BIM platform to realize intelligent integration process of BIM-based foundation pit and underground engineering monitoring information. The study provides reference for related research.

articleTitle: Intelligent Construction of Landscape Environment Monitoring System Based on Virtual Reality Technology (VRT)
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the progress of science and technology, VRT has been widely used in the field of landscape environmental monitoring. Based on the theory of VRT, this paper studies and analyzes the existing intelligent platform. Firstly, this paper expounds the function, classification and characteristics of garden landscape environment, then introduces the principle of VRT and monitoring related technical principles, and designs the functional module of garden landscape environment monitoring system based on this principle. The final test results show that the landscape environment monitoring system based on VRT has clear image quality, short data processing time, normal CPU utilization and low connection utilization. This shows that the system can meet the requirements.

articleTitle: A Multichannel ADC Module Design Method Based on DSP and FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A design method of multichannel ADC module based on DSP and FPGA is proposed in this paper, it is used to realize multichannel AD simultaneous conversion, which can be used in embedded and miniaturized analog-to-digital conversion. Furthermore, this article discusses a convenient way to improve the consistency of multichannel AD conversion, which is using standard signal source to adjusting the deviations of DC bias consistency, amplitude consistency and phase consistency.

articleTitle: Research on Informational Sports Data Recording System Based on Computer 3D Digital Modeling Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The article takes the human sports data recording and analysis as the research object. The research and analysis are based on the sports data record analysis modeling simulation system in the case of 3D digital modeling. We first use 3DMax to model and render the human body motion model. Secondly, based on real-time data recording and analysis of human body movement. Finally, the network programming technology is used to build a simulation modeling system for human sports data. The research results show that the simulated sports data recording system has the characteristics of convenient integrated modeling and simulation resources, strong reusability, high flexibility and configurability.

articleTitle: OOXML Document Data Recovery Algorithm Based on Confidence Subset
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This Aiming at the problem of text content data corruption in OOXML documents caused by noise errors during network transmission, this paper proposes a confidence-based document recovery algorithm. Firstly, the algorithm determines the size of the low confidence interval to be recovered by the signal noise ratio, and determines the error subset according to the confidence information provided by the physical layer. All possible combinations of the send sequence are obtained by iterating through the error pattern and extracting the character data through the inflate decompression. Finally, the least number of illegal characters is taken as the criterion to obtain the recovered document content. Simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively improve the data recovery rate of damaged documents by using the underlying confidence information.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Evaluation of the Strategic Alliance of Supply Chain Performance under the Background of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the relationship between supply chain node enterprises affects the performance evaluation of supply chain strategic alliance. According to the Balanced Scorecard performance measurement tool and the Supply Chain Performance Metrics Reference Model of Chinese enterprises, the strategic alliance of supply chain performance evaluation index system is designed, and the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method is used to calculate the example. The results show that each node of the supply chain should build a sharing platform with the help of information technology, strengthen cooperation and trust, improve the effectiveness of information transmission and communication, and reduce information distortion, so as to improve the core competitiveness and competitive advantage of the supply chain and ensure the comprehensive performance level of the strategic alliance of supply chain.

articleTitle: Research on the application of computer vision-based structural deformation monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The continuous development of computer vision has brought vitality to the traditional discipline of civil engineering. Structural deformation monitoring based on digital image processing is a new non-contact measurement method that has come a long way since its introduction in the last century. Based on the research results of computer vision technology, the authors firstly perform a grey-scale transformation, filtering and noise reduction, and image enhancement on photographs collected in the laboratory and use edge detection algorithms for contour extraction. Structural displacements are obtained by combining higher-order polynomial fitting, and indirect structural strains using quadratic differential derivatives. In addition, deformation monitoring of a laboratory model was also completed using sensors. The results obtained were compared with the image processing method, which proved to be satisfactory for simple engineering applications.

articleTitle: Research and System Development of Automatic Guided Vehicle Based on Ultrasonic and Infrared Obstacle Avoidance Technical
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of TV industry, more and more Automatic Guided Vehicles (AGV) have been applied to TV production. The degree of automation of TV production is increasing year by year as the proportion of flexible production line composed of AGVS is increasing, and Hisense is paying more and more attention to AGV. As an important part of the automatic TV production line, the efficiency and accuracy of its tracking and obstacle avoidance affect the whole TV production process to a great extent. The current AGV adopts the single-side obstacle avoidance method, and occasionally it is difficult to detect obstacles and the obstacle avoidance rate is low, which is an urgent problem to be solved in hisense TV production and has attracted great attention. In this paper, the application system of intelligent transport vehicle is designed based on Arduino platform, which can provide a theoretical basis for the improvement and optimization design of AGV applied in hisense TV production line, solve the problems of low obstacle avoidance efficiency and low success rate of AGV, and provide a theoretical basis for the real car test.

articleTitle: Design of Public Landscape Environment Optimization System Based on Niche Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Public landscape is a settlement landscape formed under human intervention, which is both cultural resources and ecological environment resources. Niche genetic algorithm is the most widely used algorithm in modern times. It greatly expands the space of system design and optimizes all links in public landscape environment optimization system design. This emerging technology also meets a wide range of public landscape needs. Starting from the influence of environmental factors and niche genetic algorithm, this paper discusses various links of modern public landscape environmental design in urban environment, deeply discusses the relationship and background between niche genetic algorithm and optimizing public landscape environmental design system, and analyzes the limitations of public landscape design at present, Combined with the research of niche genetic algorithm at home and abroad, this paper analyzes the performance links and characteristics of public landscape environment design system, focuses on its application principles and aesthetic evaluation in improving the efficiency of public landscape environment optimization system, and analyzes and discusses the advantages of this emerging tool in the use of public landscape environment optimization system.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Process and Construction of Domain-specific Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Knowledge graph is the core content of artificial intelligence research in the new era. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence in science and various fields of technology and society, it has attracted the attention of academia and industry. Various fields are actively constructing the Domain-specific Knowledge Graph (DKG). The construction of Domain-specific Knowledge Graph has great application value in intelligent search, intelligent question and answer, intelligent recommendation and other information services. This paper taking the artificial intelligence system development as background, systematically elaborated the origin and composition of Domain-specific Knowledge Graph, finding out that the Domain-specific Knowledge Graph has characteristics of extending the depth and detailing granularity of the knowledge representation of Domain-specific Knowledge Graph. And the development process of Domain-specific Knowledge Graph technology: developing from the symbol and the reasoning model to knowledge engineering, then to an important approach to knowledge representation of big data. The key steps and methods of Domain-specific Knowledge Graph construction are described, including entity recognition and attribute information recognition, and extraction of relationships between entities. The entity recognition technology and relation extraction technology are systematically described to provide some useful references for the construction of Domain-specific Knowledge Graph.

articleTitle: An Operational Value Index of Energy Storage Systems on a Power Grid Side for a Novel Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Configuring energy storage systems on the grid side is of great significance to enhance the flexibility of the power system and promote clean energy consumption. In order to improve the operation effect of energy storage systems on a power grid said, it is necessary to construct an evaluation index for their operation value. Firstly, an initial evaluation index set was conducted based on the grounded theory. A series of intricate indicators information is condensed and summarized into four aspects, including costs and benefits, technology, system optimization and environmental impacts. Then the grey correlate-rough set theory was introduced to select out some key indicators. F Statistical test values are combined with pedigree diagrams to eliminate indicators with redundant information. In the empirical analysis, 13 key indicators were screened to form the evaluation index of energy storage systems operation values on power grid side. The index system construction method proposed in this paper is practical and effective.

articleTitle: Dual-stream infrared object detection network combined with saliency images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Compared with visible spectrum images, thermal imaging has lower requirements for lighting conditions, but it contains many problems (e.g. blurred edges and low contrast). Aims to these defects, a dual-stream infrared object detection network (named DINet) is proposed. In order to bring into play the saliency information of the infrared object, the pseudo-color image is generated from the infrared image. Saliency information is employed as the attention mechanism of our detector. This framework design a dual-stream network with a cross-shaped receptive field aggregation module. It combined with convolutional neural network (CNN) with Transformer to create a local-global complementary dual-stream backbone, which separately extracts the feature of infrared and pseudo-color images. The prediction head fuses the adjacent layers to generate a more refined grid map, which contains high-definition positions and rich semantic information. The experimental results demonstrate that DINet achieves significant performance on infrared object detection benchmark FLIR. The quantitive analysis shows that the mean average precision can reach an excellent level.

articleTitle: Topological Optimization of Automobile’s Control Arm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on SOLIDWORKS, a 3D geometrical model is established for the lower controller arm of a commercial vehicle, after which the mechanical parameters are determined through unidirectional tensile test. Then, based on the improved SIMP model, topology optimization calculation and lightweight design are carried out for the control arm. Finally, static analysis and modal analysis are performed for the model before and after optimization. The results suggest that after the topology optimization, the material of control arm satisfies the static requirements under multiple working conditions in addition to improved utilization ratio. Compared with original structure, resonance concentrates more at low frequency with regard to the characteristic frequency of optimized structure. The proposed method for topology optimization calculation provides not only ideas and suggestions for subsequent optimization of control arm model but also a technological approach of numerical simulation for topology optimization of other similar structure.

articleTitle: System Perspective and Intelligent Information Systems Based on Architecture Design
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper uses architecture design technology and methods for reference, tailor-made a system view structure framework, expounds the mapping relationship between system requirements and system view products, as well as the relationship between system view products, and studies the process and method of system product design.

articleTitle: Research on characteristics of joint control system of large-load space manipulators
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the work of space manipulators, due to the large load and high flexibility of its joints, the overshoot and stabilization time of the manipulator joint control system are seriously affected. Aiming at the problems of poor stability and overshoot of the space manipulator joint joint control system, this article first establishes the joint dynamics model, and analyzes the control effects of joint motor position closed-loop control and absolute position closed-loop control of space manipulator. Then, the effects of joint stiffness, moment of inertia and friction coefficient on the stability of the control system are studied. Finally, the control method of space manipulator is improved by using full state-feedback method. The results show that the joint stiffness, moment of inertia and friction coefficient of space manipulator will affect the stability of joint control system; The absolute position closed-loop control system with full-state feedback can effectively improve the control effect of space manipulator joints.

articleTitle: Read and write methods for programmable chips
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This paper illustrates three common forms of chip’s reading and writing control with a typical programmable chip as an example, and each gives a specific read or write byte case program that can be used as a reference for programming the same type of chip application. We often have to read and write chips in microcontroller control applications, and I have combined my personal practical experience to summarize several forms of reading and writing chips.

articleTitle: Urban Landscape Remote Sensing Image Fusion Based on 3D Box Dimension Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Remote sensing of urban landscape is a comprehensive detection method formed by using human visual characteristics to observe natural laws and man-made things and extract rich information from images. It features visibility, dynamics, and rapid analysis capabilities. We can improve the utilization efficiency of urban land resources and achieve sustainable development through the classification and planning of landscapes. This paper mainly uses the experimental method and the comparative method to analyze the urban landscape remote sensing image fusion in detail. The experimental data shows that the 3D box dimension value of different urban landscapes is around 2.9. Urban landscape remote sensing image fusion is a complex multi-source nonlinear, data point and regional coordinated development problem. The three-dimensional box dimension value measured in this paper is generally high, and it is necessary to optimize the accurate basic data and the calculation methods and algorithms built into the software.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data Technology in the Health Monitoring of the Bridge Body of Cross-river Bridge
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: This article proposes a health monitoring system platform for cross-river bridges based on big data. The system can realize regionalized bridge operation and maintenance management. The system has functions such as registration modification and deletion of sensor equipment, user registration modification and deletion, real-time display and storage of sensor monitoring data, and evaluation and early warning of bridge structure safety. The sensor is connected to the lower computer through the serial port, analog signal, fiber grating signal, etc. The lower computer converts a variety of signals into digital signals through the single-chip A/D sampling and demodulator, etc., and transmits it to the upper computer through the serial port. The upper computer uses ARMCortex-A9 Run the main program to realize multi-threaded network communication. The system platform is to test the validity of the model, and a variety of model verification methods are used for evaluation to ensure the reliability of the big data analysis method.

articleTitle: Mathematical Model and Stability Analysis of Ship Compensation Current System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A mathematical modeling method is proposed to solve the problem of reasonable output of compensation current in the protection technology of ship electric field. The ship and compensation anode are regarded as a control system. The equivalent circuit and mathematical model of the system are established, which takes the shaft-shell voltage as input and compensation current as output. Through the linearization of the mathematical model, the transfer function of the system is determined, and the stability analysis is carried out. Finally, the proportional relationship between the compensation current and the shaft current is obtained. The simulation results show that the proportional relationship is linear and the scale factor is approximately equal to 1.

articleTitle: Graphical Model and Algorithm of Human Resource Optimal Configuration Based on FPGA and Microsystem Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the growth of the global economy, the growth engine of the global economy is gradually shifting from physical capital to human capital. As the carrier of knowledge and skills, people play a central role in promoting economic vitality and promoting social and economic development. The purpose of this paper is to study the image model and algorithm of optimal configuration of human resources based on FPGA and microsystem analysis. This paper analyzes the concept of Japanese human resources, the statistics of human resources and the evaluation of the quality and ability of human resources, and also establishes a model of optimal allocation of human resources, and draws the experimental results. The empirical analysis results show that the performance of the traditional human resources optimization configuration image model and algorithm has been greatly improved after using FPGA and microsystem analysis methods, and we conducted a questionnaire and found that more than 84% of people felt that the design of human resources optimization The configuration image model and algorithm are applied to FPGA and microsystem analysis methods, and it is found that the design efficiency has become higher.

articleTitle: Charge induction dust concentration detection technology based on active charging
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The electrostatic charge induction dust concentration detection method is widely used in typical production dust detection, but the electrostatic quantity of dust particles itself is easily affected by environmental parameters, and the signal pickup is difficult, resulting in relatively large errors in dust concentration detection. In order to further reduce the relative error of dust concentration detection, this paper actively charges the dust particles at the front end of the charge induction to make them charged as much as possible. The dust detection signal signal-to-noise ratio of dust under different charging voltages is studied to find the active charging voltage value that can meet the signal-to-noise ratio detection requirements and will not cause breakdown; The required lower limit of detection of different types of dust. In the same environment, the adjustable dust concentration detection system is used to carry out a comparative test of the dust concentration detection test of active charging and non-main charging, comparative experiments show that the relative error of the active charge induction method for detecting dust concentration is ≤14.2%, which is 4.4% smaller than the error of the electrostatic charge induction method.

articleTitle: Application of Parallel Algorithm of 3D Landscape Model in 3D Landscape Visualization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Visibility analysis is an indispensable part of spatial analysis and plays an important role in many fields of geo-analysis and production and construction. However, the existing visibility analysis based on GIS often pays attention to the visibility of single point but ignores the composite visibility of multiple points, the visibility of static point but ignores the visibility of moving point, the visibility of straight line but ignores the visibility of curve. This paper mainly studies the application of parallel algorithm of 3D landscape model in 3D landscape visualization. This paper mainly uses the parallel algorithm of 3D landscape model to study and analyze the landscape design of mountainous agriculture in China, establishes the three-dimensional landscape visualization, fully expresses the regional culture in the planning and design of agricultural landscape, and improves the regional color by 19% in the landscape design of mountainous agriculture. The model adopts analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to analyze and collect the data of people's satisfaction with mountain agricultural landscape design, and revises the model with historical data to improve the accuracy of satisfaction evaluation. However, most landscape architecture in many areas of Our country follows the design trends of western architecture. These phenomena have not been controlled and the development speed is beyond people's imagination.

articleTitle: A New Solitary Waves Monitoring System Based on Buoy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Solitary waves are active in the South China Sea, which poses a great threat to offshore activities such as offshore oil and gas development. In this paper, an internal solitary wave monitoring system based on ocean buoy is designed. The system is composed of buoy body, anchor system, power supply system, acoustic Doppler current meter (ADCP), control acquisition system and satellite communication system. The system can provide early warning of solitary waves in the ocean in real-time through on-site observation of ocean currents. This study is of great significance to marine oil and gas development.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Management Information System Based on Rsync Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Based on the lack of information management in the process, this paper designs a management system connecting managers, tutors, candidates and other users, and expounds in detail the design objectives, development principles and functional modules of the system, which are applied to the actual enrollment, Help improve the level of management.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Study Style Evaluation System Based on Data Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of education informatization, schools pay more and more attention to the construction of study style and the evaluation of study style, and the construction of study style is also a systematic project. Schools also pay more and more attention to the evaluation of students' performance, and the style of study is an important factor affecting the quality and effectiveness of teaching, teachers' teaching level and school reputation. At the same time, data analysis is a very important technology, which plays an important role in the field of information. In addition, the style of study evaluation system, as an auxiliary tool for the evaluation of style of study, is also a typical dynamic data model, which has an important impact on the evaluation of students' learning behavior and ideology and morality. In this paper, experimental research method and data analysis method are used to better understand the performance of the system through experiments. According to the experimental results, when the number of concurrent requests is 500, the time for the system test page to complete the request is 1291, 1304, 1240, and 1354ms, respectively. From this, it can be seen that the test page of the system takes a short time to complete the request, which can meet the basic usage requirements.

articleTitle: Consistent and Specific Multi-Feature Detector Based on ERCRD for Hyperspectral Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: As the most representative anomaly detection method, collaborative representation-based detector (CRD) is widely used in the domain of hyperspectral anomaly detection (HAD). While CRD use the sliding double windows, which makes the computational complexity very high. The ensemble and random collaborative representation detector (ERCRD) only consider a single spectral feature of the hyperspectral image (HSI). Moreover, the random collective representation-based detector with multiple feature (RCRDMF) only utilizes the consistency information of different view features, but ignores the specific information of each feature. To solve above problems, we propose a new anomaly detection method named Consistent and Specific Multi-Feature Detector Based on ERCRD (CSMD). This method first extract the spectral feature, Gabor feature, extended multiattribute profile (EMAP) feature, and extended morphological profile (EMP) feature matrix from HSI. Then, the improved ERCRD method is applied to utilizes the specific information of each feature. Finally, preprocess the randomly selected background points to avoid the introduction of anomalies. Experiments are carried out on six hyperspectral datasets, the result demonstrate that CSMD method has the advantages of accuracy and speed.

Author Keywords: ensemble and random collaborative representation detector (ERCRD)
random collective representation-based detector with multiple feature (RCRDMF)
Consistent and Specific Multi-Feature Detector Based on ERCRD (CSMD)

articleTitle: Research on College English Teaching Evaluation System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: with the vigorous advancement of information technology in the Internet age, various industries have been greatly affected, and the trend of combining Internet models with multiple industries is being promoted gradually. Therefore, connecting the Internet and education has slowly become popular, and data mining technology plays a central role in this process. Data mining technology analyzes the Internet information generated by students in class, extracts relevant features, and explores the relationship between students' performance in college English classrooms and the various classroom elements. At first, this article summarizes data mining and college English teaching at home and abroad. On this basis, the scenes of the students in the college English classroom are imagined, the students' habits are modeled to establish the evaluation system of college English class.

articleTitle: Experimental Teaching and Simulation System for Ship Energy Efficiency Management
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to realize the energy efficiency management of a certain type of bulk carrier, based on the concept of green ship, optimizing the system function, and combined with the theoretical calculation, the system has designed and realized the laboratory intelligent ship energy efficiency management system based on C# and SQL Server communication. On the one hand, the system enables the crew to fully understand the relevant index of ship energy efficiency in crew training. On the other hand, the system can obtain the economic speed of a certain type of bulk carrier under the premise of meeting the requirements of ship energy efficiency management, and provide a reference for ship energy saving and emission reduction.

articleTitle: Low-carbon economic dispatch of electricity-gas integrated energy system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to cope with environmental problems and improve energy efficiency, a joint operation mode of connecting carbon capture power plants and electric to gas conversion equipment is proposed with carbon storage equipment as the hub, taking the integrated energy system of electricity and gas as the research object. Firstly, the effects of carbon capture and electricity-to-gas joint operation mode on the consumption of new energy, the reduction of system carbon emissions and the improvement of the operating performance of each unit are analyzed, and a low-carbon economic dispatch model is constructed based on the low-carbon operation mechanism to achieve the low-carbon economic operation of the electricity-gas integrated energy system. The revised IEEE 39-node power network and the Belgian 20-node natural gas network coupling system verification shows that the proposed integrated electrical energy system operation mode can effectively promote wind power consumption and reduce carbon emissions.

articleTitle: A study on facial micro-expression intelligent recognition method based on residual network and long and short term memory network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The low intensity of micro-expressions, short existence time and the possibility of appearing only in some facial regions make the automatic recognition of micro-expressions with great difficulties. In this paper, we propose a micro-expression recognition method based on residual network and long and short term memory network. First, to better characterize micro-expressions, we use optical flow images as input data. Then, a residual network is used to extract spatial features from the input data, and then the extracted spatial features are fed into a long and short term memory network (LSTM) for temporal learning. Finally, a softmax classifier is used to perform micro-expression prediction classification on the extracted feature vectors.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influencing Factors of Users’ Adoption Behavior in Social Q&A Community Based on Machine Learning Regression Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Users are the core component of social Q&A communities and influence the future development of the communities. Therefore, it is particularly important to ascertain the influencing factors of users’ adoption behavior. Based on the information adoption model, 41,832 Q&A data are collected from the Zhihu community between May 27, 2011 and March 14, 2018. The data comprises three thematic areas: children education, medical care, and Internet finance. This study explores the impact of 122 features on the adoption behavior. Four machine learning algorithms are selected. They are multiple linear regression, Lasso regression, Ridge regression, and Xgboost regression. By comparing R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and RMSE of the models, the optimum model is used to filter the top 20 important features of each theme. The results show that 1) compared with the traditional model, the Xgboost model has better prediction performance, with a maximum accuracy rate of 63.9%; 2) answer content, answer background, respondents, and answer forms all affect adoption behavior; 3) users of different themes pay different attention to the features of each category. These results indicate that clarifying the scope of the themes and distinguishing them can improve models’ prediction accuracy of model. On the other hand, the research also proves the application value of the information adoption model and the Xgboost regression model.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Research on Network White Traffic Filtering Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The Internet facilitates all aspects of people’s lives, but due to the digitization of a large amount of important information, the network carries too much important information, and malicious people are using this to attack the Internet, resulting in increasingly serious security problems on the Internet. Although the detection technology based on full traffic can achieve full traffic collection and storage, full behavior analysis and full traffic backtracking, and extract network metadata and upload it to the big data analysis platform to achieve richer functions, in actual scenarios, a large number of unpacking actions are worthless. The study uses a multi-layer integrated learning model to study the filtering of white traffic, optimizes the model accuracy rate under the premise of ensuring performance, and through a large number of data experiments, the model accuracy reaches more than 98%, and shows a high processing efficiency.

articleTitle: Auxiliary Measurement of Ultra-Precision Machine Tools Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In ultra-precision machining, tool setting accuracy has a great influence on the accuracy of machining, and the key to achieve tool setting accuracy is to accurately obtain the parameters of the turning tool tip. A new method based on machine vision for ultra-precision machine tool auxiliary measurement was presented in this paper. Firstly, contrast enhancement and threshold segmentation are used to obtain binary images with clear contours. Secondly, adaptive median Gaussian filtering is used to blur the binarized images and remove image noise. Then, the improved canny edge detection algorithm is used to obtain a clear image contour of the tool tip arc. The three-point fitting arc method is used to obtain the center pixel coordinates and the radius pixel length of the tool tip arc. Finally, the pixel length calibration software system is designed on the pre-built hardware platform for verification, and the relevant industrial camera parameters and microscope head parameters are input, and the actual circular center coordinate position and radius length of the tool tip arc are obtained through the conversion of the coordinate system. Compared with the actual measurement results, the measurement error of this method can be as low as 0.17%, which is within the error tolerance range. The method is simple to operate and the measurement accuracy meets the requirements of machine tool production. It can assist the machine tool setting operation and greatly improve the production efficiency of machine shop.

articleTitle: Fire behavior of a low smoke halogen-free cable arranged by the triangular laying method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The presented study deals with the fire risk of electrical cables arranged by the triangular laying method. The ignition time and heat release rate of a low smoke halogen-free cable were investigated using the cone calorimeter. The experimental results revealed the combustion characteristics of the cable under different thermal radiation and provided data reference for the cable installation.

articleTitle: Archival Visualization Based on Time Characteristics and Associations
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid growth of information technology, the number of digital archives in various fields of social life is also growth. Since archive data contains a lot of information, how to mine hidden information and exhibition the patterns underlying the documents in computer vision way has become a key problems. The archival visualization technology based on the combination of time characteristics and association relationships can dynamically link the digital archives with the same theme in the archive library. This paper proposes a visualization method for the analysis results of archives associations, which visualized the archives according to time characteristics and associations through interactive multi-level visualization, and displays the specific content of the archives from the perspective of the whole and individual. In experiment result, the actual case shows that the visualization method can improves the efficiency and quality of archives editing and studying.

articleTitle: Accurate Detection Method and Device for Internal Diseases of Fruit Tree Trunk Based on Electromagnetic Wave Imaging
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to change the passive management after the outbreak of diseases and insect pests in the trunk of fruit trees into active prevention before the outbreak, in view of the shortcomings of the early traditional artificial methods, such as the knock identification method, visual method and anatomical observation method, such as poor timeliness, low accuracy and easy to cause irreversible damage to trees, etc., By combining the radar chip module, electromagnetic wave transmitting and receiving module, radar antenna module and software analysis module, this paper designed an accurate detection method and device for the defects of diseases and pests inside the trunk of fruit trees based on electromagnetic wave imaging. The system quantitatively evaluates the location, size and shape of the internal diseases and wormhole defects of the trees, without causing damage to the wood, and realizing the non-destructive inspection of the wood.

articleTitle: mMTC Slice Mapping under DDoS Attack in 5G RAN
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A mMTC slice mapping algorithm is proposed to alleviate the DDoS attacks in 5G RAN. Results show that our algorithm can effectively reduce slice blocking and VM usage under different modes of DDoS attack.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Network Security Algorithm Based on Boyer Intrusion Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Computer network security is an important protection means for the safe use of data and information. Aiming at the efficiency of Boyer algorithm for intrusion detection, this paper makes a new improvement on the matching detection rules. According to a specific preset array, the two characters are combined according to the principle of adjacent grouping, and then the intrusion detection is completed by minimizing the maximum moving distance. The experimental results show that the improved imboyer algorithm has shorter time and higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of network service quality monitoring and multi-authority message warning based on IPv6
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The system mainly realizes the monitoring and early warning of the network layer and application layer in the ipv6 environment, provides comprehensive network monitoring services, can monitor network performance and potential faults in real time, and ensures the stable and efficient operation of business systems in the network environment. Real-time visual monitoring is realized, allowing users to obtain complete visibility into the entire network.
