Innovatively integrates the intelligent power environment monitoring system of the computer room based on the Internet of Things to provide protection for the external environment in which the IPv6 network system can maximize its effect, fill the current market vacancy, and has forward-looking practical significance. The network early warning information can be notified to the corresponding manager in a timely and accurate manner. It supports SMS and email warning methods. Users can choose a single warning method or a combination of multiple media for warning, which improves the success rate of website content change alarms.

articleTitle: Design of Higher Vocational Student Management System Based on Intelligent Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's social economy, the number of students in higher vocational colleges is increasing year by year. The traditional management model can no longer meet the requirements of modern education for talent training. In order to achieve this goal, it is necessary to establish an intelligent optimization algorithm to solve this problem. This paper mainly introduces the system design and analysis, model construction and related programs based on intelligent optimization algorithm. Firstly, it expounds the current situation and existing problems of management system in higher vocational colleges; Secondly, each module of the system is proposed from the perspective of software development, and the performance and function of the system are tested. Finally, the test results show that all modules of the system run normally, the ratio of using CPU is small, the response time is fast, and the amount of memory is small.

articleTitle: The progress of superconducting magnet designing for ITER
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Contemporarily, the fusion power shows a strong potential to address the issue energy crisis faced by mankind among the non-traditional energy. This article will introduce ITER and its three main components which provide the magnetic field conditions for realizing fusion reaction confinement. Specifically, the toroidal field system, the polar field system and the central solenoid system coils are discussed including the parameters, achievable remarkable outputs etc. With the supporting of the generating stable and intense magnetic field, there is no doubt that ITER will play an important role in guiding the commercialization of fusion. These results offer a guideline for future magnetic field design for future magnetic confinement fusion scenarios.

articleTitle: Discussions on the 3D models of the images of stripy flaw by X-ray examination
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the process of judging the harmfulness of defects, the longitudinal depth of defects is also a very important indicator. In order to accurately judge the situation of defects, this paper discussed the reconstructured 3D models of the images of stripy flaw by X-ray examination. According to the multiple different angles of 2D images, the principle of three-dimensional ray detection technology is reviewed. There are four steps of the 3D models reconstruction, acquisition of ray detection images at different positions, edge identification, reverse modeling and adjustment of model. Finally, A sample of the 3D reconstruction of stripy flaw was discussed.

articleTitle: Cloud Computing Based Packet Intrusion Detection for Hyper Fusion Network Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With hyper-fusion network storage becoming a rapidly growing field, it is attracting users from all walks of life, including businesses, government departments, and social networks. The implications of network intrusion on cloud computing are becoming increasingly dire. A design method based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) hypergraph feature reduction is proposed to improve the precision and calculation efficiency of network intrusion detection systems. To achieve data reduction, the optimal feature subset representation form can be optimized using the minimum distance measurement of the hypergraph structure and represented as a more significant form by the high order relation between the entities in the real world; secondly, the optimal feature subset is identified using the hypergraph helly feature recursion method, and intrusion detection is classified using the residual error-based CNN. Finally, experimental comparisons on the KDD CUP 1999 benchmark test set proved that the proposed method outperforms the industry standard according to detection precision, recall rate, and stability index.

articleTitle: Dynamic Resource Allocation Strategy Based on Dutch Auction
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: When the edge server performs resource allocation, the traditional virtual machine allocation method is insufficient to flexibly deal with the problem of computing resource allocation of the edge cloud. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a Dynamic Computing Resource and Frequency Allocation Algorithm (DRFAA) based on the change of users' comprehensive demand. It adopts the 'divide and conquer' strategy and simulate the fine-grained division of resources into 'fluid' resources for allocation, so as to seek for larger throughput and lower transmission delay. Experimental simulation results show that this method can effectively reduce the transmission delay between the user and the edge cloud and improve the throughput of the edge cloud.

articleTitle: Design of Interactive English-Chinese Machine Translation System Based on Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The era of mobile Internet has gradually matured. Facing the trend of globalization, language communication has become an indispensable part. Since the current level of education has not been universalized to everyone's basic grasp, the design of English-Chinese translation software is particularly important when communicating with foreign friends. Therefore, this paper studies an interactive English-Chinese machine translation system. The purpose of this time is to design a translation software that can bring convenience and provide a tool for people to communicate. This paper mainly uses the experimental method and the comparative method to design and test the interactive English-Chinese machine translation system. Experimental data show that the system designed in this paper has better translation ability in attributive post-terms, with an error of only 0.3862.

articleTitle: Study on Application of Channel Propagation Model for Maritime Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the implementation of marine power strategy, large scale activities at sea are increasing, and the demand for maritime communication, especially LOS communication and over-the-horizon communication on the sea, is growing, so the role of maritime communication is increasingly prominent to support the activities. It is discussed of the production, development and application of Longley-Rice model, troposcatter trans-horizon propagation loss prediction model, and evaporation duct trans-horizon propagation loss prediction model. The applicabilities of these models are analyzed and compared by digital simulation. In the end, a method of comprehensive application of the three models is proposed to provide help for the design of a comprehensive communication terminal, which can contribute to reduce the volume, weight and power consumption of the marine communication systems for complex applications.

articleTitle: A Survey of Heart Disease Risk Computer Intelligent Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the US, heart disease is the most serious problem that leads to death. What’s more, the World Health Organization regards heart disease as one of the leading causes of death in the world. Early detection and timely treatment are significant, so the predictions about the aspect of heart disease must be more accurate and timelier, because even a second for heart disease patients matters and there is no chance for error to occur. Machine learning is a solution to solve this problem, and it can help people make predictions to hears disease risk. In this article, there are three methods which have been used in predictions of heart disease will be discussed, figure out the advantages, disadvantages of each of them. Besides, there are some comparisons among these methods. Then the specific situation which is suitable for those methods to apply will be displayed, then make a summary of discussion. After that, we identify the major challenges in this area in the future.

articleTitle: A Multi-Scale Temporal Data Fusion Model Based on Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Aiming at the poor performance of traditional data fusion algorithms for high-dimension, high-noise and multi-scale temporal data fusion, a data fusion model based on deep neural network (DDB model) is proposed in this paper. DAE is used to denoise and reconstruct the input data. Secondly, deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) is used to extract spatial and short-term features of the data. The bidirectional long and short-term memory network (BLSTM) is introduced to further extract the long-term time features of the data. Finally, a fully connected network is used to fuse the temporal features of different scales. Experimental results on GE data set show that the fusion performance of this model is superior to BPNN, DCNN and CNN-LSTM data fusion models.

articleTitle: Siamese anchor-free network based on dual attention mechanism for visual tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In order to improve the ability of extracting discriminant features and add valid location information, a new Siamese anchor-free network based on dual attention mechanism is proposed—DASN. The method introduces the coordinate channel attention module and the spatial attention module to get the context features that contain the precise location information of the target. DASN can enhance the feature extraction by modeling the dependency between channels and positions, thus achieve the improvement of the accuracy of classification and locating and the robustness of tracking. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves the performance improvement on datasets VOT2018, OTB-2013 and OTB-2015, and also meets the real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Modular Information Fusion Model of Urban Landscape Design Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In the process of continuous development of urban landscape design, with social progress, scientific and technological level and other factors, people have a new understanding of natural phenomena, geographical environment and human activities. For the city, its basic function is to meet the harmony between man and the natural environment. Therefore, this paper designs the modular information fusion model of urban landscape design based on genetic algorithm. Firstly, this paper expounds the function, characteristics and design principles of urban landscape design. Then, the principle and related application of genetic algorithm are introduced. Based on the algorithm, a modular information fusion model of urban landscape design is designed, and the model is tested by simulation experiment. Finally, the test results show that the performance of the modular information fusion model of urban landscape design based on genetic algorithm is very excellent, which can show that the model can meet the needs.

articleTitle: Research and design of concentrating photovoltaic coupled heat pump cogeneration system
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: In this paper, the research on building cogeneration system based on concentrating photovoltaic coupled heat pump complementarity is carried out, and the cogeneration system platform is built. The energy transfer model and optimal combination of concentrating photovoltaic photothermal system, coupled heat pump heating, hot water supply system, heat storage system and other system components are studied, the operation mechanism of cogeneration system is analyzed, and experimental tests are carried out. Study the steady-state operation parameters that maintain the maximum comprehensive utilization rate under different working conditions under high cold and high altitude conditions and the system operation regulation strategies under different demand conditions, so as to improve the comprehensive energy utilization rate, reduce building energy consumption, provide technical support for building energy conservation in Tibet, and further provide new development ideas for realizing "carbon peak" and "carbon neutralization" in Tibet.

articleTitle: Website Link Structure Optimization Based on SEO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Search engine is an indispensable part of people's life now, and it is also an important function to complete users' normal daily life. It plays a very important role in today's society with developed network technology. Using the SEO algorithm to optimize the link structure of the website, and to a certain extent, optimize the relevant search engine algorithm, which solves the redundant and complex algorithms between traditional websites, which is a leap in the convenient and concise website link structure in the future. Based on the SEO algorithm, this paper optimizes the structure of the relationship between the website link structures and solves the problems existing between the traditional link structures. The experimental results show that after using the SEO algorithm to optimize the link structure of the website, the deficiencies of the traditional link structure are solved, the importance before optimization increases from 0 to 100, and the accessibility of the web page increases from 0 to 400.

articleTitle: Safety Analysis of Uncontained Rotor Failure Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: During the process of airworthiness certification of the civil aircraft, it is required to show that the probability of catastrophic hazard caused by uncontained rotor failure is lower than the specified standard. This paper sets forth a safety analysis method for uncontained rotor failure to verify whether the damage caused by uncontained rotor failure has been reduced to an acceptable level. A calculation model of minimal cut set trigger probability for multiple failure models is proposed, which can be used to calculate the trigger probability of minimal cut set obtained from qualitative safety analysis; A risk assessment model for uncontained failure based on Bayesian network is constructed, which can not only solve the probability of aircraft catastrophic hazard by forwarding reasoning but also solve the posterior probability of each minimal cut set by reverse reasoning. Finally, an example of safety analysis for uncontained rotor failure is given to show the feasibility of the aforementioned method.

articleTitle: Stabilize the scale by geometry consistency in self-supervised monocular depth estimation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Limited by the difficulty to gather per-pixel ground truth depth data, self-supervised depth estimation suggests an alternative approach to take advantage of large-scale dataset of autonomous driving scenes. Compared to binocular or multi-view stereo methods, depth estimation on monocular videos appears easy to implement. However, the scale-ambiguity of monocular videos prevents the metric-scale outputs of depth value and causes scale-shift that limits further application such as SLAM. In this paper we attempt to stabilize the scale of depth map by geometry consistency. Experiments on KITTI dataset illustrate that our method gains progress both on the depth and the visual odometry tasks.

articleTitle: Automobile Service Evaluation and Analysis System Based on RVM Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the prosperity and development of domestic and international automobile market, automobile service industry develops everywhere. In this environment, the construction and development of automobile service evaluation and analysis system must be strengthened. To cope with the increasing market competition, it is necessary to strengthen the network construction and development of automobile service evaluation and analysis system, and improve the high availability and reliability of the system. This article studied the RVM algorithm based car service evaluation system, focus on RVM algorithms, definition, concept, application range and so on, also explained the enterprise service evaluation system basic composition, system architecture, system principle, etc., and expounds the auto service evaluation system based on RVM method how to improve the effect. The superiority of automobile service evaluation and analysis system based on RVM algorithm is proved from data. The research and development of automobile service evaluation and analysis system based on RVM algorithm is combined with big data technology to carry out functional reform of automobile service evaluation and analysis system, improve system efficiency and improve the overall quality level of the system. After many tests, the scores of this auto service evaluation and analysis system based on RVM algorithm in the first guarantee return rate, the first payment rate, the proportion of accident vehicles, proportion of after-sales boutique revenue, accessories dead stock rate and zero-amplitude absorption are respectively 98%, 95%, 5%, 45%, 6% and 80%.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high-performance instant messaging system and personalized aggregate content service
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Nowadays, instant messaging software is widely used in people's lives, and software usage scenarios have a tendency to transform from PC to mobile. At this time, the software needs to meet the conditions of the mobile device's network environment and device configuration. Therefore, it is necessary to focus on issues such as the immediacy, reliability, orderliness, and weak network optimization of the mobile terminal's instant messaging program to send and receive messages. In the process of system design and implementation, the server side mainly uses Netty and Spring Boot frameworks, and the data storage mainly uses relational database MySQL, key-value pair database Redis, object storage MinIO, and uses the JavaMail framework to write mail services and the open-source RSSHub to provide aggregate content services. The client-side program is designed and developed based on the Android system. The program is characterized by fast message sending and receiving, high delivery rate, low traffic consumption, and low power consumption, to make sure that messages can still be sent and received successfully even when the network is weak. The main network protocols used for communication between the client and the server are TCP and HTTP.

articleTitle: Unified Control of Bidirectional Grid Connection and Active Power Filter Based on One Cycle Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: A bi-directional grid connection control method of inverter based on bipolar mode one cycle control is proposed. The structure of grid connected inverter is completely consistent with the main circuit structure of active power filter. The hardware structure of one cycle control is simple, there is no large number of multiplication, and the real-time performance is good. In addition, the switching device is in the constant frequency working state, and the switching error of each cycle will not be brought into the next cycle, so that the output current of the inverter can keep a relatively low harmonic distortion rate while tracking the grid side voltage without phase difference. The simulation results show that the bi-directional grid connected one cycle control method based on bipolar modulation proposed in this paper can input or output power with high power factor and small harmonic distortion, and has excellent harmonic current compensation performance.

articleTitle: Sonar Image Segmentation Based on BP Neural Network Optimized by Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the development of sonar technology, researchers found that the images obtained by sonar contain rich sediment characteristic information, which can understand the types of sediments, and provide a new auxiliary means for underwater survey, terrain inversion and military operations. This paper analyzes the structure of genetic algorithm, summarizes BP neural network, studies the current situation of sonar IS, discusses the sonar IS of BP neural network, and detects Sobel operator, Gaussian Laplace operator and Canny operator. The results show that when the target detection algorithm with Sobel operator as the core detects the target in radar echo image, It has better performance than Gaussian Laplace operator and Canny operator.

articleTitle: Research on Information Fusion Method for Cutting Positioning of Wire Harness Corrugated Pipe
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: The paper presents an information fusion method to ensure that the wire harness corrugated pipe is cut to the specified length and the cutting position is at the wave crest. A discrete-time linear system model is established, in which the linear displacement information of worktable is collected by photoelectric encoder as prediction information and the vertical distance information of wave crest is collected by displacement sensor as measurement information. An improved adaptive Kalman filtering algorithm is studied, which can realize on-line real-time iterative estimation of worktable linear displacement and wave crest cutting location. This method not only greatly reduces the noise estimation error, but also improves the positioning accuracy of the corrugated pipe. The error rate of crest cutting location is close to zero.

articleTitle: Multi Index Synchronous Optimization of FOC Control Based on Switched Reluctance Motor System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: Switched reluctance motor is commonly used in the control of synchronous motor in practical application. In this paper, a simulation experiment is carried out based on a simple model, the main structure and working principle of the system are introduced in detail, the driving mechanism of switched magnetic wave and the design method of related algorithm parameters are analyzed, and it is applied to the system analysis of switched reluctance motor system. Mathematical modeling and optimization experiments are built to verify whether the established model achieves the optimal performance in the control effect. The final experimental results show that the simulation results are reliable and effective.

articleTitle: Text Classification of International Relations Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE Asia-Pacific Conference on Image Processing, Electronics and Computers (IPEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of global information and the popularization of the Internet, this new method of information dissemination has changed people's lifestyles, but Internet data as an information carrier has also shown explosive growth. Effectively organizing and extracting these data to find the information that users need faster, more accurately, and more comprehensively is a major challenge facing the field of informatics today. Text mining mainly includes methods such as text sorting, text grouping, and document summarization. Text sorting is a very important way for people to acquire knowledge and recognize things. It plays an important role in natural language editing, language understanding, machine learning, and topic recognition. Therefore, this article focuses on the deep learning of international relations text classification. The learned international relations text classification model is constructed, and the constructed model is tested. The test results show that the classification model proposed in this paper has an average classification accuracy of 90%, which is better than other classification models.
